title: Supervisor
description:
**Job Family**
 GIC General (India)
   

  

**Travel Required**
 None
   

  

**Clearance Required**
 None
   

  

**What You Will Do**
* Team Management: Manage and work with Team Leads and their combined pods, setting clear performance expectations and holding regular one\-on\-ones.
* SLA \& Quality Ownership: Own segment\-level SLA, aging, and quality metrics across all in\-scope AML workstreams; drive corrective action plans where targets slip.
* Escalation Resolution: Serve as the escalation point for complex Transaction Monitoring alerts, ambiguous typology matches, and cross\-functional queries requiring judgment beyond Team Lead level.
* Calibration: Run regular calibration sessions with Quality Assurance to align on disposition standards for TM alerts, EDD assessments, and SAR quality.
* Capacity \& Roster Planning: Plan shift rosters, leave, and capacity across teams in coordination with workforce management to maintain SLA coverage.
* Process \& Regulatory Change: Translate updates to typologies, regulatory guidance, or internal policy into revised SOPs and floor communication, ensuring timely rollout.
* Performance Management: Conduct performance reviews, PIPs, and coaching plans for Team Leads; approve QA\-driven coaching plans for analysts.
* MI \& Reporting: Consolidate and present segment\-level dashboards (volume, aging, quality, attrition, productivity) to the Manager on a weekly/monthly cadence.
* Stakeholder Coordination: Liaise with Compliance, Legal, and Training functions on case\-specific queries, policy interpretation, and escalations requiring sign\-off.


**What You Will Need**
* 10\+ years of overall experience in AML/Financial Crime compliance operations, with at least 2 years directly supervising teams or Team Leads.
* Strong, demonstrable experience in Transaction Monitoring (TM) — alert investigation, disposition quality, and typology\-based decisioning at a review/oversight level.
* Proven experience managing KYC/CDD, EDD, PEP Review, and SAR Filing workstreams concurrently, ideally in a multi\-process AML operation.
* Experience managing SLA/quality performance across a segment
* Working knowledge of TM/case management systems (e.g., Actimize, SAS AML, Verafin) and reporting tools.


**What Would Be Nice To Have**
* Prior supervisory experience in a crypto/virtual asset transaction monitoring environment, including oversight of on\-chain analytics or VASP\-related due diligence.
* Working knowledge of blockchain analytics platforms (e.g., Chainalysis, Elliptic, TRM Labs) and how findings integrate into TM alert review.
* Familiarity with crypto\-specific regulatory expectations (e.g., FATF Travel Rule, Markets in Crypto\-Assets Regulation) and their impact on SAR/STR quality.

title: Senior Manager, Veeva RIM Integration Manager
description:
**Role Summary:**
 At Pfizer we make medicines and vaccines that change patients' lives with a global reach of over 780 million patients.
   

  

 Within Digital R\&D Creation Center, the Veeva RIM team is responsible for defining the strategy and leading the delivery of the Veeva RIM product suite to end users. This includes the operation, implementation, and integration of Veeva RIM solutions that address R\&D business processes effectively. At Pfizer, Veeva RIM product suite includes all modules including Registrations, HA Correspondence, Submissions \& Publishing.
   

  

 The Snr Manager, Veeva RIM Integration Manager, is a hands\-on individual contributor responsible for coordinating release readiness and lifecycle management for a complex portfolio of 60\+ upstream and downstream integrations supporting Pfizer’s Veeva RIM product suite. This role combines project management, stakeholder communication, and technical integration understanding, including knowledge of the Veeva RIM data model and how data model changes impact integrations and consuming systems. The role works closely with Product Management, Business Owners, Business Process Owners, Regulatory Operations, technical teams, Quality, validation partners, integration owners, consuming application teams, and vendors to manage release impacts, data model changes, remediation needs, cutover readiness, and operational handoffs in alignment with Agile, SDLC methodologies.
   

  

**Role Responsibilities:**
**Integration Portfolio and Project Management**
* Accountable for coordinating visibility, readiness tracking, dependency management, and stakeholder alignment across a portfolio of 60\+ upstream and downstream Veeva RIM integrations spanning consuming systems, business processes, data flows, and stakeholder groups.
* Serve on a SAFe Agile team and contribute to PI planning, backlog refinement, sprint execution, and management of Veeva RIM release impacts, dependencies, risks, issues, readiness status, cutover activities, and operational handoffs across the integration landscape.
* Accountable for ensuring downstream consumers, upstream source systems, and Business Process Owners have clear awareness of upcoming release scope, timing, data model changes, process impacts, testing expectations, cutover needs, and required actions.
* Accountable for developing and managing release communications, Business Process Owner updates, consumer impact summaries, readiness checkpoints, escalation messages, and post\-release follow\-up.
* Accountable for tracking timelines, milestones, dependencies, action items, decisions, and stakeholder status reporting to keep integration work aligned to Veeva RIM release commitments.


**Technical Integration and Remediation Coordination**
* Accountable for coordinating with integration owners, consuming application teams, technical leads, platform teams, and vendors to ensure technical issues, root causes, remediation plans, and readiness risks are visible and actively tracked.
* Apply practical understanding of the Veeva RIM data model, APIs, middleware, ETL patterns, file\-based integrations, SSO, data mapping, data model impacts, error handling, monitoring, and operational support to coordinate technical discussions and decisions.
* Accountable for facilitating alignment with technical teams responsible for remediating impacted consuming systems to confirm readiness, track remediation progress, resolve dependencies, and support smooth cutover for Veeva RIM data model or integration changes.
* Technical design and remediation activities are performed by the accountable technical teams; this role coordinates impact assessment, readiness tracking, communications, and cutover alignment across those teams.


**Testing, Validation, and Operational Readiness**
* Accountable for coordinating functional, integration, regression, user acceptance, cutover, and operational readiness testing across impacted systems and consumers.
* Partner with Quality, validation, testing, engineering, consumer teams, and vendors to ensure integration changes meet SDLC and CSV expectations, including requirements traceability, test evidence, defect management, and release approvals.
* Accountable for maintaining key integration and release materials, such as integration inventories, consumer impact matrices, interface specifications, data flow diagrams, release checklists, runbooks, decision logs, environment matrix and support handoff materials.


**Basic Qualifications:**
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, Business, or a related field, with 7\+ years of relevant experience, or equivalent combination of education and experience.
* Experience supporting integration delivery for enterprise platforms; experience with Veeva Vault and/or Veeva RIM integrations is strongly preferred.
* Experience coordinating complex integration work across upstream systems, downstream consumers, technical teams, vendors, and business stakeholder groups.
* Strong project management skills, including planning, milestone tracking, dependency management, risk/issue management, release readiness tracking, and stakeholder status reporting.
* Strong communications skills, including the ability to create clear release communications, Business Process Owner updates, consumer impact summaries, readiness updates, escalation messages, and executive\-ready status updates.
* Practical understanding of the Veeva RIM data model and integration concepts, including APIs, middleware, ETL patterns, file\-based integrations, SSO, data mapping, data model impacts, error handling, monitoring, remediation coordination, and operational support.
* Experience with Agile delivery, SDLC controls, release governance in a regulated environment.


**Preferred Qualifications:**
* Experience supporting Regulatory business processes and/or working in the Life Sciences industry.
* Experience with SAFe, Scrum, or formal project management practices; relevant certification such as SAFe, Scrum, PMP, or similar is a plus.
* Veeva Vault certification(s) and/or experience with Veeva RIM, multi\-vault deployments, integration inventories, consumer impact matrices, release checklists, cutover planning, and operational runbooks.


 Work Location Assignment: Hybrid

* Own your own projects and/or contribute to projects managed by other 2S sponsors

* Contribute to the structure and smooth functioning among the various within the team.
* Lead the project approach internally and demonstrate its benefits.
* Embed a continuous‑improvement mindset and a systematic voice‑of‑the‑client listening process.
* Build a global view of progress and risks across all projects.

**Financial**
* Ensure all teams are adhered to Quality of 100%

Updating required staff/team adequately on any changes/new events impacting BAU. Should be proactively escalating the BAU/Staff issues to Senior Manager.

* Develop SMEs and ensure that, the Back\-up management tool is in place for all the team members.

* Enforce 100% compliance of controls. If new controls need to be placed to ensure quality
* Ensure procedures are in place to effectively deal with exceptions and that they are reviewed, researched, documented and resolved in a timely manner.
* Identify the manual steps, process efficiencies \& developments, by providing practical ideas on areas of improvements \& work towards its automation.
* Ensure to minimize the unplanned leaves, especially during business critical days, like month end, rollover days and migration of new funds

 Client Focus
   

  

* Be pro\-active in developing customer relations by understanding and responding to customer needs.
* Strive continually for customer satisfaction.
* Try to identify the real needs of the customer, including those not necessarily stated.
* Deliver very high quality results.

title: Head of Section of Solutions Engineering
description:
**About Us**
 We are the independent expert in assurance and risk management. Driven by our purpose, to safeguard life, property, and the environment, we empower our customers and their stakeholders with facts and reliable insights so that critical decisions can be made with confidence.
   

  

 As a trusted voice for many of the world’s most successful organizations, we use our knowledge to advance safety and performance, set industry benchmarks, and inspire and invent solutions to tackle global transformations.
   

  

**About Energy Systems**
 We help customers navigate the complex transition to a decarbonized and more sustainable energy future. We do this by assuring that energy systems work safely and effectively, using solutions that are increasingly digital. We also help industries and governments to navigate the many complex, interrelated transitions taking place globally and regionally, in the energy industry.
   

  

**About The Role**
 The Head of Section \- Solutions Engineering is responsible for leading the solutions engineering function that translates business, customer, and subject matter expert needs into scalable platform implementations within Digital \& Transformation. This includes leading configuration\-first delivery across low\-code, hybrid, and API\-enabled platform environments while ensuring implementation quality, repeatability, and production readiness.
   

  

 This role sits within the Digital \& Transformation organization, helping to advance how DNV performs Due Diligence, Verification \& Assurance, and Renewables Certification work across Energy Systems.
   

  

 Working in close partnership with Product leadership, Data \& AI Engineering, Application Engineering, and global digital teams, this role translates customer requirements into reliable, production\-ready platform configurations. The Head of Section \- Solution Engineering sets clear standards for implementation quality, stability, validation, and reusable configuration patterns across low\-code and hybrid development environments.
   

  

 This role leads a team focused on configuring the platform for customer\-specific and business\-specific use cases using existing platform capabilities wherever possible. When a requirement cannot be met through configuration, the role ensures it is clearly assessed, documented, and translated into a product or engineering backlog item for prioritization, including the business context, implementation impact, and recommended path forward.
   

  

 The Head of Section \- Solutions Engineering plays a key role in scaling repeatable implementation practices, improving delivery velocity through AI\-assisted configuration methods, and strengthening knowledge transfer between implementation and engineering teams.
   

  

 \*\*This role is based at our DNV office in Chennai, India. Further details regarding role\-specific requirements will be shared during the interview process.\*\*
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Solution Engineering Leadership \& Delivery**
* Lead solution engineering across customer and internal platform implementation programs, ensuring consistent, high\-quality delivery of configured platform solutions.
* Translate requirements into scalable, maintainable, and production\-ready platform configurations.
* Establish clear ownership, accountability, and delivery discipline across implementation activities.
* Ensure program\-specific configurations are validated through structured User Acceptance Testing and implementation quality reviews.


**Modern Development \& AI\-Enabled Configuration**
* Drive adoption of AI\-assisted methods for requirements analysis, workflow configuration, test case generation, documentation, and implementation reuse across low\-code and hybrid development environments.
* Define how solution engineering teams use AI\-enabled tools to improve speed, consistency, and documentation quality.
* Ensure strong implementation fundamentals, configuration quality, and peer review practices remain central alongside AI acceleration.
* Partner with engineering teams to turn mature AI capabilities into reusable implementation patterns.


**Platform Configuration \& Interoperability**
* Oversee configuration patterns, business rules, workflows, data loads, and platform setup needed to support customer use cases.
* Collaborate across Product, engineering teams, advisory regions, and digital teams to support interoperability across core systems.
* Promote reusable implementation patterns, templates, prompts, and configuration standards.
* Guide the appropriate balance between customer\-specific configuration and requests that require platform enhancement.


**Organization \& Capability Development**
* Lead and evolve a solution engineering team with clear roles, implementation standards, and delivery expectations.
* Build, develop, and retain high\-performing implementation and platform configuration talent.
* Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, continuous improvement, and delivery excellence.


**Implementation Governance, Quality \& Security**
* Ensure implementations follow platform governance, security, data handling, and access control standards.
* Maintain traceability between requirements, configuration decisions, validation evidence, and production release readiness.
* Establish consistent implementation review practices to reduce delivery risk and improve repeatability across programs.
* Partner with Product, Engineering, Security, and Global Shared Services teams to ensure implementation practices align with enterprise standards.


 What we offer
   

  

* Flexible work arrangements for better work\-life balance
* Generous Paid Leaves (Annual, Sick, Compassionate, Local Public, Marriage, Maternity, Paternity, Medical leave)
* Medical benefits ( Insurance and Annual Health Check\-up)
* Pension and Insurance Policies (Group Term Life Insurance, Group Personal Accident Insurance, Travel Insurance)
* Training and Development Assistance (Training Sponsorship, On\-The\-Job Training, Training Programme)
* Additional Benefits (Long Service Awards, Mobile Phone Reimbursement)
* Company bonus/Profit share.


 \*Benefits may vary based on position, tenure/contract/grade level\*
   

  

 DNV is an Equal Opportunity Employer and gives consideration for employment to qualified applicants without regard to gender, religion, race, national or ethnic origin, cultural background, social group, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, age or political opinion. Diversity is fundamental to our culture and we invite you to be part of this diversity.
   

  

**About You**
* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or related field, or equivalent experience.
* 5\-8 years of relevant experience in solution engineering, implementation, platform configuration, or technical delivery, including 3\+ years leading teams, workstreams, or implementation programs.
* Strong background delivering customer solutions in low\-code, hybrid, SaaS, or enterprise platform environments.
* Demonstrated experience translating customer requirements into reliable platform configurations and implementation patterns.
* Experience with User Acceptance Testing, validation planning, customer delivery quality, and implementation governance.
* Understanding of APIs, workflows, business rules, data loads, and integration patterns.
* Experience using AI\-assisted tools or automation to improve implementation delivery, testing, or documentation.


**What Is Preferred**
* Experience in product\-led or platform\-based organizations.
* Familiarity with low\-code or hybrid development environments.
* Experience supporting interoperability across multiple systems or enterprise platforms.
* Background in energy, infrastructure, or other technically complex industries.
* Experience leading customer implementation teams in globally distributed environments.
* Experience scaling repeatable implementation practices across multiple customers, business units, regions, or delivery teams.


*Security and compliance with statutory requirements in the countries in which we operate is essential for DNV. Background checks will be conducted on all final candidates as part of the offer process, in accordance with applicable country\-specific laws and practices.*

description:
**Senior Category Manager \| Urban Company** 




  





**About the Company** 




 Urban Company is a technology platform offering customers a variety of services at home. Customers use our platform to book services such as beauty treatments, haircuts, massage
 



 therapy, cleaning, plumbing, carpentry, appliance repair, painting, etc., all delivered in the comfort of their home and at a time of their choosing. We promise our customers a high\-quality, standardized, and reliable service experience. To fulfill this promise, we work closely with our hand\-picked service partners, enabling them with technology, training, products, tools, financing, insurance, and brand, helping them succeed and deliver on this promise.
 



 Urban Company started as UrbanClap in November 2014, when its founders, Abhiraj, Raghav, and Varun, realized that the home services industry was predominantly unorganized, fragmented, and offline. Customers found it challenging to avail quality services conveniently, and service professionals were struggling to make ends meet, having to rely upon several

description:

**Description**
 At the World Bank, a member of the World Bank Group (WBG), you’ll join a diverse, global community working across cultures, disciplines, and borders to address the world’s most pressing development challenges. With 1\.2 billion young people reaching working age in the decade ahead, the challenge of job creation has never been greater. Through partnerships across 145 countries and more than 182 offices worldwide, we work with governments, private sector, development partners and other stakeholders to invest in people, strengthen markets, and deliver scalable, data\-driven solutions that generate more and better jobs and improve lives. For more information, visit https:// www.worldbank.org/en/who\-we\-are/ibrd
   

  

 The WBG Controllers Vice Presidency oversees all aspects of financial reporting and the internal control framework across the World Bank Group, including its extensive Trust Fund and Partnership portfolio. CTR supports a robust fiduciary control framework, administers disbursements for Bank lending operations, and leads the client service function for the WB's corporate expenses. The Vice Presidency is organized into three departments – Corporate Accounting and Reporting; Loan and Financing Operations; and Financial Operations – and is guided by a shared focus on delivery, optimization, impact, and people and culture.
   

  

**CTRAC – Financial Instruments Accounting and Valuation**
 Within CTR, the Financial Instruments Accounting and Valuation (CTRAC) is responsible for product control functions for financial instruments including borrowings, derivatives, and investments for IBRD, IDA, IFC, MIGA, and Trust Funds except for pension funds. These include financial instrument product aligned accounting, determination of the lending rate of the Bank, producing valuation for the IBRD/IDA bonds, derivatives, and loans, implementation of financial models and valuation review, market data sourcing and verification, implementing accounting policies around financial instruments, independent price verification, financial instrument related data management and providing disclosure information for financial statements regarding these financial instruments.
   

  

 This position is that of Financial Officer in Chennai (CTRAC), who will play the role of a technical lead in the delivery of the unit’s responsibilities as they relate to the project management, accounting, valuation and reporting of financial instruments. She/He will interact with counterparts in Finance (CTR, Chief Risk officer, Treasury, and Corporate Finance) and with external counterparts especially MDBs and will represent the division in working groups related to new initiatives and new financial instruments.
   

  

**What Will You Do**
* Lead / support efforts to implement institutional projects and business initiatives. Translate new initiatives or financial products into new processes and / or system portfolios
* requirements. This would include implementation and maintenance of systems supporting various Coordinate the documentation and consolidation of business requirements (BRDs) with business Subject Matter Experts, into clear, actionable specifications for the technical development team.
* Manage User Acceptance Testing (UAT) for sprint and quarterly releases, including review, and quality assurance of test cases in accordance with defined testing standards
* Collaborate with business and information technology teams across locations to address system issues and implement solutions promptly
* Review accounting entries and ensure daily / weekly / monthly control activities are performed, especially for the liquid investments portfolios
* Identify, investigate, and resolve system\-to\-system reconciliation and accounting flow breaks
* Monitor and analyze accounting and valuation results as they relate to the investments portfolios primarily, to ensure they are consistent with expectations and business objectives or deviations (if any) are justified and adequately documented. This would include the establishment of exception and monitoring reports and review and investigation of the same.
* Verify trade set\-up and trade modifications
* Prepare and provide quality assurance of calculated market data, evaluation of data sources, and verification of the data reliability
* Develop expectations, perform analysis, prepare / review and present sign\-off commentaries, suggest and implement solutions in a pro\-active manner
* Prepare and analyze allocation of debt funding to separate pools and computation of cost pass through rates for Bank lending products
* Prepare / present various financial and management reports, as required by the department or other stakeholders
* Proactively interact with World Bank Treasury (TRE) front office business units to stay abreast of new/proposed activities that may have accounting or reporting implications.
* Provide services to clients within and outside the Bank by providing financial information, training programs and related materials.
* Coordinate with / support external and internal auditors, when required
* Exercise fiduciary responsibility by reviewing policies and procedures and ensuring they are correctly followed.
* Staying abreast of accounting pronouncements and industry best practice as it relates to accounting / valuation of financial instruments.
* Continually look for opportunities to improve processes and internal controls. Be responsible for promoting controls and ensuring compliance in WFA.
* Maintain and develop processes, procedures, documentation and internal controls around portfolios handled, with the objective of increasing efficiency and accuracy


 Selection Criteria
   

  

**Education**
 What will you bring:
   

  

* Master’s degree(s) or equivalent in relevant profession discipline (Accounting, Finance, Economics, etc.)
* Professional finance/accounting qualification (CA, CPA, ACCA or equivalent accounting qualification and / or CFA / FRM)


**Experience**

**Core Technical Knowledge**

* Strong knowledge of Murex, including familiarity with accounting\-related outputs, trade booking, trade lifecycle processing, and investigation of system or data discrepancies.
* Proven quantitative and qualitative analytical skills, including excellent spreadsheet and skills. Familiarity with Power BI, financial modeling techniques, programming languages (e.g., Python), writing macros will be a plus.

* 
* Demonstrated high level of initiative, self\-confidence, and a self\-starter.
* Diplomacy and strong interpersonal skills; commitment to work in a team\-oriented, multi\-cultural environment; detail oriented.
* Excellent verbal and written communication and presentation skills, including preparing presentations for senior management.


**Abilities**

* Ability to meet tight deadlines.
* Strong communication skills, including the ability to explain and express views/opinions clearly and confidently.

 As the World Bank Group continues to evolve, we value candidates who:

title: Project Commissioning Engneer - Main circuit equipments - HVDC
description:
**The Opportunity**
 We are seeking a highly skilled Project Commissioning Engineer specializing in main circuit equipment for High Voltage Direct Current (HVDC) systems. This role involves ensuring the successful commissioning, testing, and handover of complex HVDC projects, focusing on the main power circuit components.
   

  

**How You’ll Make An Impact**
* Develop and implement detailed commissioning plans, procedures, and checklists for main circuit equipment in HVDC converter stations (e.g., converters, transformers, AC filters, DC filters, switchgear, busbars).
* Lead and execute pre\-commissioning, functional testing, and integrated system testing of main circuit components, adhering to project specifications, safety regulations, and industry standards.
* Perform troubleshooting and fault diagnosis on HVDC main circuit equipment, identifying root causes of issues and implementing effective solutions during commissioning phases.
* Collaborate closely with design engineers, manufacturing teams, site installation teams, and client representatives to ensure seamless project execution and resolve technical challenges.
* Prepare and review technical reports, test records, commissioning certificates, and as\-built documentation.
* Provide technical guidance and training to site personnel and junior engineers on HVDC main circuit equipment operation and maintenance.
* Ensure compliance with all safety regulations, environmental policies, and quality standards throughout the commissioning process.
* Participate in factory acceptance testing (FAT) and site acceptance testing (SAT) as required.
* Manage and coordinate commissioning resources, including tools, equipment, and personnel.
* Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives for commissioning processes and procedures.


**Your Background**
* Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Power Engineering, or a related field.
* Minimum of 5\-7 years of experience in commissioning, testing, or field service of HVDC systems, with a strong focus on main circuit equipment.
* In\-depth knowledge of HVDC technology, power electronics, and high voltage AC/DC systems.
* Proven experience with testing equipment and diagnostic tools used in HVDC commissioning.
* Familiarity with relevant international standards (e.g., IEC, IEEE) for HVDC systems and main circuit components.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills, with the ability to troubleshoot complex electrical systems.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to work effectively in multidisciplinary and multicultural teams.
* Ability to read and interpret electrical schematics, single\-line diagrams, and technical specifications.
* Willingness to travel extensively to project sites globally for extended periods.
* Proficiency in English, both written and spoken. Knowledge of additional languages is a plus.

* Executive Communication \& Visual Storytelling
* Strategic Narrative Design: Lead the creation of sophisticated, executive\-level presentations (PowerPoint) for Steering Committees, Board reviews, and Group\-level reporting.

* Capable of working independently, managing multiple tasks and priorities simultaneously. Mentor junior consultants and review their technical deliverables.

title: Senior Delivery Manager
description:
**Job Description**
**Ciklum** 
 is looking for a
 **Senior Delivery Manager** 
 to join our team full\-time in India.

With a global team of over 4,000 highly skilled developers, consultants, analysts and product owners, we engineer technology that redefines industries and shapes the way people live.

 As a Senior Delivery Manager, become a part of a cross\-functional development team engineering experiences of tomorrow.

* Own the delivery plan, sprint cadence, milestones and dependency map across parallel workstreams
* Run delivery governance: weekly status, steering committee updates, the RAID log and financial tracking

* Lead and coordinate architects, engineers, AI and conversation designers, business analysts and QA, including planning when people join and roll off
* Chase and escalate client dependencies such as system access, environments, data and sign\-offs, and clear blockers early
* Build and maintain relationships with client sponsors, product owners and system owners
* Plan and run user acceptance testing, defect triage, release readiness, go\-live and hypercare

* Set up how benefits will be measured after go\-live, in agreement with the client
* Make sure the team meets client onboarding, access and security requirements, including leaver and access audits


**Requirements**
* Agile delivery across workstreams that move at different speeds, such as platform build and product or conversation design
* Programme planning across parallel streams, including critical path and dependency management
* Executive stakeholder management and clear, early escalation
* Risk, issue and change management
* Test and release management, including UAT planning and go/no\-go decisions
* Enough technical fluency in APIs, cloud and AI or data platforms to challenge estimates and understand why a dependency matters
* 10 or more years in technology delivery, including 5 or more years leading programmes with teams of 10 or more
* A track record of delivering fixed\-price, multi\-stream programmes in large, matrixed enterprises
* Consulting or professional services background with direct client ownership


**Desirable**
* Experience on contact centre, customer experience, conversational AI or automation programmes
* Experience working with enterprise procurement and contingent worker controls
* Delivery certifications such as PMP, PRINCE2, SAFe or Scrum Master


**Personal Skills**
* Direct and calm under pressure, and comfortable saying no and holding scope
* Escalates early and clearly, rather than absorbing risk quietly
* Builds trust with both client and delivery teams, and keeps both informed without needing to be chased

* Care: We’ve got you covered with company\-paid medical insurance, mental health support, and financial \& legal consultations


**About Us**
 At Ciklum, we are always exploring innovations, empowering each other to achieve more, and engineering solutions that matter. With us, you’ll work with cutting\-edge technologies, contribute to impactful projects, and be part of a One Team culture that values collaboration and progress.
   

  

 India is a strategic innovation hub for Ciklum, with growing teams in Chennai and Pune leading advancements in EdgeTech, AR/VR, IoT, and beyond. Join us to collaborate on game\-changing solutions and take your career to the next level.

The TPM serves as a strategic leader who balances platform scalability, reliability, security, developer experience, and cost optimization while ensuring enterprise platform services continue to meet evolving business and technology needs.
   

  

 Platform domains may include Observability, Infrastructure Automation, PKI and Certificate Lifecycle Management, Trusted Images, Kubernetes and Container Platform Services, Developer Tooling, and Internal Developer Platforms.
   

  

 This is a hybrid position and involves regular performance of job responsibilities virtually as well as in\-person at an assigned TU office location for a minimum of two days a week. This is a hybrid position and involves regular performance of job responsibilities virtually as well as in\-person at an assigned TU office location for a minimum of two days a week.
   

  

**Role Overview And Core Responsibilities**
 Platform Strategy \& Roadmap Management

+ Observability
+ PKI and Certificate Lifecycle Management
+ Trusted Images
+ Container Platform Services (Kubernetes/CMK)
+ Infrastructure Automation
+ Internal Developer Platform capabilities

* Drive platform strategy, lifecycle management, adoption, and governance in partnership with platform service owners and engineering leadership.

 Platform Adoption \& Customer Success
   

  

* Drive adoption of enterprise platform services across engineering organizations.
* Establish feedback mechanisms to understand customer needs and continuously improve platform offerings.
* Measure and report platform adoption, utilization, maturity, and customer satisfaction.
* Champion self\-service platform capabilities that improve developer productivity and experience.


 Service Governance \& Operational Excellence
   

  

* Define and maintain platform governance models, operating processes, and service lifecycle standards.
* Establish and monitor service KPIs, SLAs, SLOs, operational health metrics, reliability indicators, and adoption measures.
* Partner with engineering teams to ensure services meet enterprise standards for security, availability, scalability, and compliance.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives based on operational data, service performance, and customer feedback.


 Program \& Delivery Leadership
   

  

* Manage cross\-team initiatives spanning multiple platform and engineering organizations.
* Develop and maintain delivery plans, release schedules, dependencies, risks, and mitigation strategies.
* Facilitate Agile planning, PI Planning, readiness activities, roadmap reviews, and executive reporting.
* Ensure successful execution of platform initiatives while maintaining alignment with strategic objectives.


 Cross\-Functional Leadership
   

  

* Coordinate complex initiatives involving:
+ Enterprise Architecture
+ Information Security
+ Compliance \& Risk
+ Cloud Engineering
+ Platform Operations
+ Application Development Teams

* Build alignment among technical and business stakeholders.
* Influence architecture decisions, platform standards, and engineering best practices.
* Drive consistent adoption of enterprise\-wide platform capabilities and operating models.


**Required Knowledge And Experiences**
 Required Knowledge \& Experiences:
   

  

* 5\+ years of experience as a Technical Platform Manager, Technical Product Manager, Technical Program Manager, or similar leadership role within an Agile environment.

* Experience defining and executing platform strategy, adoption, governance, service lifecycle management, and roadmap execution.
* Strong understanding of platform engineering domains including Observability, Infrastructure Automation, PKI/Certificate Services, Container Platforms, and Cloud Operations.
* Strong understanding of cloud architecture, scalability, reliability, resiliency, security, and operational excellence principles.
* Experience managing shared platform services or internal developer platforms serving multiple engineering teams.
* Experience establishing and tracking platform KPIs, SLAs, SLOs, operational health metrics, reliability indicators, and adoption measures.
* Experience coordinating cross\-functional initiatives involving Architecture, Security, Compliance, Cloud Engineering, Operations, and Application Development teams.
* Proven ability to influence technical and business stakeholders at all organizational levels.
* Strong ownership mindset with demonstrated success managing dependencies, risks, and commitments across multiple teams.
* Ability to identify patterns across organizations, simplify complexity, and establish consistent operating standards.
* Experience managing platform roadmaps, requirements, delivery execution, and reporting using Jira, Confluence, and related workflow tools.
* Experience working with globally distributed teams across multiple time zones.
* Excellent communication and presentation skills, including the ability to translate complex technical topics into actionable business outcomes.
* Experience balancing platform scalability, reliability, security, and adoption while optimizing infrastructure and operational costs.


**Required Technical Skills**
* Cloud platforms: AWS, Microsoft Azure, and/or Google Cloud Platform (GCP).

title: Service Delivery Manager, Field Services
description:
Job Description – Service Delivery Manager, Field Services
 



**Company:** 
 Teceze
 



**Position:** 
 Service Delivery Manager – Field Services
 



**Department:** 
 Service Delivery / Operations
 



**Employment Type:** 
 Full\-Time
 



**Reporting To:** 
 Head of Service Delivery / Operations Director
 



 Role Overview
 



 Teceze is looking for an experienced
 **Service Delivery Manager – Field Services** 
 to manage and drive the successful delivery of onsite IT field services projects across multiple customer locations.
 



 The role will be responsible for end\-to\-end service delivery covering
 **Field IT Support, Smart Hands, Deskside Support, Data Center Support, Network Support, IMACD, Break/Fix, Rollouts, Deployments, and Dispatch Services** 
 .
 



 The SDM will act as the primary operational interface between Teceze, customers, engineers, subcontractors, and internal teams. The individual will be accountable for meeting contractual SLAs, maintaining service quality, managing engineer performance, ensuring timely resource deployment, and improving overall customer satisfaction.
 



 This is a highly operational and customer\-facing role requiring strong experience managing distributed field engineering teams and multi\-site IT support engagements.
 



 Key Responsibilities
 



 Service Delivery Management
 


* Manage end\-to\-end delivery of Field Services engagements across assigned customers, countries, regions, or service towers.
* Ensure all onsite IT support tickets, dispatch requests, projects, and scheduled activities are delivered within agreed SLA and quality standards.
* Act as the primary operational point of contact for customers.
* Conduct daily and weekly service reviews with customers and internal stakeholders.
* Track incidents, service requests, escalations, project activities, and engineer performance.
* Ensure customer commitments are clearly communicated and delivered.
* Maintain complete visibility of all active projects, open tickets, pending dispatches, and engineer assignments.
* Ensure services are delivered in accordance with contractual scope, SOPs, work instructions, and customer processes.



 Field Services Operations
 



 Manage delivery across services including:
 


* Deskside Support
* Desktop Support
* End User Computing Support
* Smart Hands
* Remote Hands
* Network Field Support
* Data Center Support
* IT Infrastructure Support
* IMAC / IMACD
* Break/Fix Support
* Hardware Installation
* Hardware Replacement
* Device Deployment
* Device Refresh
* Site Surveys
* Office Moves
* Network Rollouts
* Wi\-Fi Deployments
* Rack and Stack
* Cabling
* Server and Network Device Replacement
* POS Support
* Printer and Peripheral Support
* Project\-Based IT Deployments



 SLA \& KPI Management
 



 The SDM will be responsible for monitoring and maintaining service performance against agreed KPIs and SLAs.
 



 Key metrics may include:
 


* SLA compliance
* Response time
* Engineer acceptance time
* Engineer arrival time
* Resolution time
* First\-time fix rate
* Ticket backlog
* Repeat incident rate
* Engineer utilization
* Engineer attendance
* Customer satisfaction
* Escalation rate
* Ticket aging
* Resource fulfillment time
* Project completion rate



 The role should aim to consistently maintain
 **98% or higher SLA achievement** 
 , subject to customer contractual requirements.
 



 Engineer \& Resource Management
 


* Manage a distributed workforce of Field Engineers, Deskside Engineers, Smart Hands Engineers, Network Engineers, and Data Center Engineers.
* Coordinate with recruitment and sourcing teams to ensure adequate engineer coverage.
* Maintain backup engineer pools for critical locations.
* Ensure rapid backfill when engineers are unavailable.
* Monitor engineer attendance, punctuality, ticket acceptance, and service quality.
* Conduct regular engineer performance reviews.
* Address repeated SLA failures or customer complaints involving engineers.
* Ensure engineers have the correct tools, skills, access, documentation, and site information before dispatch.
* Coordinate engineer onboarding, access approvals, background verification, and customer compliance requirements.
* Maintain skill matrices for engineers across locations.



 Dispatch Management
 


* Ensure all dispatch tickets are assigned within agreed turnaround time.
* Coordinate engineer availability and scheduling.
* Track engineers from assignment through ticket completion.
* Monitor engineer ETA and site arrival.
* Escalate delays proactively.
* Ensure proper communication with customers throughout the dispatch lifecycle.
* Maintain alternate engineer coverage for high\-priority locations.
* Ensure engineers complete all required service reports and closure documentation.



 Project Management
 



 Manage Field Services projects such as:
 


* Desktop refresh projects
* Hardware rollout
* Network equipment replacement
* Data center migration
* Office relocation
* Device deployment
* Wi\-Fi rollout
* Site surveys
* Infrastructure upgrades
* Cabling projects
* End\-user migration
* Store rollout
* Branch rollout
* POS deployment



 Responsibilities include:
 


* Project planning
* Resource planning
* Site scheduling
* Scope validation
* Engineer allocation
* Risk management
* Client communication
* Progress tracking
* Daily reporting
* Issue management
* Quality control
* Project closure



 Customer Management
 


* Build strong operational relationships with customers.
* Act as escalation point for service delivery issues.
* Conduct regular service review meetings.
* Present SLA and KPI performance.
* Discuss open risks, incidents, projects, and improvement opportunities.
* Ensure customer expectations are clearly understood and communicated internally.
* Identify service gaps and recommend corrective actions.
* Work closely with account management and sales teams to identify opportunities for service expansion.



 Escalation Management
 


* Own critical service escalations.
* Coordinate internal teams to resolve customer\-impacting issues.
* Establish clear escalation paths.
* Provide timely customer communication during major incidents.
* Conduct root cause analysis where required.
* Implement corrective and preventive actions.
* Maintain an escalation log and track actions through closure.



 Vendor \& Partner Management
 


* Manage subcontractors, local service partners, and third\-party engineers.
* Monitor vendor SLA performance.
* Ensure vendors comply with customer security, safety, and operational requirements.
* Review vendor performance regularly.
* Support procurement in negotiating service rates where required.
* Identify alternate suppliers or partners where service coverage is weak.
* Ensure appropriate documentation and agreements are in place.



 ITSM \& Ticket Management
 



 The SDM should have experience working with ITSM platforms such as:
 


* ServiceNow
* Jira Service Management
* ManageEngine
* Remedy
* Freshservice
* Zendesk
* Other enterprise ITSM platforms



 Responsibilities include:
 


* Ticket monitoring
* Assignment management
* SLA tracking
* Escalation handling
* Incident management
* Request management
* Change coordination
* Problem management
* Reporting and dashboards



 Documentation \& Governance
 



 Ensure appropriate documentation is maintained, including:
 


* SOPs
* Runbooks
* Work Instructions
* Site Information
* Engineer Guides
* Escalation Matrices
* Contact Lists
* Service Reports
* SLA Reports
* KPI Dashboards
* Project Plans
* Risk Registers
* Issue Logs
* Asset Records
* Customer Meeting Minutes



 Asset Management
 



 Where applicable, manage field service\-related assets including:
 


* Laptops
* Desktops
* Servers
* Network equipment
* Spare devices
* Replacement parts
* Tools
* Peripheral devices



 Ensure accurate tracking of equipment dispatched, installed, replaced, returned, or stored.
 



 Knowledge Management
 


* Maintain technical knowledge repositories.
* Ensure engineers have access to customer\-specific troubleshooting documentation.
* Conduct knowledge transfer sessions.
* Capture lessons learned from projects and escalations.
* Standardize best practices across customer environments.



 Service Improvement
 


* Identify opportunities to improve SLA performance and reduce operational cost.
* Automate reporting and repetitive operational processes where possible.
* Reduce engineer no\-shows and late arrivals.
* Improve first\-time fix rate.
* Improve engineer coverage.
* Reduce ticket aging and backlog.
* Standardize processes across regions.
* Conduct regular service improvement reviews.



 Commercial Awareness
 



 The SDM should understand basic commercial aspects of service delivery including:
 


* Engineer rates
* Project costing
* Dispatch costs
* Travel costs
* Overtime
* Service penalties
* SLA credits
* Vendor costs
* Project profitability
* Resource utilization



 Work closely with finance, procurement, and account management teams to ensure projects remain operationally and commercially sustainable.
 



 Required Experience
 


* **7\+ years of experience in IT Service Delivery, Field Services, IT Infrastructure, or Managed Services.**
* Minimum
 **3–5 years in a Service Delivery Manager or equivalent role** 
 .
* Strong experience managing onsite and field engineering teams.
* Experience managing multi\-site or multi\-country operations.
* Strong understanding of IT infrastructure support.
* Experience with SLA\-driven managed services environments.
* Strong experience managing customers and escalations.
* Experience with ITSM platforms such as ServiceNow.
* Experience working with third\-party vendors and subcontractors.
* Strong reporting, governance, and communication skills.



 Technical Understanding
 



 The candidate should have working knowledge of:
 


* Desktop Support
* Windows
* Microsoft 365
* Active Directory
* Hardware troubleshooting
* Networking
* Cisco
* Aruba
* Routers
* Switches
* Wireless
* LAN / WAN
* Servers
* Storage
* Data Centers
* Smart Hands
* Rack and Stack
* Cabling
* IT Asset Management
* IMACD
* ITIL Processes



 Preferred Certifications
 



 The following certifications are desirable:
 


* ITIL Foundation / ITIL 4
* PMP
* PRINCE2
* ServiceNow certifications
* Cisco certifications
* Microsoft certifications



 Certifications are preferred but not mandatory where the candidate has strong relevant operational experience.
 



 Key Competencies
 


* Service Delivery Management
* Field Services Operations
* Customer Management
* SLA Management
* Escalation Management
* Resource Management
* Vendor Management
* Project Management
* ITSM
* Problem Solving
* Leadership
* Communication
* Reporting
* Commercial Awareness
* Stakeholder Management
* Continuous Improvement



 Performance Expectations
 



 The Service Delivery Manager will be measured against metrics including:
 


* **98%\+ SLA Achievement**
* Engineer fulfillment rate
* Response and resolution performance
* Project completion within schedule
* Customer satisfaction
* Engineer availability
* Reduction in escalations
* Ticket backlog reduction
* First\-time fix rate
* Engineer utilization
* Cost optimization
* Vendor performance
* Customer retention



 Ideal Candidate Profile
 



 The ideal candidate will have previously managed a large distributed Field Services operation involving multiple customers, locations, and engineering resources.
 



 The candidate should be comfortable managing both
 **planned projects and high\-volume reactive dispatch requirements** 
 and should be capable of handling critical customer escalations while maintaining strong governance across service operations.
 



 Experience working within a
 **Global IT Services Company, Managed Service Provider, System Integrator, Field Services Organization, Digital Workplace Services provider, or IT Infrastructure Services company** 
 would be highly preferred.
 



 About Teceze
 



 Teceze is a global IT services company delivering technology services across multiple countries. Our service capabilities include:
 


* Digital Workplace Services
* Field Services
* Smart Hands
* Cloud \& Infrastructure Services
* Data Center Services
* Cybersecurity Services
* Global Procurement Services
* IT Staff Augmentation



 The Service Delivery Manager – Field Services will play a key role in ensuring Teceze consistently delivers high\-quality, scalable, SLA\-driven services to customers across multiple geographies.

title: Engineering Manager - Electrical Design
description:
* Plan, execute, and oversee Electrical engineering design within budget, schedule, and scope.
* Coordinate with project stakeholders, including clients, contractors, and internal teams to ensure seamless execution.
* Review and approve electrical design drawings, layouts, and specifications, ensuring alignment with project requirements and client expectations.
* Ensure adherence to industry standards, codes, and client requirements (e.g., IEC, IEEE, NEC, BS, AS/NZS).
* Optimize electrical system layouts and routes to minimize cost, enhance performance, and reduce environmental impact.
* Perform electrical load analysis, short\-circuit studies, and protection coordination, collaborating with multidisciplinary teams to optimize system designs for safety, performance, and cost efficiency.
* Identify and resolve potential electrical system issues during the design phase or through field support during construction and operations.
* Review and approve electrical material specifications, equipment specifications, and material take\-off sheets.
* Review and approve the design of electrical installations for substations, distribution boards, and other electrical infrastructure according to project specifications and operational requirements.
* Lead and mentor a team of Electrical engineers, designers, and technical support staff, providing guidance.
* Foster collaboration across multi\-disciplinary teams, ensuring seamless communication and coordination between electrical engineering, design, construction, and other departments
* Ensure all electrical systems meet quality, safety, and environmental standards, aligning with project specifications and industry regulations.
* Conduct regular internal audits to identify potential issues and ensure all electrical designs and installations conform to quality and safety standards.
* If required, participate in vendor inspections, including factory acceptance tests (FAT), witness testing and quality checks to validate electrical equipment and system performance.
* Support in review inspection and test plans (ITPs/QAP) to ensure adherence to project and industry standards, ensuring compliance with applicable codes and client requirements.
* Oversee material selection during vendor engineering for electrical components, ensuring all materials meet project requirements and industry standards.
* Select appropriate electrical materials based on system requirements, operating conditions (voltage, current, load), and project specifications.
* Review and approve electrical component datasheets for transformers, circuit breakers, cables, switches, protective relays, and other electrical equipment.
* Support procurement teams in evaluating vendor proposals for electrical equipment and systems, ensuring compliance with technical specifications and performance criteria.
* Evaluate and approve supplier and contractor proposals and schedule adherence to ensure optimal selection of electrical systems and components.
* Review project progress, technical documents, and presentations to ensure effective communication and updates to stakeholders.
* Support the project team in maintaining accurate records of electrical designs, material certifications, test reports, and inspection documentation for compliance and traceability
* Drive innovation in electrical design and installation techniques, incorporating new technologies and best practices to enhance system efficiency and performance.
* Stay updated with the latest technologies, industry trends and regulatory changes to continuously improve design methodologies.

 Ready to make a difference?
   

  

 Apply now and help us build a zero\-carbon future.

 You are a senior professional with a strong track record of delivering complex, multidisciplinary projects and building trusted client relationships. You are comfortable leading teams, influencing delivery strategy, and contributing to business growth.
   

  

**Key Attributes**
* Degree in Engineering, or a related discipline

* Proven leadership of project teams and ability to develop others
* Strong client\-facing experience and ability to build long\-term relationships

 Your career at Cundall

title: Lead AI/ML Solutions
description:
**Job Summary**
* Lead people and provide end\-to\-end engineering accountability for governed agentic AI solutions, from discovery and architecture through delivery, production adoption, support and continuous improvement.
* Translate business, risk, compliance and regulatory needs into secure, scalable, reliable, observable and auditable AI/ML solution designs that deliver measurable business outcomes.
* Build reusable agentic AI engineering capabilities, including orchestration, tool calling, retrieval, memory, human\-in\-the\-loop controls, sandboxed execution, automated evaluation and AI\-assisted SDLC practices.


**Key Responsibilities**
 Lead a multidisciplinary engineering team and take end\-to\-end accountability for the strategy, architecture, delivery, governance, production adoption and continuous improvement of secure, governed and measurable agentic AI solutions.
   

  

* Set the engineering direction and translate business, risk, compliance and regulatory needs into scalable solution designs. Guide implementation of orchestration, tool calling, retrieval, memory, workflow automation, human\-in\-the\-loop controls, sandboxed execution and enterprise integrations, while ensuring security, reliability, resilience, observability, auditability and production readiness.
* Own execution from discovery through build, testing, release, adoption and support. Lead and develop engineers, establish standards for code quality, automated testing and evaluation, manage delivery and technology risks, embed responsible AI and control requirements, engage senior stakeholders, monitor operational and business outcomes, and build reusable patterns and AI\-assisted SDLC accelerators that improve quality, consistency and delivery speed.


**Engineering strategy and architecture**
* Define and execute the engineering strategy, technical direction, solution design principles and roadmap for governed agentic AI capabilities across the AI/ML delivery portfolio.
* Design and guide implementation of orchestration, tool calling, retrieval, memory, workflow automation, enterprise integration, human\-in\-the\-loop controls and sandboxed execution patterns.


**End\-to\-end delivery and business outcomes**
* Own delivery from intake and discovery through design, build, test, release, production adoption, support and continuous improvement, with clear accountability for scope, quality, timelines and value.
* Partner with business, product, risk, compliance and technology stakeholders to agree priorities, outcomes, dependencies, controls and adoption requirements.


**Engineering excellence and production readiness**
* Establish standards for code quality, design reviews, documentation, peer review, automated testing, prompt and model evaluation, release controls, traceability and evidence capture.
* Ensure production readiness across security, reliability, scalability, resilience, observability, telemetry, support, incident response, rollback and operational handover.


**Risk, responsible AI and governance**
* Own identification, assessment, mitigation and escalation of delivery, technology, security, data, model, operational and regulatory risks.
* Embed responsible AI, model risk, data protection, access control, approval, auditability and governance controls, and provide evidence\-based updates to decision forums.


**Continuous improvement and reusable capability**
* Monitor adoption, performance, evaluation results, control effectiveness, incidents and business outcomes, using evidence to drive remediation and product evolution.
* Create reusable engineering patterns, platforms and accelerators, including AI\-assisted SDLC practices that improve productivity, consistency and speed without compromising control.


**People and Talent (for People Leader roles only)**
* Set direction and drive high performance by translating strategy into clear direction, aligning individual goals to team outcomes and providing regular, constructive feedback.
* Develop talent and capability through coaching and career conversations that build critical skills, stretch potential and prepare individuals for future opportunities.
* Lead by example by role\-modelling the Bank’s valued behaviours, upholding strong risk and conduct standards, exercising sound judgment, and creating an inclusive team culture that supports wellbeing, values diverse perspectives, and drives accountability.
* Lead, manage and develop engineering teams by setting direction, clarifying priorities, allocating work, coaching engineers and creating a high\-accountability, collaborative delivery culture.
* Build capability through hiring, onboarding, mentoring, career development, knowledge sharing, cross\-skilling, succession planning and clear ownership of critical solutions.


**Motivations**
* Solving complex business, risk and regulatory problems through secure, governed and measurable AI engineering.
* Building high\-performing engineering teams and reusable capabilities that improve delivery quality, speed and consistency.
* Taking solutions from ambiguity and design through reliable production adoption, then improving them using operational evidence and business outcomes.


**Skills And Experience**
**Must\-have Skills**
* Agentic AI solution architecture and engineering design
* Engineering leadership, team development and delivery accountability
* Enterprise software engineering, platform integration and AI\-assisted SDLC


**Other Skills**
* Responsible AI, model risk, data protection and control governance
* Production readiness, observability, resilience and operational support
* Senior stakeholder management, architecture governance and decision facilitation
* AI/ML delivery lifecycle, evaluation and continuous improvement


**Qualifications**
**Key Experiences**
* 8\-12 years of relevant hands\-on experience, including engineering leadership and delivery of enterprise AI/ML or agentic AI solutions in regulated environments.


**Certifications / Qualifications**
* Master's degree with specialisation in Technology.


**Languages**
* English

title: Engineering Leader
description:
**About Us:**
 Barry\-Wehmiller is a diversified global supplier of engineering consulting and manufacturing technology for the packaging, corrugating, sheeting and paper\-converting industries. By blending people\-centric leadership with disciplined operational strategies and purpose\-driven growth, Barry\-Wehmiller has become a $3 billion organization with nearly 12,000 team members united by a common belief: to use the power of business to build a better world.
   

  

**Job Description:**
**Join Us. Build a Better World Through Business.**
 At Barry\-Wehmiller Companies, we believe business can be a powerful force for good. Headquartered in St. Louis, Missouri, we are a global leader in manufacturing technology and services. Since our founding in 1885 as a maker of brewing machinery, we’ve grown through the acquisition of more than 80 companies, serving industries such as packaging, paper converting, sheeting, corrugating, engineering, and IT consulting. In 2016, we ranked No. 10 on the
 *St. Louis Business Journal* 
 list of the city’s Top 150 Privately Held Companies.
   

  

 What truly sets us apart is our culture—rooted in Truly Human Leadership, a philosophy that prioritizes the well\-being and growth of every individual. We measure success by the way we touch lives, not just by financial results.
   

  

 In India, Barry\-Wehmiller operates as a hub of innovation and collaboration through our Global Competency Center (GCC) and other strategic functions. The GCC houses centers of excellence in engineering, content management, sourcing, software development, global IT operations, and shared financial services—providing critical support to Barry\-Wehmiller divisions worldwide.
   

  

 Our culture is built on:
   

  

* Ownership – Drive features end\-to\-end, from design to deployment.
* Flexibility – A friendly, results\-oriented environment that respects your time.
* Empowerment – Your ideas matter, and your work creates visible impact.
* Learning and Growth – Tackle complex challenges alongside passionate peers, with continuous support for your development.


**Career Development and Global Exposure**
 At Barry\-Wehmiller, your growth is our priority. You’ll have access to world\-class learning programs, leadership development opportunities, and mentorship from industry experts. Our global footprint means you’ll collaborate with teams across continents, gaining exposure to diverse markets, cutting\-edge technologies, and best practices from around the world. Whether you aspire to deepen your technical expertise or take on leadership roles, we provide the resources and support to help you thrive.
   

  

 If you’re ready to bring your best thinking to a high\-impact, future\-focused environment—where long\-term stability meets start\-up agility—and be part of a company that cares deeply about people, we’d love to hear from you.
   

  

**Position Summary**
 The Engineering Leader provides leadership oversight for the GCC Engineering flex pool, ensuring engineering resources are deployed effectively across multiple global divisions while maintaining the agreed scope, operating intent, and stakeholder commitments of the flex team model. Day\-to\-day technical challenge resolution, deliverable quality, and output management will be owned by front\-line leaders within the flex team.
   

  

 Reporting to the Director, GCC Engineering, the Flex Team Leader enables GCC scalability, cross\-platform collaboration, and shared\-services identity by establishing the right governance, cadence, role clarity, and stakeholder engagement mechanisms for the flex team.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Resource Allocation and Delivery
* Oversee flex pool deployment across platforms, ensuring the required Mechanical, Electrical, and Controls Engineering capacity is available and aligned to agreed priorities, while front\-line leaders manage day\-to\-day deliverable execution.
* Establish delivery governance through front\-line leaders who are accountable for technical issue resolution, quantity of work completed, quality of outputs, and timely escalation of risks or constraints.
* Bench strength ownership
* Drive a monthly demand\-planning cadence with platforms and partner with recruiting to sustain available capacity at all times through proactive team build\-out with efficient forecasting and demand planning.
* Partner with engineering leaders to plan the cohort size, composition and deployment to fulfil recruitment needs across the GCC engineering team.
* Stakeholder Engagement
* Partner with platform engineering leaders and internal front\-line leaders to anticipate flex resource demand, confirm scope and priorities, and provide weekly and monthly updates on capacity, commitments, delivery health, and stakeholder risks.
* Team Leadership and Capability Building
* Build organizational capability by developing front\-line leaders, enabling them to coach flex engineers, manage technical readiness, and ensure consistent execution against platform\-specific standards.
* Use a skills matrix to maintain visibility to team capability, coverage gaps, readiness levels, and deployment suitability across the flex team.
* Partner with Director, GCC Engineering and People team on recruitment, onboarding, and training.
* Governance and Reporting
* Own allocation governance, billing visibility, stakeholder commitment tracking, monthly reporting, heart count forecasts, and core flex team utilization metrics.
* Contribute to GCC dashboards (utilization, attrition, skills coverage, project allocation).
* Support continuous improvement and standardization of engineering processes by enabling governance, escalation discipline, and consistent execution practices through front\-line leaders.
* GCC Integration and Culture
* Role\-model GCC identity while ensuring fairness and transparency in cross\-platform assignments.
* Encourage knowledge\-sharing and collaboration across flex and dedicated teams.


**Technical and Operational Leader Capability**
* Seeking an experienced engineering leader with a strong understanding of mechanical engineering delivery and cross\-platform stakeholder management. The role requires sufficient technical breadth to engage credibly with platform leaders and front\-line technical leaders, while relying on designated front\-line leaders for detailed technical decisions and deliverable ownership.
* The ideal candidate will bring relevant industry experience, proven people leadership, governance discipline, and the ability to manage delivery commitments through front\-line leaders while maintaining clear visibility to execution health.
* Working knowledge of discrete machine design, engineering workflows, CAD\-based delivery environments, FEA concepts, and global engineering standards is preferred.
* Certifications such as PMP or Six Sigma Black Belt will be considered an advantage, reflecting structured governance, execution discipline, continuous improvement mindset, and the ability to drive predictable delivery through teams.
* Exposure to industrial machinery design, installation, commissioning, and practical engineering constraints is desirable to support informed stakeholder discussions and appropriate escalation management.
* Experience managing distributed teams, external partners, or shared\-service delivery models is important to ensure commitments, timelines, escalation paths, and stakeholder expectations are managed effectively.
* A key expectation from this role is to build confidence with BW group companies by ensuring the flex team model delivers reliably against agreed scope, quality expectations, communication cadences, and stakeholder commitments.
* The candidate should demonstrate a strong learning mindset and proven experience developing front\-line leaders who can manage technical depth, execution quality, team productivity, mentorship, and performance management within the flex team.


*At Barry\-Wehmiller we recognize that people come with a wealth of experience and talent beyond just the technical requirements of a job. If your experience is close to what you see listed here, please still consider applying. We know that our differences often can bring about innovation, excellence and meaningful work—therefore, people from all backgrounds are encouraged to apply to our positions. Please let us know if you require reasonable accommodations during the interview process.*
**Company:**
 Bw Corporate Gcc

title: Senior Network Manager
description:
Req ID: 139010
   

  

 Remote Position: Hybrid
   

  

 Region: Asia
   

  

 Country: India
   

  

 State/Province: Chennai
   

  

 City: Guindy, Chennai
   

  

**Summary**
 Manages a global department of resources focused on the design, delivery, support and optimization of Celestica's IT Global Network infrastructure. The Senior Manager, IT Infrastructure leverages their network of business and IT partners to plan and deliver strategic projects, enhancement work and baseline requests according to established service levels, budgets, and compliance standards. The Senior Manager, IT Infrastructure helps to determine and drive the IT operations framework and solution lifecycle, and has extensive hands\-on experience with infrastructure technologies. The Senior Manager, IT Infrastructure also creates and champions Celestica's service management culture rooted in continuous improvement, and is responsible for building organizational strength by leading change \& leveraging Celestica's HR processes.
   

  

 Detailed Description
   

  

 Performs tasks such as, but not limited to, the following:
   

  

* Promote business continuity as the primary focus of all plans, operations, and decisions.
* Strengthen the organization through strong leadership, people management, purposeful communication, and cultural enablement.
* Cultivate strong relationships and engage with senior business, functional, solution \& service partners to enable effective cross\-team collaboration, knowledge sharing, and problem solving.
* Lead and motivate a high\-performing team to design, build, and run IT solutions in accordance with established service levels.
* Engage and partner with business partners to create, communicate and deliver IT roadmaps that enable strategic business objectives.
* Drive IT operations to leverage standard IT processes to deliver solutions and services.


 Knowledge/Skills/Competencies
   

  

* Extensive experience in the design of local area, wide area networks and Cloud integration. Complexity of projects ranges from simple projects with minimal risks/ uncertainty to medium level projects with some high impact risks and multiple project variables with uncertainty. Excellent understanding of IP, MPLS, WAN, SDWAN, Wireless networking technologies. Experience with data centre design, security principles, computing infrastructure. Engaged by the unknowns of implementing emergent technologies and industry standards. Must be flexible with working hours, as there is a periodic requirement to work long hours in the field to commission installations. Experience with Cisco switches \& routers, Checkpoint NGFW, SDWAN technologies. Must have experience working in an enterprise Datacenter environment. Cloud migration \& deployment experience. Cisco certified with CCDP or CCIE certification is preferred. Strong experience building and maintaining VPN networks to support Remote user connectivity including integration into Multi\-factor authentication solutions. Must have the ability to communicate confidently and directly with executive stakeholders as well as end\-client technical teams. People leadership, coordinating/influencing skills Problem solving / strong analytics.
* Strong understanding of system architecture. Excellent ability to perform software and hardware evaluation and selection. Strong business writing skills. Excellent analytical, communication, presentation and problem resolution skills. Strong team leadership ability. Excellent project management skills. In\-depth knowledge of planning process and the maximization of IT resources.
* Ability to introduce change of infrastructure/application environment.


 Physical Demands
   

  

* Duties of this position are performed in a normal office environment.
* Duties may require extended periods of sitting and sustained visual concentration on a computer monitor or on numbers and other detailed data. Repetitive manual movements (e.g., data entry, using a computer mouse, using a calculator, etc.) are frequently required.


 Typical Experience
   

  

* 11 to 14 years of IT experience that shows consistent progression, and at least 5 years hands\-on technology and team leadership experience.


 Typical Education
   

  

* Bachelor's Degree or consideration of an equivalent combination of education and experience.
* Educational requirements may vary by geography.


 Notes
   

  

 This job description is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties and responsibilities of the position. Employees are held accountable for all duties of the job. Job duties and the % of time identified for any function are subject to change at any time.
   

  

 Celestica is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment and will not be discriminated against on any protected status (including race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran or disability status or other characteristics protected by law).
   

  

 At Celestica we are committed to fostering an inclusive, accessible environment, where all employees and customers feel valued, respected and supported. Special arrangements can be made for candidates who need it throughout the hiring process. Please indicate your needs and we will work with you to meet them.
   

  

**Company Overview**
 Celestica, Inc. (NYSE: CLS; TSX: CLS) is a technology leader dedicated to driving customer success and market advancements. With deep expertise in design, engineering, manufacturing, supply chain, and platform solutions, Celestica enables critical data center infrastructure for AI, cloud, and hybrid cloud and advances technologies in high\-growth markets. With a talented team and a strategic global network, Celestica helps its customers achieve competitive advantages.
   

  

 Today, Celestica delivers innovative supply chain solutions globally to customers in strategic two operating and reporting segments: Advanced Technology Solutions (ATS) and Connectivity and Cloud Solutions (CC):
   

  

**ATS:** 
 This segment serves customers in complex, regulated and high\-reliability markets such as Industrial \& Smart Energy, Aerospace \& Defense, Semiconductor Capital Equipment, and HealthTech. It is engineering led, with deep expertise in design, manufacturing and lifecycle solutions.
   

  

**CCS:** 
 This segment focuses on high\-performance technology solutions and services for the data center, serving hyperscalers, digital native customers and enterprises. Celestica's Platform Solutions offering provides innovative and customizable computing, storage and networking solutions enabling AI\-driven growth.
   

  

 Built on a legacy of trust and performance, Celestica has earned its reputation by delivering results in complex and fast\-changing markets. Celestica exceeds customer expectations by identifying trends and staying ahead of the curve. Backed by comprehensive capabilities and a global network across North America, Europe and Asia, Celestica helps customers gain competitive advantage with the quality, flexibility and resiliency they need to respond quickly to shifts in demand. Guided by a bold vision to accelerate market advancements, Celestica delivers innovative solutions and technologies that turn complexity into opportunity. Anchored in teamwork and commitment, Celestica strives to be the most trusted partner to its customers and colleagues worldwide.
   

  

 Celestica would like to thank all applicants, however, only qualified applicants will be contacted.
   

  

 Celestica does not accept unsolicited resumes from recruitment agencies or fee based recruitment services.

title: Principal Mechanical Engineer
description:
**Job Overview**
**JOB DESCRIPTION**
 The Principal Mechanical Engineer is responsible for interpreting internal or external business issues and recommending best practices. They will be tasked with solving complex Mechanical Engineering\-related problems and will work independently with minimal guidance. The Principal Mechanical Engineer may be responsible for leading functional teams or projects and is regarded as a specialist in Mechanical Engineering. As such, they must have in\-depth expertise as well as broad knowledge of the Mechanical discipline within the Engineering function.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
**Key Tasks and Responsibilities**

* Apply in\-depth skills and broad knowledge of the business to address complex problems and nonstandard situations

* Clearly communicate and explain difficult concepts and persuade others to adopt a point of view

* Become fully familiar with the project scope of work, specifications, schedule, and all inter\-discipline requirements, including identifying concerns as early as practicable and taking appropriate initiatives to address the issues
