* Identify changes to scope and promptly raise change notifications, including providing any necessary supporting documentation and estimates
* Provide similar support for Variation Orders
* Interface with all disciplines to develop clash\-free designs

* Maintain close coordination with other engineering disciplines, Planning, and Project Management Team, as required

* Prepare estimates for bid proposals, including technical query reviews, execution statements, and manhour estimates, identifying software requirements and any other project\-specific requirements

* Review project schedule and fabrication schedule in relation to construction sequence, milestones, and engineering scope
* Attend project kickoff and review meetings, vendor meetings, engineering meetings, and site surveys, as required

* Assist procurement personnel in procuring Discipline equipment, materials, and services, ensuring that work produced complies with Customer objectives and procedures

* Assist in updating weight report based on receipt of vendor information
* Review and (as Lead Engineer) approve vendor and subcontractor submittals, checking for compliance with project specifications and providing comments as necessary
* Review and (as Lead Engineer) approve design verification through single\-discipline check/ inter­ discipline check (IDC)
* Provide technical support to fabrication queries
* Keep the Discipline Manager and Project Management Team apprised of all activities and concerns, technical, budgetary, and workforce\-related
* Assist in providing inputs for actual, planning, and forecasting progress reports, including associated productivity

title: Service Delivery Coordinator, Field Services
description:
Job Description – Service Delivery Coordinator, Field Services
 



**Company:** 
 Teceze
 



**Position:** 
 Service Delivery Coordinator – Field Services
 



**Department:** 
 Service Delivery / Operations
 



**Employment Type:** 
 Full\-Time
 



**Reporting To:** 
 Service Delivery Manager / Field Services Manager
 



 Role Overview
 



 Teceze is looking for a highly organized and proactive
 **Service Delivery Coordinator – Field Services** 
 to support the day\-to\-day delivery of onsite IT support and field services projects across multiple customer locations.
 



 The Service Delivery Coordinator will act as the operational coordination point between customers, Field Engineers, Service Delivery Managers, recruitment teams, vendors, and internal support functions.
 



 The role will be responsible for coordinating engineer assignments, managing dispatch tickets, tracking SLA performance, following up on open activities, maintaining service documentation, and ensuring that customer requests are completed on time and in accordance with agreed service levels.
 



 The ideal candidate should have experience supporting
 **Field IT Services, Deskside Support, Smart Hands, Network Support, Data Center Support, IMACD, Break/Fix, Rollouts, and Project\-Based IT Deployments** 
 .
 



 Key Responsibilities
 



 Field Services Coordination
 


* Coordinate day\-to\-day Field Services activities across assigned customer accounts and locations.
* Receive and review service requests, tickets, work orders, and project requirements.
* Identify appropriate engineers based on location, technical skills, availability, and customer requirements.
* Assign engineers to tickets and projects within agreed SLA timelines.
* Maintain constant communication with assigned engineers from dispatch through completion.
* Ensure engineers receive complete job information before visiting customer sites.
* Coordinate planned and reactive Field Services activities.
* Ensure all service requests are properly tracked from creation through closure.



 Dispatch Management
 



 Manage the complete dispatch lifecycle including:
 


* Ticket receipt
* Requirement validation
* Engineer identification
* Engineer availability confirmation
* Engineer assignment
* ETA confirmation
* Customer communication
* Site arrival confirmation
* Work progress tracking
* Job completion confirmation
* Service report collection
* Ticket closure



 The SDC should ensure that no ticket is left unattended and that all delays are identified and escalated proactively.
 



 Engineer Scheduling \& Coordination
 


* Schedule Field Engineers according to customer requirements.
* Confirm engineer availability before assignment.
* Maintain engineer calendars and schedules.
* Coordinate multiple jobs across different customer locations.
* Avoid scheduling conflicts and missed appointments.
* Arrange backup engineers where required.
* Coordinate emergency and out\-of\-hours support requests.
* Track engineer attendance and site arrival.
* Maintain up\-to\-date engineer contact and availability information.



 Engineer Categories
 



 The SDC will coordinate engineers supporting areas such as:
 


* Desktop Support
* Deskside Support
* Field IT Support
* Smart Hands
* Remote Hands
* Network Support
* Data Center Support
* IT Infrastructure Support
* Hardware Support
* IMAC / IMACD
* Break/Fix
* POS Support
* Printer Support
* EUC Support
* Deployment and Rollout Engineers



 SLA Management
 


* Monitor all tickets against agreed SLA requirements.
* Track response time, acceptance time, engineer arrival, resolution time, and closure.
* Identify tickets at risk of SLA breach.
* Follow up continuously with engineers on priority tickets.
* Escalate SLA risks to the Service Delivery Manager.
* Maintain SLA trackers and operational dashboards.
* Support the Service Delivery Manager in maintaining a target of
 **98% or higher SLA compliance** 
 , subject to customer agreements.



 Ticket Management
 



 The SDC will be responsible for:
 


* Reviewing newly assigned tickets.
* Validating ticket information.
* Assigning resources.
* Updating ticket status.
* Following up on open tickets.
* Tracking pending customer dependencies.
* Monitoring aging tickets.
* Escalating delayed tickets.
* Collecting completion evidence.
* Ensuring engineer notes are complete.
* Supporting timely ticket closure.



 ITSM Tools
 



 The candidate should have experience using or supporting ticketing platforms such as:
 


* ServiceNow
* Jira Service Management
* Remedy
* ManageEngine
* Freshservice
* Zendesk
* Other enterprise ITSM platforms



 Customer Communication
 


* Provide regular ticket and project updates to customers.
* Confirm engineer schedules and ETA.
* Inform customers of delays or changes.
* Coordinate customer site access.
* Communicate engineer details where required.
* Follow up on pending approvals or access requests.
* Support Service Delivery Managers during customer service reviews.
* Maintain professional communication with customer stakeholders.



 Project Coordination
 



 Support Field Services projects including:
 


* Desktop refresh
* Device rollout
* Hardware deployment
* Office relocation
* Network rollout
* Wi\-Fi deployment
* Router and switch replacement
* Data center migration
* Rack and stack
* Cabling
* Site surveys
* POS deployments
* Infrastructure upgrades
* End\-user migrations
* Branch rollouts



 Responsibilities include:
 


* Engineer scheduling
* Site planning
* Activity tracking
* Progress monitoring
* Status reporting
* Documentation tracking
* Issue escalation
* Completion confirmation



 Smart Hands \& Data Center Coordination
 



 Coordinate engineers for tasks including:
 


* Rack and stack
* Server installation
* Switch installation
* Router replacement
* Storage equipment support
* Cable installation
* Cable tracing
* Device reboot
* Hardware replacement
* Equipment relocation
* Patch panel work
* Visual inspection
* Remote technical assistance



 Ensure engineers have appropriate instructions, tools, access, and technical support.
 



 Network Field Services Coordination
 



 Coordinate activities involving:
 


* Routers
* Switches
* Wireless Access Points
* Firewalls
* Cabling
* LAN/WAN
* Cisco
* Aruba
* Network device replacement
* Hardware installation
* Troubleshooting



 The SDC is not expected to be a network engineer but should understand basic IT infrastructure terminology to coordinate resources effectively.
 



 Resource \& Capacity Planning
 


* Maintain visibility of available engineers by location.
* Track primary and backup engineers.
* Identify coverage gaps.
* Inform recruitment teams of areas requiring additional resources.
* Maintain engineer skill matrices.
* Support onboarding of new engineers.
* Coordinate resource requirements for upcoming projects.
* Build engineer coverage for high\-priority customer sites.



 Recruitment Coordination
 



 Work closely with recruitment and sourcing teams to:
 


* Share urgent Field Engineer requirements.
* Provide location and technical requirements.
* Support candidate validation.
* Coordinate technical interviews where required.
* Support onboarding and deployment.
* Identify recurring skill and coverage gaps.



 Engineer Onboarding
 



 Coordinate onboarding requirements such as:
 


* Customer documentation
* Background checks
* NDA completion
* Site access
* Security requirements
* ID verification
* Engineer profile submission
* Technical documentation
* Tools and equipment
* Customer\-specific training



 Ensure engineers are ready before deployment.
 



 Vendor \& Partner Coordination
 


* Coordinate with third\-party Field Service partners and subcontractors.
* Obtain engineer availability from partners.
* Confirm assignments and schedules.
* Follow up on completion.
* Track vendor SLA performance.
* Collect completion reports.
* Escalate vendor\-related delays.



 Escalation Management
 


* Identify operational issues before they become customer escalations.
* Escalate SLA risks to the Service Delivery Manager.
* Support critical incident coordination.
* Maintain escalation trackers.
* Follow up until issues are resolved.
* Ensure customers receive regular status updates.



 Reporting \& Governance
 



 Prepare and maintain reports including:
 


* Daily ticket status
* Open ticket report
* Aging ticket report
* Engineer assignment tracker
* SLA performance
* Engineer availability
* Engineer attendance
* Project progress
* Pending actions
* Escalation tracker
* Customer issue tracker
* Site coverage report



 Support preparation of weekly and monthly service review reports.
 



 Service Documentation
 



 Maintain accurate records including:
 


* Engineer details
* Site information
* Contact details
* SOPs
* Work instructions
* Escalation matrices
* Customer\-specific procedures
* Engineer schedules
* Dispatch records
* Service reports
* Project trackers
* Completion documents



 Service Quality
 


* Ensure engineers submit accurate service reports.
* Verify completion evidence where required.
* Ensure customer sign\-off is obtained.
* Track repeat complaints.
* Report recurring quality issues.
* Support corrective action plans.
* Ensure engineers follow customer\-specific processes.



 Asset \& Logistics Coordination
 



 Where required, coordinate:
 


* Device shipment
* Spare parts
* Replacement hardware
* Engineer toolkits
* Equipment delivery
* Equipment collection
* Return merchandise
* Asset movement



 Work closely with procurement, logistics, and service delivery teams.
 



 Operational Performance
 



 The SDC will be measured against KPIs such as:
 


* Ticket assignment within SLA
* Engineer response time
* Engineer arrival performance
* SLA compliance
* Ticket closure time
* Ticket backlog
* Aging ticket reduction
* Engineer attendance
* Dispatch success rate
* Project completion
* Customer escalations
* Accuracy of reporting



 Required Experience
 


* **2–5 years of experience** 
 in Service Delivery Coordination, Field Services, IT Operations, IT Support Coordination, or Managed Services.
* Experience coordinating engineers across multiple customer locations.
* Good understanding of IT support environments.
* Experience managing service tickets.
* Familiarity with ITSM tools.
* Experience working in an SLA\-driven environment.
* Strong coordination and follow\-up skills.
* Ability to manage multiple activities simultaneously.
* Good written and verbal communication skills.
* Strong Excel and reporting capabilities.



 Technical Understanding
 



 The candidate should have basic understanding of:
 


* Desktop Support
* Deskside Support
* Windows
* Microsoft 365
* Active Directory
* Networking
* Routers
* Switches
* Wireless
* Servers
* Data Centers
* Rack and Stack
* Smart Hands
* Cabling
* Hardware Support
* IMACD
* IT Asset Management
* Incident Management
* Service Request Management

title: SAP BDC-DSP-Manager
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

**Technology Consulting \- Manager:**
 At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
   

  

 We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
   

  

 Join EY and help to build a better working world.
   

  

**About Global Delivery Services**
 Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.
   

  

 Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000\+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.
   

  

 Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy \& Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high\-quality, value\-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.
   

  

 Enablement Services provides cost\-effective, high\-skilled, and innovative services to support EY’s global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.
   

  

 Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
   

  

**The Opportunity**
 Join our SAP BI \& Analytics practice as an SAP Business Data Cloud (BDC) Manager and lead the delivery of enterprise\-scale data transformation initiatives. You will be responsible for driving solution strategy, managing teams, engaging with senior business stakeholders, and delivering innovative analytics and data platform solutions leveraging SAP Business Data Cloud, SAP Datasphere, SAP Analytics Cloud (SAC), SAP BW/4HANA, and SAP S/4HANA. This role offers the opportunity to shape clients' data modernization journeys and help them realize business value through data\-driven decision\-making.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
* Lead end\-to\-end delivery of SAP Business Data Cloud and analytics transformation programs.
* Define data architecture, solution roadmaps, and implementation strategies aligned with business objectives.
* Manage client relationships and serve as a trusted advisor to business and technology stakeholders.
* Lead workshops to gather business requirements and translate them into scalable SAP data and analytics solutions.
* Oversee the design and implementation of data models, semantic layers, reporting, and planning solutions.
* Drive integration of SAP and non\-SAP data sources into the enterprise analytics landscape.
* Ensure adherence to data governance, security, compliance, and quality standards.
* Manage project planning, resource allocation, budgets, risks, and delivery milestones.
* Mentor and develop consultants, senior consultants, and team leads.
* Support business development activities, proposal creation, solution estimations, and pre\-sales engagements.
* Identify opportunities for innovation and continuous improvement within client environments.
* Collaborate with global teams to deliver complex transformation programs.


**Skills And Attributes For Success**
* Strong experience with minimum 3 end to end implementations in SAP Business Data Cloud, SAP Datasphere, SAP Analytics Cloud (SAC), SAP BW/4HANA, and SAP HANA.
* Deep understanding of enterprise data warehousing, data modelling, data integration, and analytics architectures.
* Experience designing and implementing cloud\-based analytics and reporting solutions.
* Proven leadership experience managing cross\-functional and geographically distributed teams.
* Strong stakeholder and executive management skills.
* Experience leading large\-scale SAP transformation programs.
* Strong consulting, problem\-solving, and decision\-making capabilities.
* Knowledge of data governance, master data management, and data quality frameworks.
* Excellent communication, presentation, and relationship\-building skills.
* Ability to balance strategic thinking with hands\-on delivery oversight.


**\<\< Ideally, you’ll also\>\>**
* SAP certifications in Business Data Cloud, Datasphere, BW/4HANA, SAC, or SAP HANA.
* Experience with cloud platforms such as Microsoft Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud.
* Experience with SAP Data Intelligence, SAP Integration Suite, and modern data integration technologies.
* Knowledge of AI/ML\-enabled analytics and data products.
* Experience delivering Finance, Supply Chain, Procurement, Sales, or Manufacturing analytics solutions.
* Exposure to enterprise data platform modernization and migration programs.


**\<\< What we look for\>\>**
 We are looking for motivated professionals who are passionate about data, analytics, and digital transformation. The ideal candidate demonstrates strong technical expertise, a continuous learning mindset, excellent communication skills, and the ability to work collaboratively with diverse teams to deliver business value through innovative SAP data and analytics solutions. They should be proactive, adaptable, and committed to delivering high\-quality results in a fast\-paced consulting environment.

**Role Summary**
 We are looking for an AI Data Protection Forward Deployed Engineer – Manager to act as the technical owner for client\-facing data protection transformations that sit at the intersection of enterprise platforms, cybersecurity controls, and AI tools. That aligns closely with external FDE market patterns focused on customer\-embedded technical ownership and end\-to\-end production deployment.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Lead the discovery, architecture, and deployment of AI\-enabled data protection solutions for strategic clients, translating business, privacy, and cybersecurity requirements into scalable technical designs.
* Serve as a forward deployed technical leader, embedding with client stakeholders to break down ambiguous problem statements, make architecture decisions, and drive measurable outcomes in production. External FDE role definitions from EY, Databricks, Palantir, and Deloitte all emphasize this embedded technical ownership model.
* Architect integrations across data protection platforms, AI models, copilots, RAG pipelines, enterprise data estates, and downstream security/policy controls.
* Lead engineering teams through build, integration, testing, troubleshooting, go\-live, and post\-deployment hardening while maintaining delivery quality, client confidence, and practical execution pace.
* Shape pursuit solutions through demonstrations, solution architecture, proofs of concept, effort estimates, and technical proposals. This is explicitly called out in external FDE manager patterns.
* Build reusable methods, accelerators, reference architectures, and runbooks that strengthen the firm’s AI data protection offerings and improve repeatability across sectors and accounts.

**Required Qualifications**
* 8–12 years of experience across data protection, cybersecurity engineering, security architecture, privacy engineering, cloud security, or related fields.
* Strong depth in data protection, data discovery/classification, PKI \& KMS, and information rights management.
* Strong working knowledge of ML, deep learning, NLP, RAG, AI\-assisted prioritization, and model risk scoring, with experience applying these to enterprise problem\-solving.

The role combines genuine technical depth with delivery rigour — every activity executed safely, on time and with zero customer impact. This is a hands\-on role. The TPM reports to the practice Delivery Manager and is the primary execution owner beneath that layer. Key Responsibilities 1\. End\-to\-End Delivery Ownership
* Own complete execution of assigned work packages from planning through successful completion.
* Ensure every intervention is delivered safely, within schedule and in compliance with customer standards.
* Drive timely closure of all deliverables while proactively managing risks and dependencies.
* Take accountability for delivery outcomes rather than simply tracking activities.
* Provide the Delivery Manager with accurate, early and unfiltered status — no surprises.
* Allocate work packages to engineers based on competency, certifications and experience.
* Ensure the right engineer is assigned to the right task, with verified readiness.
* Monitor work package progress, remove execution blockers and maintain delivery governance.
* Ensure ownership across the entire lifecycle of each assigned activity.
* Work closely with customer project managers, planners and technical leads.
* Ensure LNI execution aligns with project timelines, milestones and deployment priorities.
* Represent the execution team during customer governance meetings.
* Build customer confidence through proactive communication and predictable delivery.
* Maintain genuine working command of the practice domain — not oversight from a distance.
* Provide technical guidance during planning, execution, rollback and issue resolution.
* Review implementation approaches, Method of Procedure (MoP), rollback plans and risk assessments; approve before execution.
* Lead technical discussions during complex interventions and critical incidents, and drive root cause analysis personally.
* Coach engineers on best practices and promote continuous technical improvement.
* Execute against the practice delivery framework — MoP templates, checklists, readiness criteria and acceptance standards — and drive full team adoption.
* Eliminate ad\-hoc, engineer\-specific ways of working; make execution repeatable regardless of who performs it.
* Convert every lesson learned into an updated standard, checklist or preventive control.
* Feed practice\-level gaps and improvement proposals back to the Delivery Manager for framework updates.
* Identify repetitive, manual and error\-prone steps within the execution lifecycle and propose automation candidates.
* Drive automation of health checks, pre/post validation, configuration and reporting activities within the team.
* Set and track efficiency targets — effort per work package, cycle time, first\-time\-right percentage.
* Reuse assets from the BU automation repository rather than rebuilding, and contribute back what the team creates.
* Stay current with technology and tooling direction in the practice domain and bring it into execution practice.
* Propose improvements to delivery approach rather than only executing the defined method.
* Document and share knowledge — playbooks, execution guides, incident learnings — across the wider practice.
* Contribute technical input to solutioning, estimation and proposal work when required.
* Build a culture of ownership, accountability and collaboration.
* Conduct regular 1:1s to understand workload, aspirations and challenges.
* Balance shift planning, resource utilisation and fatigue management for 24x7 operations.
* Support hiring, onboarding, mentoring and capability development.
* Set direction the team believes in — connect day\-to\-day execution to the wider account and customer outcome.
* Foster a positive, high\-performance environment where engineers raise problems early and propose improvements without being asked.
* Recognise individual and team achievement visibly; address underperformance directly and fairly.
* Encourage continuous learning, certification and knowledge sharing.
* Create development plans for engineers to grow into future technical leaders and build a succession bench.
* Ensure every deliverable meets customer quality expectations before submission.
* Drive first\-time\-right execution and eliminate repeat issues.
* Perform quality reviews of documentation, implementation plans and execution reports.
* Promote continuous improvement through lessons learned and preventive actions.
* Right engineer for the right task, with validated competency.
* Pre\-LNI readiness verification.
* MoP and rollback validation.
* Network health validation before execution.
* Executor\-Observer compliance.
* Weekly engineer engagement and mentoring.
* Shift and fatigue governance.
* Information Security compliance.
* End\-to\-end ownership of every LNI.

**Compliance \& People**

 On\-Time Delivery (OTD) First Time Right (FTR)

 Zero Customer Escalations Team Utilisation \& Productivity

 Manual effort automated / standard adoption Employee Engagement and Team Retention

 \* Comfortable working in a lean organisation where priorities evolve and individual ownership matters more than hierarchy.
 



  





**The Persona We’re Looking For** 




  





 We need someone who can move comfortably between a client executive meeting and an internal delivery discussion, understand the business and technical implications of a decision, and take responsibility for getting things done.

description:
**WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands.**
**We unite cutting\-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world\-class creativity, next\-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth.**
**We work with the world's most valuable brands and have global reach across 100\+ markets, with deep local expertise.**
**Our people are the key to our success. We're committed to fostering a culture of creativity, belonging and continuous learning, attracting and developing the brightest talent, and providing exciting career opportunities that help our people grow.**
**For more information, visit WPP.com.**
**Why we're hiring:**
 WPP is accelerating the adoption of AI across the enterprise, investing in a portfolio of strategic initiatives designed to transform how work gets done across our global business.
   

  

 Within Enterprise Technology, we're enabling this transformation by building the platforms, capabilities and operating models that will power the next generation of work. From Microsoft Copilot and intelligent automation to emerging AI technologies and agentic workflows, we're embedding AI into the fabric of how WPP operates globally.
   

  

 We're looking for a Project Analyst (Value \& Delivery) to join our Enterprise AI team, helping turn data, insight and experimentation into meaningful business outcomes.
   

  

 This is a unique role that sits at the intersection of technology, data and business value. You'll own the licence, utilisation and adoption data that underpins executive decision\-making, while also helping shape WPP's understanding of emerging AI capabilities through hands\-on testing, analysis and prototyping.
   

  

 We're looking for someone who is equally comfortable reconciling large, complex datasets as they are exploring a new AI feature, building a proof of concept or translating a business challenge into a practical solution. If you're naturally curious, analytical and passionate about identifying the real\-world value of technology, this role offers the opportunity to work at the forefront of AI adoption in one of the world's largest marketing and communications companies.
   

  

**What You'll Be Doing**
* Own and maintain licence, adoption and utilisation datasets across Microsoft 365, HR and tenant data sources, ensuring information is accurate, reconciled and audit\-ready.
* Build and automate reporting and analysis processes using tools such as Viva Insights, Power BI, Power Query and Microsoft 365 data sources.
* Support the measurement of AI adoption and value, helping develop the evidence base behind business outcomes and benefits reporting.
* Maintain licence, cost and funding models, providing insight that informs investment and adoption decisions.
* Design and build automations, prototypes and proof\-of\-concepts using tools including Python, Power Automate, Copilot Studio, Dataverse and Microsoft Graph.
* Partner with stakeholders across the business to understand challenges, identify opportunities and demonstrate practical AI\-enabled solutions.
* Evaluate newly released AI products and capabilities, turning technical developments into clear recommendations and actionable insights for WPP.
* Support the operation of the WPP Frontier Lab, helping assess, test and prioritise emerging technologies.
* Execute pilots and user testing activities, capturing evidence, documenting findings and validating outcomes before recommendations are made.
* Contribute to executive reporting by turning complex data into clear, credible and decision\-ready insights.


**What We're Looking For**
* Experience working with large, complex datasets from multiple sources and transforming them into accurate, trusted insights.
* Strong analytical skills with excellent attention to detail and a disciplined approach to data quality.
* Advanced Excel capability and experience working with reporting, analytics or business intelligence tools.
* A natural curiosity about AI, technology and emerging products, combined with the ability to assess their practical business value.
* Experience building automations, workflows, reports, prototypes or proof\-of\-concepts using modern technology platforms.
* Strong problem\-solving skills and the ability to frame solutions around business needs rather than technical features.
* Comfortable engaging with stakeholders at different levels, from operational teams to senior decision\-makers.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain complex concepts clearly and concisely.
* A proactive, self\-directed approach and enthusiasm for learning new tools and technologies.


**Nice to have**
* Experience with Microsoft Copilot, Viva Insights or Microsoft 365 adoption and analytics.
* Exposure to Power BI, Power Platform, Dataverse or Microsoft Graph.
* Knowledge of Python or other scripting and automation tools.
* Microsoft AZ\-900, DP\-900 or equivalent cloud and data certifications.
* Experience supporting digital transformation, adoption, analytics or business change programmes.


**Who you are:**
**You're open
 *:***
 we are inclusive and collaborative; we encourage the free exchange of ideas; we respect and celebrate diverse views. We are open\-minded: to new ideas, new partnerships, new ways of working.
   

  

**You're optimistic
 *:***
 we approach all that we do with confidence: to try the new and to seek the unexpected.
   

  

**You're extraordinary:** 
 We are stronger together: through collaboration we achieve the amazing. We are creative leaders and pioneers of our industry; we provide extraordinary every day.
   

  

**What we'll give you:**
**Passionate, inspired people** 
 – we champion a culture of people that do extraordinary work
   

  

**Scale and opportunity** 
 – we offer the opportunity to create, influence and deliver projects at a scale that is unparalleled in the industry.
   

  

**Challenging and stimulating work** 
 – unique work and the opportunity to join a group of creative problem solvers.
   

  

**We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection. That's why we’ve adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office around four days a week. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process.**
**WPP is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to particular characteristics. We are committed to fostering a culture of respect in which everyone feels they belong and has the same opportunities to progress in their careers.**
**Please read our Privacy Notice (https://www.wpp.com/en/careers/wpp\-privacy\-policy\-for\-recruitment) for more information on how we process the information you provide.**

title: BPE - Professional
description:
**Vestas is the world leader in wind technology and a driving\-force in the development of the wind power industry. Vestas’ core business comprises the development, manufacture, sale, marketing, and maintenance of Wind Turbines. Come and join us at Vestas!**
**Region APC \> Service APC \> Operating Model \& Process Improvement APAC**
 We are seeking a highly analytical and service\-oriented Business Process expert \-professional to support service operations across the APAC region. The role is responsible for enterprise system administration, business reporting, data governance, user support, and process optimization. Working across platforms such as Salesforce, SAP, Power BI, ServiceNow, SharePoint, and Microsoft 365, this position plays a critical role in ensuring data integrity, operational efficiency, and effective business decision\-making
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Administer and support Salesforce, SAP, ServiceNow, and other business applications, including user access, master data, and system configurations
* Develop and maintain operational dashboards, reports, and data analytics solutions using Salesforce, Power BI, Excel, and related tools
* Ensure data integrity, system performance, and seamless integration across enterprise platforms while resolving user and system issues
* Manage master data, reporting structures, and operational datasets to support business and regional reporting requirements
* Create and maintain documentation, governance standards, and training materials to support effective system usage and compliance
* Collaborate with stakeholders to drive process improvements, reporting enhancements, and operational excellence initiatives


**Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree in information systems, Business Administration, Computer Science, or a related field
* 3\+ years of experience in business systems administration, reporting, data management, or operational support
* Hands\-on experience with Salesforce and Power BI mandatory and preferable experience in SAP, , SharePoint, ServiceNow, and Microsoft 365 applications
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, troubleshooting, and communication skills
* Preferably Salesforce Administrator Certification (ADM\-201\)
* Experience supporting enterprise business applications, data integration, reporting automation, and service operations environments


**Competencies**
* Business Systems Administration
* Salesforce \& SAP Expertise
* Power BI Dashboard Development
* Data Governance \& Master Data Management
* System Integration \& Troubleshooting
* Stakeholder Management
* Communication \& Collaboration


**What We Offer**
* Opportunity to work within a global renewable energy organization
* Exposure to enterprise business systems and operational processes
* Collaborative and inclusive team environment
* Professional development and continuous learning opportunities
* Flexible work arrangements and a strong focus on employee well\-being
* Meaningful contribution to operational excellence and business transformation initiatives


**Additional Information**
 Your primary location will be in Chennai, India Please note: We do amend or withdraw our jobs and reserve the right to do so at any time, including prior to the advertised closing date. Please be advised to apply on or before 14th Oct 2026
   

  

 Learn more about Vestas at www.vestas.com and follow us on our social media channels.
   

  

**Our commitment to a fair hiring.**
 At Vestas, we evaluate all candidates solely based on their professional experience, education, and relevant skills. To support a fair recruitment process, we kindly ask that you remove any photos, dates of birth or graduation, gender pronouns, marital status, or other personal information not relevant to the role before submitting your CV/resume. Your CV/resume should focus on your professional and educational background, along with the necessary contact details (email and phone number). We train our hiring teams in inclusive evaluation and regularly review process outcomes to ensure fairness.
   

  

**DEIB Statement**
 At Vestas, we recognize the value of diversity, equity, and inclusion in driving innovation and success. We strongly encourage individuals from all backgrounds to apply, particularly those who may hesitate due to their identity or feel they do not meet every criterion. As our CEO states, "Expertise and talent come in many forms, and a diverse workforce enhances our ability to think differently and solve the complex challenges of our industry". Your unique perspective is what will help us powering the solution for a sustainable, green energy future.
   

  

**BEWARE – RECRUITMENT FRAUD**
 It has come to our attention that there are a number of fraudulent emails from people pretending to work for Vestas. Read more via this link, https://www.vestas.com/en/careers/our\-recruitment\-process
   

  

**About Vestas**
 Vestas is the energy industry’s global partner on sustainable energy solutions. We are specialised in designing, manufacturing, installing, and servicing wind turbines, both onshore and offshore.
   

  

 Across the globe, we have installed more wind power than anyone else. We consider ourselves pioneers within the industry, as we continuously aim to design new solutions and technologies to create a more sustainable future for all of us. With more than 200 GW of wind power installed worldwide and 40\+ years of experience in wind energy, we have an unmatched track record demonstrating our expertise within the field.
   

  

 With 39,000 employees globally, we are a diverse team united by a common goal: to power the solution – today, tomorrow, and far into the future.
   

  

 Vestas promotes a diverse workforce which embraces all social identities and is free of any discrimination. We commit to create and sustain an environment that acknowledges and harvests different experiences, skills, and perspectives. We also aim to give everyone equal access to opportunity.
   

  

 To learn more about our company and life at Vestas, we invite you to visit our website at www.vestas.com and follow us on our social media channels. We also encourage you to join our Talent Universe to receive notifications on new and relevant postings.

title: Principal Construction Support Engineer
description:
**Job Overview**
**JOB DESCRIPTION**
 The Principal Construction Support Engineer is responsible for interpreting internal or external business issues and recommending best practices They will be tasked with solving complex Construction Support (Eng) \-related problems and will work independently with minimal guidance The Principal Construction Support Engineer may be responsible for leading functional teams or projects and is regarded as a specialist in Construction Support (Eng) As such, they must have in\-depth expertise in Construction Support (Eng) as well as broad knowledge of the Construction Support (Eng) discipline within the Engineering function.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
**Key Tasks and Responsibilities**
* Perform conceptual, FEED, and detailed analyses and design as per design basis, project specifications, design codes, and standards
* Apply in\-depth skills and broad knowledge of the business to address complex problems and nonstandard situations
* Prepare clear and accurate detailed design calculations and analyses including design reports and procedures
* Manage own time to meet objectives and (as Lead Engineer) forecast and plan resource requirements
* Clearly communicate and explain difficult concepts and persuade others to adopt a point of view
* When acting as Lead Engineer, in addition:
+ Direct an Engineering team as a Lead Engineer
+ Lead the Discipline engineering design of the assigned work area and complete it within the planned schedule and budget, in accordance with standards, MDR, and project\-specific procedures and to a high professional standard
+ Plan, organize, and direct all aspects of Discipline execution on the assigned project including scope, deliverables, schedule, and all manpower resources \- agree allocations with the Discipline Manager
+ Ensure interfaces and deliverables are clearly identified
+ Maintain responsibility for progress and productivity, identifying any required corrective action
+ Act as project representative for Discipline during meetings with the Project Team, Customer discipline lead, and relevant agencies such as certifying authorities, auditors, third parties, etc

* Become fully familiar with the project scope of work, specifications, schedule, and all inter\-discipline requirements; including identifying concerns as early as practicable and taking appropriate initiatives to address issues, interpreting contractual requirements as they relate to engineering execution
* Identify changes to scope and promptly raise change notifications, including providing any necessary supporting documentation and estimates Provide similar support for variation orders
* Interface with all disciplines to develop clash\-free designs
* Interface with other departments to obtain input for discipline designs and drawings
* Maintain close coordination with other engineering disciplines, Planning, fabrication, Marine, and Project Management Teams, as required
* Document substantive communications (communications that result in significant decisions or assignment of actions) and forward copies to the Discipline Lead Engineer and Discipline Manager
* Prepare estimates for bid proposals, including technical query reviews, execution statements, and manhour estimates, identifying software requirements and any other project\-specific requirements
* Raise technical queries to obtain missing information, clarify work scope, and maintain preferred McDermott procedures, specifications, standards, practices, and operational requirements
* Prepare, review, and (as Lead Engineer) approve engineering design basis, philosophies, and technical specifications
* Participate in finalizing deliverable lists and deliverables, ensuring compliance with specifications and functional integrity
* Review project schedule and fabrication schedule about construction sequence, milestones, and engineering scope
* Attend project kickoff and review meetings, vendor meetings, engineering meetings, and offshore site surveys, as required
* Provide technical direction and review of Designers producing products related to Construction Support Engineering
* Prepare, review, and (as Lead Engineer) approve design reports and procedures
* Assist in providing necessary design inputs to other disciplines to enable them to proceed with their deliverables
* Where assigned, assist procurement personnel in procuring discipline equipment, materials, and services; ensuring that work produced complies with Customer objectives and procedures Procurement assistance includes preparing, reviewing, and (as Lead Engineer) approving requisitions, evaluating technical quotations, preparing queries and compiling bid tabulations and recommendations, as directed by Discipline Lead Engineer
* Review and (as Lead Engineer) approve design verification through single\-discipline check /inter\-discipline check (IDC)
* Provide technical support to all fabrication queries, including identifying defect/rectification requirements
* Keep the Discipline Manager apprised of all activities and concerns, technical, budgetary and manpower related
* Assist in providing inputs for actual, planning, and forecasting progress reports including associated productivity
* Present issues and problems to Customers in a timely manner and assist the Lead Engineer in negotiating resolution in accordance with project and company requirements
* Perform (as required) Technical Quality Audit reviews in accordance with MDR Global Procedures
* Assist Lead engineer with responses to Customers and other agencies (such as certifying authorities, auditors, third parties, etc) on their review and approval
* Capture lessons learned and enter into MDR’s Lessons Learned system
* Guide less experienced engineers on MDR and Discipline procedures, standards, worksheets, design calculations, software, requisitions, technical bid evaluations, technical queries etc
* auditors, third parties, etc) on their review and approval
* Supervise and guide assigned engineers and coordinate with Lead Designers for Discipline engineering and design deliverables
* Responsible for the engineering integrity of the assigned work area
* Monitor costs of own work processes
* Assist in the maintenance of departmental technical guidelines and standard calculation notes
* Participate in development and maintenance of Global Procedures, Software, and Standards
* May participate in standards development committees or task groups such as API
* Develop communication and presentation skills (e.g., write technical papers, participate in conferences and/or seminars, present design solutions, and/or present topics at ‘lunch and learn’; etc.)
* Identify and provide training to staff in specific techniques and proprietary software
* Provide information on employee performance to the Discipline Manager
* Assist the Discipline manager in interviewing job applicants
* Perform, review, and (as Lead Engineer) approve designs, analyses, evaluations, calculations, and procedures such as :
+ Erection sequences for jackets, topsides, and other structures
+ Loadout procedure and guidance during the operations
+ Construction lift analyses and procedures for activities such as floatovers, stackings, rollups, etc.
+ Weighing Procedures
+ Design and detailing of miscellaneous fabrication yard items
+ Crane arrangements and rigging arrangements
+ Trailer arrangements/operations

* Assist in coordinating critical operations pre\-activity meetings and attend yard critical operations
* When acting as Lead engineer, in addition:
+ Act as a discipline point of contact in communications and meetings with customer counterparts
+ Ensure substantive communications are documented
+ Prepare bids and projects discipline engineering budget and execution plans
+ Identify project staff needs based on knowledge of individual engineer’s skill sets and provide requests to the discipline manager
+ Plan, organize, and assign tasks, responsibilities, and manhour budgets to the discipline team, and verify tasks are completed within budgets
+ Plan discipline deliverable schedule/register compliant with the overall execution plan
+ Prepare work forecasts identifying change management plans, corrective action, and real\-time schedule
+ Provide discipline inputs for actual, planning, and forecasting progress reports including associated productivity
+ Alert the project team of any deviation from the scope or a need for a change order
+ Monitor KPI measurement results and take corrective action as necessary to improve Discipline performance, including performance at interfaces with others
+ Coordinate with other Discipline Lead Engineers and Designers to ensure timely receipt of necessary design inputs
+ Review and approve requisitions, technical quotation evaluations, and queries, compiled bid tabulations, and coordinate with Procurement to expedite vendor documents as required
+ Lead the Discipline team during project audits (internal, Customer and third\-party technical audits) and Design reviews
+ Review comments from Customers and other agencies on documents and drawings produced by the team, and resolve/give guidance on their update and incorporation
+ Assist the Discipline manager in the preparation of quarterly forecasts and manpower planning
+ Anticipate project engineering needs and plan accordingly
+ Assist the Discipline manager in the Performance Evaluation of project team members


 Reports to: Manager (Construction Support Eng)
   

  

 Liaise With: All Engineering disciplines, Fabrication Dept, Marine Dept, Safety Dept, Project Management Team, Document
   

  

 Control, Project Planner, Project Cost Controller, QC and Certification Group, Procurement Group, Subcontractors, Vendors,
   

  

 and Customers
   

  

 Supervises: Senior Engineers and Engineers
   

  

**Qualifications**
**Essential Qualifications and Education**
* Bachelor's Degree in Naval Architecture, Civil/Structural/Mechanical Engineering (Master’s is a preference)
* 15\-20 years of experience in oil and gas with a major contractor or consultant predominantly performing construction and installation design
* Detailed knowledge of design techniques and analysis methods, and detailed knowledge of the theory, content, and application of standards, codes, and guidelines as applicable
* Knowledgeable in project coordination and execution skills


**About Us**
 Our ingenuity fuels daily life. Together, we’ve forged some of the most trusted partnerships across the energy value chain to make what was once just an idea a reality: laying subsea infrastructure thousands of feet below sea level, installing platforms hundreds of miles from shore, using our expertise to design and build offshore wind infrastructure, and reshaping the onshore landscape to deliver the energy products the world needs safely and sustainably.
   

  

 For more than 100 years, we've been making the impossible possible. Today, we're driving the energy transition with more than 30,000 of the brightest minds across 54 countries.

title: Senior Modeler - Construction Modeling

* Guides/assists other modelers regarding issues such as codes, design criteria, and software

* Excellent written and verbal communication
* Strong organizational skills
* Demonstrated ability to engage individuals and teams to complete tasks or projects.
* Ability to mentor and lead individuals and teams, build partnerships, and work collaboratively with others to meet shared objectives
* Demonstrated career growth that includes experience working on design teams for a variety of building or project types
* Strong client\-service attitude with the ability to multitask and accomplish multiple priorities

 Walter P Moore is an equal employment opportunity employer, and provides equal employment opportunities (including offering competitive compensation and benefit packages) to all employees and applicants for employment. We prohibit discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to any characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws and encourage all to apply including veterans and individuals with disabilities.
   

  

**Overview**
 Walter P Moore is an international company of engineers, architects, innovators, and creative people who solve some of the world’s most complex structural and infrastructure challenges. Providing structural, diagnostics, civil, traffic, parking, transportation, enclosure, WPM technology and construction engineering services, we design solutions that are cost\- and resource\-efficient, forward\-thinking, and help support and shape communities worldwide. Founded in 1931 and headquartered in Houston, Texas, our 1000\+ professionals work across 26 U.S. offices and 8 international locations.

The candidate is responsible for translating business requirements into system solutions, managing data migration, testing, training, and post\-go\-live support, while aligning with SAP best practices and project timelines.**

* Facilitate and support workstream managers / Solution Architects \& leads right from requirement gathering, solution design with focus on Sales and Customer Service processes and integration of same with operations, finance \& product management workstreams.
* Analyse business requirements related to sales quotations, sales orders management, order fulfilment, invoicing, returns and credit management processes.
* Configure core SD components such as sales order types, item categories, ATP, pricing procedures, delivery types, billing types and work with technical teams for WRICEF developments
* Responsible for creating/maintaining functional specifications for WRICEF (Workflow, Report, Interface, Conversion, Enhancement, Forms) objects.
* Perform configuration, testing, training, migration, cutover, go\-live and hyper care activities.
* Support incidents or change requests for the live Business units.
* Collaborate with BRIM, MM, FI, PP and EWM module consultants to support cross\-functional processes.


**SELECTION CRITERIA**
**Essential:**
* Bachelor / master’s degree in business, Computer Science, or equivalent discipline is required with minimum 15 years of consulting experience with multiple Industries.
* Minimum 4 full lifecycle implementations / roll outs \& support experience in Sales \& Distribution module in S/4 HANA or SAP ECC Projects.
* Extensive experience in the core SD customizing including Quotations, Sales contracts, Sales order management, Available to Promise (ATP), outbound logistics, pricing, billing and returns and credit management.
* Hands\-on experience in SD configurations.
* Understanding on SAP Best Practices in SD module and their integrations \& technology.
* Experience in S/4HANA environment and Fiori applications.
* Strong communication skills in English, self\-driven and motivated.
* Ability to manage and deliver multiple priorities in a constrained timeline


**Desirable:**
* SAP S/4 HANA Certification in SAP SD.
* Knowledge of new features in SAP S/4HANA like embedded analytics, user experience using Fiori, SAP cloud platform
* Basic ABAP debugging or familiarity with enhancement frameworks.


**WORK ENVIRONMENT FACTORS**
* Office based/Remote with occasional international travel.
* Health and Safety accountability statements.
* Working times are European time zone, however open to be available in APAC/US time zone as well for the need basis.

 Join Deloitte Tax Services India Private Limited and support US\-based clients as they modernize and strengthen their tax functions through SAP\-enabled transformation.  As a Manager, Tax Services on the Tax Transformation Consulting (TTC) team, you will be responsible for:

* Engagement Management: Lead engagement planning and budgeting; mobilize and manage engagement teams; define deliverable structure and content; facilitate buy\-in of proposed solutions from top management levels at the client; direct on\-time, quality delivery of work products; manage engagement economics; and manage engagement risk.
* Practice Development \& Eminence: Develop practical solutions and methodologies; develop "thought\-ware" and "point\-of\-view" documents; participate in public speaking events; get published in industry periodicals.

 Deloitte's TTC group helps our clients’ tax department move forward from their current state to the next generation of tax functions and is dedicated to finding new methods and processes to assist clients in improving their tax operations. description:
Join us as we work to create a thriving ecosystem that delivers accessible, high\-quality, and sustainable healthcare for all.
   

  

 Role Summary
   

  

 The
 **Associate Manager** 
 is responsible for leading a team of Project Managers who manage data migration and import projects supporting the transition of patient and clinical data from source Electronic Health Record (EHR) systems into athenaOne.
   

  

 The Associate Manager provides people, product, process, operational, and portfolio leadership to ensure the team consistently delivers high\-quality outcomes, meets project and business commitments, and provides an exceptional client experience. This role is accountable for team performance, project portfolio health, risk and escalation management, operational metrics, and continuous improvement.
   

  

 The Associate Manager serves as a key escalation point for complex or high\-risk projects and partners closely with Product, Engineering, Client Services, and other cross\-functional teams to resolve issues, improve processes, and develop scalable solutions for the Data Imports organization.
   

  

 The role requires a strong combination of people leadership, project management, analytical thinking, client management, and operational expertise, along with the ability to work effectively with geographically distributed teams across India and the US.
   

  

 Team Summary
   

  

 The Data Imports organization supports the transition of patient and clinical data from source EHR systems into athenaOne. The team works on data migration and import projects that require strong project execution, data quality focus, client coordination, and cross\-functional collaboration.
   

  

 Team members partner with Product, Engineering, Client Services, and other stakeholders to manage complex implementations, resolve issues, and ensure successful project delivery. The environment values accountability, continuous improvement, operational discipline, and the ability to balance business priorities with client needs.
   

  

**Essential Job Responsibilities**
* Lead, coach, and develop a team of Project Managers, establishing clear performance expectations and accountability for productivity, quality, project delivery, and client experience.
* Conduct regular 1:1s, provide meaningful feedback, recognize strong performance, address performance gaps, and support career development, training, badging, and succession planning.
* Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, inclusion, continuous learning, and continuous improvement, while participating in hiring and other personnel\-related activities.
* Provide oversight of the team’s portfolio of data import and migration projects, ensuring appropriate management of project health, risks, dependencies, go\-live readiness, and delivery outcomes.
* Monitor portfolio performance, operational metrics, capacity, and emerging risks; proactively intervene and prioritize resources to address high\-risk projects, competing priorities, and business needs.
* Serve as the escalation point for complex, high\-risk, or high\-visibility projects and client concerns, providing direction and driving issues to timely resolution.
* Ensure Project Managers effectively manage client relationships, project communications, expectations, and escalations while maintaining a high standard of professionalism and service.
* Partner with Client Services, Product, Engineering, and other cross\-functional teams across India and the US to resolve complex project and client\-impacting issues and drive successful outcomes.
* Ensure the team maintains high standards for data accuracy, quality, and import readiness, providing guidance on complex data mapping, validation, reconciliation, transformation, and troubleshooting scenarios as needed.
* Use project and operational data, including information from tools such as Microsoft Excel, Salesforce, SQL, and reporting platforms, to evaluate team performance, identify trends and risks, and support data\-driven decision\-making.
* Identify systemic issues, operational inefficiencies, and recurring challenges within Data Imports and lead initiatives to improve efficiency, quality, scalability, and consistency.
* Partner with Product and Engineering to identify and implement opportunities for automation, tooling enhancements, and workflow improvements.
* Develop and standardize processes, operating mechanisms, and best practices, ensuring effective adoption across the team and incorporating lessons learned into training, documentation, and knowledge management.
* Work with Data Imports leadership in India and the US to translate organizational priorities into clear team objectives, measurable outcomes, and actionable plans.
* Provide leadership with visibility into team performance, portfolio health, emerging risks, capacity requirements, and opportunities for improvement through regular operational reviews and data\-driven recommendations.
* Contribute to the long\-term vision, strategy, and operating model for Data Imports and lead initiatives that support the growth and scalability of the organization.
* Serve as a subject matter expert for data import and implementation processes, maintaining strong knowledge of athenahealth’s data models, import tools, EHR workflows, and data migration practices.
* Promote data import best practices and provide guidance to Project Managers on complex project execution, data quality, risk management, troubleshooting, and client management.


**Additional Job Responsibilities**
* Support knowledge sharing, training, and capability building across the Data Imports team.
* Contribute to operational reviews, portfolio planning, and leadership discussions.
* Help maintain consistency in documentation, reporting, and process adherence across projects.
* Participate in initiatives that improve scalability, standardization, and team effectiveness.
* Leverage AI\-enabled tools and emerging technologies to support analysis, process improvement, documentation, and operational efficiency while applying human judgment to validate outcomes.
* Perform other duties as assigned in support of team and organizational objectives.


 Expected Education \& Experience
   

  

* Active PMP certification.
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, Science, Statistics, Management, Healthcare Administration, or another related field.
* 6\+ years of relevant experience in US healthcare, Health IT, EHR implementations, data migration, project management, or a related field.
* Demonstrated experience leading, mentoring, or managing teams, preferably in a project management, implementation, technical operations, or healthcare environment.
* Strong project and portfolio management experience, including managing complex projects with multiple stakeholders and competing priorities.
* Strong understanding of EHR implementation, healthcare workflows, data migration, and data quality processes.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to effectively engage geographically distributed teams across India and the US.
* Demonstrated ability to manage complex client relationships and resolve escalated customer issues.
* Excellent analytical, logical, and problem\-solving skills with a data\-driven approach to decision\-making.
* Strong proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including advanced functions, pivot tables, XLOOKUP/VLOOKUP, data analysis, and transformation techniques.
* Working knowledge of SQL for querying, validating, reconciling, and analyzing large datasets.
* Experience with Salesforce or equivalent CRM/project management tools is preferred.
* Demonstrated experience identifying operational inefficiencies and leading process improvement initiatives.
* Strong understanding of project risk management, escalation management, dependency management, and portfolio oversight.
* Demonstrated ability to coach, mentor, and develop employees while maintaining accountability for performance and results.
* Ability to influence cross\-functional stakeholders and drive initiatives without direct authority.
* Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
* Proven ability to operate effectively in a fast\-paced, high\-volume environment and manage competing priorities.
* Ability to work independently, exercise sound judgment, and make decisions with appropriate consideration of business and client impact.
* Passion for continuous learning, operational excellence, and people development.
* Flexibility to adapt to changing business priorities and organizational needs.
* Willingness to work shifts aligned with US business hours, including IST night shifts.
* Familiarity with healthcare data standards such as HL7, CCDA, CCD, or FHIR is preferred.

title: Assistant Vice President - Change the Bank
description:
**Job Description** 




  





**Mizuho Global Services India Pvt. Ltd.** 




  





 Mizuho Global Services Pvt Ltd (MGS) is a subsidiary company of Mizuho Bank, Ltd, which is one of the largest banks or so called ‘Mega Banks’ of Japan. MGS was established in the year 2020 as part of Mizuho’s long term strategy of creating a captive global processing centre for remotely handling banking and IT related operations of Mizuho Bank’s domestic and overseas offices and Mizuho’s group companies across the globe.
 



 At Mizuho we are committed to a culture that is driven by ethical values and supports diversity in all its forms for its talent pool. Direction of MGS’s development is paved by its three key pillars, which are Mutual Respect, Discipline and Transparency, which are set as the baseline of every process and operation carried out at MGS.
 



  





**What’s in it for you?** 



* Immense exposure and learning
* Excellent career growth
* Company of highly passionate leaders and mentors
* Ability to build things from scratch



  





**Know more about MGS:** 




 https://www.mizuhogroup.com/asia\-pacific/mizuho\-global\-services
 



  





**AVP – Change the Bank** 




  





**Process Initiatives, Governance \& Service Management** 




**Role Purpose:** 
 To strengthen the Change the Bank capability within Mizuho Global Services by leading structured process initiatives, governance forums, service management reviews, productivity improvement, benefit tracking, and cross\-functional transformation across Operations.
 



  





**Position Summary** 




 The AVP – Change the Bank role will be responsible for driving process improvement, governance discipline, service management, and transformation delivery across Mizuho Global Services Operations. The role holder will partner with Operations, Risk, Technology, Quality, Business Management, and senior stakeholders to identify opportunities, prioritize initiatives, execute process changes, and sustain measurable benefits.
 



  





 The position is expected to operate as a transformation orchestrator and governance enabler. The individual should be able to convert business issues into structured change initiatives, facilitate senior governance forums, produce executive\-level MI, and ensure that improvements are embedded into BAU operations with clear ownership, KPI tracking, and benefit validation.
 



  





**Key Accountabilities** 




  





**A. Process Initiatives \& Operational Excellence** 



* Lead end\-to\-end process diagnostics across Operations functions, including As\-Is assessment, pain\-point identification, root cause analysis, and To\-Be process design.
* Drive process reengineering initiatives to improve turnaround time, right\-first\-time quality, productivity, control effectiveness, and stakeholder experience.
* Facilitate workshops with Operations SMEs, line managers, control teams, technology partners, and business stakeholders to identify transformation opportunities.
* Apply Lean, Six Sigma, Kaizen, value stream mapping, and structured problem\-solving methods to simplify processes and remove non\-value\-added activities.
* Prepare business cases, initiative charters, implementation plans, and benefit tracking templates for approved process improvement projects.
* Ensure process changes are documented, communicated, implemented, and handed over to BAU owners with clear controls and sustainability measures.



  





**B. Governance Meetings \& Executive Reporting** 



* Plan, coordinate, and facilitate CTB governance forums, steering committees, portfolio reviews, service review meetings, and senior management updates.
* Create executive\-ready governance packs covering initiative status, risks, issues, dependencies, decisions required, benefits, and overdue actions.
* Maintain a structured CTB initiative pipeline with prioritization based on value, risk, customer impact, feasibility, regulatory relevance, and operational urgency.
* Track governance actions to closure and escalate delays or unresolved issues through the agreed forum structure.
* Support leadership communication by preparing crisp summaries, dashboards, decision notes, and management commentary.



  





**C. Service Management \& Performance Improvement** 



* Drive service management reviews with Operations units and stakeholders to assess service performance, SLA achievement, backlog trends, quality issues, escalations, and improvement actions.
* Define, monitor, and improve key service metrics such as TAT, SLA adherence, RFT, error rate, capacity utilization, productivity, aging, and stakeholder feedback.
* Identify service delivery gaps and convert recurring issues into structured improvement initiatives.
* Partner with service delivery teams to standardize operating rhythms, issue management routines, performance dashboards, and action tracking mechanisms.
* Support improved stakeholder experience through proactive service reviews, transparent MI, and disciplined follow\-up.



  





**D. Productivity, Capacity \& Benefits Management** 



* Establish baseline measurements for volumes, FTE capacity, productivity, TAT, quality, and cost drivers.
* Identify and quantify capacity release opportunities through process simplification, workflow redesign, automation, and elimination of duplicate effort.
* Track planned versus delivered benefits, including effort saved, FTE capacity released, cost avoidance, risk reduction, quality improvement, and service enhancement.
* Validate benefit sustainability after implementation and ensure ownership is transferred to BAU teams.
* Develop productivity dashboards and management reporting to support leadership decisions.



  





**E. Automation \& Digital Enablement** 



* Partner with Technology, Digital Transformation, and Automation teams to identify opportunities for workflow digitization, RPA, OCR, AI, data automation, and platform enhancements.
* Translate operational pain points into clear business requirements and solution proposals.
* Support prioritization of automation use cases based on effort, impact, feasibility, control improvement, and benefit potential.
* Coordinate UAT, implementation readiness, change adoption, and post\-implementation benefit tracking for digital initiatives.



  





**F. Risk, Control \& Change Sustainability** 



* Embed control considerations into process redesign and ensure changes support audit readiness, evidence discipline, and operational resilience.
* Use error trends, audit observations, KRIs, control gaps, and service issues as inputs for transformation prioritization.
* Ensure that CTB initiatives do not dilute operational controls and that revised processes are sustainable, measurable, and compliant with internal standards.
* Work with Operations Risk, Compliance, Quality, and Control functions where process changes require risk assessment or control validation.



  





**Required Experience** 



* 10 to 15 years of experience in Banking Operations, Shared Services, Global Capability Centres, Consulting, Process Excellence, PMO, Service Management, or Transformation roles.
* Experience in operating model improvement, process reengineering, governance management, service delivery transformation, or productivity programs.
* Strong exposure to banking operations such as KYC, Trade Finance, Loans, Payments, Middle Office, Client Operations, Credit Operations, or other back\-office / middle\-office domains will be preferred.
* Experience in preparing senior management presentations, dashboards, governance packs, project updates, and benefit realization reports.
* Proven ability to work with cross\-functional stakeholders across Operations, Risk, Technology.



  





**Education \& Certifications** 



* Graduate degree in Commerce, Finance, Engineering, Business, Operations, or related discipline.
* MBA / PGDM / Post Graduate qualification preferred.
* Lean Six Sigma Green Belt strongly preferred; Black Belt desirable.
* PMP, PRINCE2, Agile, ITIL, or Service Management certification will be an added advantage.



  





**Desired Profile:** 




 Candidate with strong execution capability, governance pack preparation, process improvement delivery, service review management, stakeholder coordination, and ability to independently manage a portfolio of initiatives.

description:
Looking for a highly capable individual to work directly with a Founder with keen business interests and venture ideas in Investments, Hospitality \& Wellness, Clean Food, Travel and Sports. The core purpose of this role is two\-fold;
 



 1\)     Shadow role \& community building: Investments \& Well\-Being
 



 2\)     New Venture Ideas – Execution, Co\-ordination, structuring, and customer relations
 



 This is not a traditional administrative or EA role. It is a hands\-on position for someone who thrives on execution, operates with high autonomy and enjoys working across varied domains.
 



  





 Key Responsibilities
 



 ·      Act as a trusted resource on prioritization and decision\-making; help evaluate new opportunities and shape which ideas move forward.
 



 ·      Own projects from high\-level ideation through execution: scoping (research, analysis, due diligence), planning, stakeholder coordination, operational follow\-through, progress tracking and driving outcomes.
 



 ·      Naturally well networked and inclination towards building purposeful communities
 



 ·      Prepare clear briefing materials and updates that support rapid, informed decisions.
 



 ·      Identify bottlenecks, propose solutions and keep multiple workstreams moving.
 



  





 Ideal Candidate
 



 ·      Strong intellectual curiosity and genuine interest in execution across areas such as finance, hospitality, wellness, sports, fitness, food, dogs/pets and travel. A perfect sector match is not required; a bias for ‘getting things done’ is essential.
 



 ·      1 – 5 years of professional experience
 



 ·      Analytical, structured, and comfortable with ambiguity \- able to turn loosely defined ideas into clear action plans.
 



 ·      Proactive, resourceful, and follow\-through oriented.
 



 ·      Strong written and verbal communication; able to synthesize information clearly
 



 ·      Well versed with MS Office programs, Social Media platforms and AI LLMs
 



 ·      Comfortable working closely with an ambitious principal (with focus on deliverables and deliverables alone) and operating with significant trust and autonomy
 



  





 Success in the Role
 



 Within the first few months, the right person will have moved several initiatives from concept to concrete progress, established reliable systems for tracking and follow\-through, and become a trusted partner the founder can rely on to advance ideas effectively. The role can transition towards being a team leader that oversees the above mentioned.
 



  





 Salary Range: Basis experience and skill sets
