* Maintain user guides, SOPs, and training materials
* Govern usage standards, workflows, and documentation requirements
* Support reports and dashboards with consistent KPI definitions
* Coordinate UAT, releases and backlog priorities


 You will work across manufacturing sites and shared functions, in close collaboration with CAPEX project managers, site controllers, procurement and IT.
   

  

**Structured communicator with a clear quality focus**
 We are looking for someone who is service\-minded, and organized, with a practical approach to user support and process governance. You communicate clearly with both end users and management, work carefully with documentation and change control, and are comfortable balancing business needs with standard ways of working. The right person is initiative\-taking, detail\-oriented, and able to move issues forward while keeping compliance, auditability, and data quality in focus.
   

  

**You Also Have**
* 5\+ years of experience in CAPEX controlling, project execution, PMO, finance, or a similar area using CAPEX, ERP, or project portfolio tools
* Experience translating business needs into system requirements and supporting UAT, training, and change management
* Good understanding of data structures, reporting, and integrations with finance or ERP systems
* Experience acting as system or product owner
* Training or certification in ERP/PM systems or project management


**Help improve investment quality for a greener future**
 NKT is committed to developing a diverse organization and culture where people of diverse backgrounds can grow and are inspired to do their best. We are motivated to establish gender diversity at NKT and encourage all interested candidates to apply – even if you don’t tick all the boxes described. We believe that a diverse organization enables long\-term performance, and that an inclusive and welcoming culture creates a better work environment.
   

  

 In this role, you will be part of a collaborative international setting where you can broaden your skills in CAPEX governance, systems, reporting, and change processes. You will work with colleagues across business functions and sites, contribute to continuous improvement, and support reliable investment planning that matters to NKT’s ongoing journey and the wider green transition.
   

  

 “This role is ideal for someone who enjoys connecting systems, process standards, and user needs to create reliable CAPEX planning and reporting across the business,” says Hiring Manager, Karim Damiani
   

  

 Read more about our offer and listen to some voices of NKT Connectors here!
   

  

 We will review applications continuously, but we recommend you apply no later than 30th September 2026\. Be aware that personality and cognitive tests might be included in the recruitment process. Please note that due to the GDPR regulations we cannot accept any applications via e\-mail.
   

  

 We collect confidential candidate experience feedback to improve our recruitment process. Your responses are for quality development only and do not affect hiring decisions.
   

  

 Be a Connector of the green tomorrow!
   

  

**About NKT**
*NKT connects a greener world with high\-quality power cable technology and takes centre stage as the world moves towards green energy. NKT designs, manufactures and installs low\-, medium\- and high\-voltage power cable solutions enabling sustainable energy transmission. Since 1891, NKT has innovated the power cable technology building the infrastructure for the first light bulbs to the megawatts created by renewable energy today. title: Software Engineering Manager
description:
As a Software Engineering Manager within MS TECH Order Fulfillment, you will provide strategic product and technical leadership, along with hands\-on expertise, to build industry\-leading products. You are a systems thinker capable of driving large\-scale transformations that maximize value for Ford, our Dealers, and our customers. The role combines high\-level strategy, including product vision, AI/ML use\-case portfolio, data strategy, and technical roadmaps, with disciplined execution to deliver scalable, resilient, secure, explainable, and highly available solutions in a global environment.
   

  

**Technical Leadership \& Vision**
* Serve as the primary technical authority for the Order Generation product suite, defining the evolution of the technology stack, data architecture, AI/ML capabilities, and architectural patterns.
* Lead cross\-functional teams through complex integrations, managing dependencies across the broader Order Fulfillment ecosystem to ensure seamless data flow and system interoperability.
* Translate high\-level business requirements into actionable technical strategies that align with Ford enterprise standards.


**AI/ML Product Strategy \& Innovation**
* Define and execute an AI/ML and data analytics product strategy that converts priority business requirements into a sequenced portfolio of intelligent capabilities and measurable outcomes.
* Identify, evaluate, and prioritize AI/ML opportunities across forecasting, order generation, decision support, anomaly detection, optimization, and workflow automation using value, feasibility, risk, data readiness, and adoption criteria.
* Lead the end\-to\-end lifecycle of AI/ML products from discovery, business\-case development, experimentation, and MVP validation through industrialization, launch, adoption, and continuous improvement.
* Partner with Data Science, Data Engineering, Product, Architecture, Cybersecurity, Legal, Privacy, and business teams to ensure solutions are technically sound, usable, compliant, and aligned with responsible AI principles.
* Establish outcome\-based product metrics, experimentation methods, model performance targets, and adoption measures; use evidence and customer feedback to guide investment and roadmap decisions.
* Monitor emerging technologies, including generative AI, agentic AI, foundation models, advanced analytics, optimization, and intelligent automation, and determine where they can create differentiated business value.
* Drive build, buy, or partner assessments and develop scalable patterns for reusable AI/ML services, data products, model APIs, and decision intelligence capabilities.


**Product Strategy \& Delivery**
* Partner with business stakeholders to define and execute a multi\-year product vision and roadmap focused on optimized order forecasting and generation.
* Champion an iterative, Agile delivery model, prioritizing the delivery of Minimum Viable Products (MVPs) and maintaining a high\-velocity release cadence.
* Apply Human\-Centered Design (HCD) principles to ensure technical solutions solve real\-world problems for Dealers and customers.
* Create launch and adoption plans that include operational readiness, user training, change management, benefit tracking, and feedback loops.


**Data, Model \& MLOps Excellence**
* Ensure AI/ML solutions are supported by trusted, governed, discoverable, and fit\-for\-purpose data, with clear ownership, lineage, quality controls, and access patterns.
* Guide the implementation of robust MLOps and LLMOps practices covering reproducible experimentation, model registry, automated testing, deployment, monitoring, drift detection, retraining, rollback, and auditability.
* Define controls for model quality, explainability, bias and fairness evaluation, privacy, security, human oversight, and responsible use throughout the product lifecycle.
* Balance predictive accuracy with interpretability, latency, cost, reliability, and business usability when selecting models and architectures.


**Engineering \& Operational Excellence**
* Enforce rigorous engineering standards, including Test\-Driven Development (TDD), robust CI/CD pipelines, and DevSecOps practices.
* Drive a culture of Full Lifecycle Ownership, where the team is responsible for the design, security, deployment, and operational health of its services.
* Establish and monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) for system health, code quality, delivery velocity, model performance, data quality, adoption, and realized business value.


**Architectural Design**
* Architect and oversee the development of cloud\-native, microservices\-based systems designed for global scale, multi\-tenancy, and high\-performance transactional processing.
* Design interoperable data and AI architectures that support batch and real\-time inference, event\-driven workflows, APIs, observability, and secure integration with enterprise platforms.


**People Leadership \& Talent Development**
* Cultivate a high\-performing, diverse team of Software Engineers, Product Managers, Data Engineers, Data Scientists, and ML Engineers through active coaching, mentorship, and career pathing.
* Foster a culture of psychological safety and continuous learning, utilizing blameless retrospectives and regular feedback loops to drive team growth.
* Identify and close skill gaps within the team to keep pace with emerging technologies and industry trends.


**Strategic Collaboration**
* Act as a bridge between the product team and domain experts in Cloud Infrastructure, Data \& AI, Cybersecurity, Responsible AI, SRE, and DevOps to reduce portfolio complexity.
* Influence stakeholders across the organization to adopt modern engineering practices, responsible AI controls, reusable data products, and standardized service contracts.


**Technical Execution (Hands\-on)**
* Maintain deep technical fluency in the team’s primary languages, frameworks, cloud services, data platforms, and AI/ML toolchain, including Java, Spring Boot, GCP/Azure, Vertex AI, and modern MLOps platforms.
* Lead from the front by participating in architecture and code reviews, resolving complex technical blockers, reviewing model and data design decisions, and occasionally prototyping high\-risk or emerging technology concepts.
* Experience: 10\+ years of progressive software engineering, digital product, data, or AI/ML solution delivery experience, with a significant portion in engineering and product leadership roles.
* AI/ML Product Leadership: Demonstrated experience strategizing, developing, launching, and scaling AI/ML\-based products that address business requirements and deliver measurable operational or customer outcomes.
* Product Strategy: Experience defining product vision, business cases, roadmaps, prioritization frameworks, MVPs, go\-to\-market or launch plans, adoption strategies, and value\-realization metrics for data and AI products.
* Education: Undergraduate degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, Artificial Intelligence, Statistics, Operations Research, or a related quantitative field.
* Certifications: Industry certifications relevant to software engineering, cloud, data, or AI/ML, or a commitment to obtain them within 6 months. GCP Professional Cloud Architect, Professional Machine Learning Engineer, or equivalent certification is a plus.
* Cloud Expertise: 4\+ years of experience delivering production solutions on Google Cloud Platform (GCP), including cloud\-native application and data/AI services.
* Technical Depth: Expertise in microservices, cloud\-native architectures, event\-driven architectures, APIs, Domain\-Driven Design (DDD), distributed systems, and secure enterprise integration.

title: Engineering Manager
description:
As an Engineering Manager, you will be responsible for leading a team of engineers to deliver high\-quality, client\-focused solutions. You will collaborate closely with Product Owners, Senior Engineering Managers, and Solution Architects to implement technical designs that align with client requirements and business objectives. Your role will require staying up\-to\-date with emerging technologies, ensuring application wellness, and fostering a collaborative and performance\-driven culture within your team. You will also be responsible for managing engineers’ performance, facilitating their professional development, and providing regular project updates to senior leadership.
   

  

**Core Responsibilities:**
**Requirement Analysis** 
 :
   

  

* Collaborate with Product Owners and Senior Engineering Managers to thoroughly understand client and business requirements.
* Plan and prioritize the implementation of technical solutions that meet client needs.


**Solution Design** 
 :
   

  

* Work with Solution Architects to implement finalized architecture designs that consider scalability, security, and performance.
* Ensure the designs are executed effectively to meet client and business expectations.


**Technical Expertise** 
 :
   

  

* Application \& API Development: Guide the technical design and delivery of .NET web applications and RESTful APIs, ensuring adherence to microservices architecture and established design patterns (Dependency Injection, Repository pattern), while maintaining a consistent track record of on\-time, high\-quality delivery.
* Cloud\-Native Development \& DevOps: Oversee containerization strategy (Docker) and cloud deployment across GCP (primary) and Azure, and drive the build\-out and maintenance of CI/CD pipelines to automate build, test, and deployment processes.
* Application Security: Ensure the team follows secure coding practices against common vulnerabilities (OWASP Top 10\), enforces standards\-based authentication/authorization (OAuth 2\.0, OpenID Connect, JWT), and proactively monitors/remediates vulnerabilities in dependencies and third\-party packages.
* Data Management: Direct database schema design and query optimization to support application data needs, ensuring performance, integrity, and scalability across transactional and reporting use cases.
* Testing \& Quality Assurance: Champion a culture of automated testing (unit/integration) and rigorous code review, ensuring consistent troubleshooting and validation practices throughout the development lifecycle.
* Compliance \& Governance: Ensure application development aligns with applicable compliance and data protection requirements, embedding these considerations into the team's standard practices.


**Cross\-Functional Collaboration** 
 :
   

  

* Coordinate with developers, engineers, product owners, and quality assurance professionals to deliver efficient and high\-quality solutions.
* Ensure the application is kept up to date with the latest technology standards and free from security vulnerabilities.


**Application Wellness** 
 :
   

  

* Ensure applications are regularly scanned for security issues, kept current with updates, and optimized for performance.
* Documentation:
* Build and maintain technical documentation for all managed applications and keep Confluence pages updated.
* Work collaboratively to maintain an accurate and up\-to\-date application catalog.


**Team Evaluation and Development** 
 :
   

  

* Conduct regular performance reviews and one\-on\-one meetings with engineers.
* Identify training and development opportunities to foster a high\-performing and motivated engineering team.


**Status Updates** 
 :
   

  

* Provide weekly updates on project status, team performance, and any critical issues or escalations to Senior Engineering Managers.
* Ensure transparency and effective communication with both internal teams and clients.


**Key** 
**Competencies** 
**:**
**Technical Solution Management** 
 :
   

  

* Proven experience in managing technical solutions, systems architecture, or a related field.


**Communication and Presentation** 
 :
   

  

* Effective communication skills for effectively presenting ideas and updates to both technical teams and clients.


**Problem\-Solving and Critical Thinking** 
 :
   

  

* Ability to assess complex challenges and develop practical, efficient solutions.


**Project Management Knowledge** 
 :
   

  

* Familiarity with project management principles, with relevant certifications being an added advantage.


**Technology Selection** 
 :
   

  

* Evaluate and select the best technologies, tools, and vendors to support the needs of client projects.


**Quality Assurance** 
 :
   

  

* Oversee and participate in quality assurance processes, ensuring that solutions meet performance, security, and reliability standards.

title: Associate Project Manager
description:
ABOUT
   





 Agnikul Cosmos is a company incubated at IIT Madras and we build rockets that can take satellites up to 500 kg to Lower Earth Orbit (LEO). In May 2024, we successfully completed our maiden launch from our own launchpad (India's first private launchpad). The launch has proven all the new technologies developed by Agnikul and also earned recognition from Honourable Prime Minister of India.
   





 We are looking for a hands\-on Project Manager who can work across teams, understand bottlenecks, coordinate people and resources, and drive projects to completion. This is a highly execution\-oriented role for someone who enjoys solving problems, chasing dependencies, and getting things done rather than simply tracking tasks.
   





 This role is for you if
   




* You naturally ask “What is blocking this?” instead of waiting for an update.
* You are comfortable getting into the details when something is stuck.
* You can coordinate with multiple teams without needing formal authority over them.
* You enjoy taking a messy problem and turning it into a clear action plan.
* You don't stop at identifying a problem, you stay with it until it gets solved.



 Key Responsibilities
   




* Own projects end\-to\-end, from planning and execution to closure, ensuring timelines, dependencies, and deliverables are clearly defined and tracked.
* Work closely with engineering, manufacturing, quality, operations, and other teams to coordinate activities and keep projects moving.
* Identify bottlenecks, dependencies, risks, and delays, and proactively work with relevant teams to resolve them.
* Drive regular project reviews, track milestones and action items, and ensure owners follow through on commitments.
* Build and maintain project plans, schedules, resource requirements, and status reports.
* Coordinate cross\-functional teams to ensure information, decisions, materials, and resources reach the right people at the right time.
* Escalate critical issues when required and work with stakeholders to arrive at practical solutions.
* Monitor project progress against timelines and proactively communicate changes, risks, and recovery plans to leadership.
* Support process improvements and introduce better ways of working to improve execution speed, accountability, and visibility.
* Take ownership of problems outside the immediate scope of the role when required to ensure the overall project gets delivered.


 Requirements
   

  

* 2\-5 years of experience in Engineering Project Management, Operations, or a similar execution\-focused role.
* Experience managing cross\-functional projects involving multiple teams and dependencies.
* Strong project planning, coordination, tracking, and problem\-solving skills.
* Ability to understand technical and operational requirements and work effectively with engineering and non\-engineering teams.
* Strong ownership and follow\-through; comfortable working in situations where there is ambiguity and no predefined playbook.
* Aerospace, defence, automotive, manufacturing, hardware, or other complex engineering environments would be preferred.
* Comfortable working in a 6\-day work week environment and willingness to work extended hours based on project requirements.

 Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. We are building a full\-stack AI cloud platform that supports developers and enterprises from data and model training through to production deployment, without the cost and complexity of building large in\-house AI/ML infrastructure.
   

  

 Built by engineers, for engineers. From large\-scale GPU orchestration to inference optimization, we own the hard problems across compute, storage, networking and applied AI.
   

  

 Listed on Nasdaq (NBIS) and headquartered in Amsterdam, we have a global footprint with R\&D hubs across Europe, the UK, North America and Israel. Our team of 1,500\+ includes hundreds of engineers with deep expertise across hardware, software and AI R\&D.
   

  

**The role**
 Nebius is building next\-generation AI infrastructure at scale. We are looking for a Field Technical Lead to drive the on\-site execution of large\-scale data center infrastructure deployments, leading technical teams and contractors while ensuring high\-quality, on\-time delivery.

* Proven hands\-on experience with data center infrastructure deployments, ideally in high\-performance computing or AI\-focused environments.
* Strong understanding of data center operations including racking, structured cabling, power planning, and cooling considerations.
* Technical knowledge of GPU servers, compute nodes, storage platforms, and high\-speed networking technologies.
* Experience working within project delivery frameworks, collaborating closely with Project Managers, and managing subcontractors or vendors.
* Excellent problem\-solving skills with the ability to troubleshoot and resolve issues in on\-site, time\-critical environments.
* Strong communication skills in English, both written and verbal.

 Fast moving \- Bold thinking \- Constant growth \- Meaningful impact \- Trust and real ownership \- Opportunity to shape the future of AI

* Own end\-to\-end vulnerability management program delivery, including service quality, service level agreement adherence, client satisfaction, and remediation outcomes across enterprise environments.
* Lead executive client relationships, provide strategic guidance on vulnerability risk management and program maturity, and translate complex exposure data into board\-level reporting and investment priorities.

 This role includes the responsibility of coordinating the Rs1 Workflow Consultancy (WfC) activities to support the Shell assets across the globe. As a coordinator, there will be opportunities to cooperate with and gain insight into a wide range of corporate functions and groups such as Resource Assurance and Reporting (RAR), Hydrocarbon Performance (HCP), Finance, Planning and Economics. It also gives opportunities to engage with Resource Volume Managers (RVM), Country Resource Focal Points (CRFP), as well as Reservoir Engineers across Shell.
   

  

**What You’ll Be Doing (Duties And Responsibilities)**
 The responsibilities of this role include:
   

  

* Working closely with Assets / Reservoir Engineers to understand the current challenges in using the Rs1 application and providing improvement suggestions.
* Support the E2E workflow in assessing and reporting volumetrics. Participate and support OP/ARPR cycles with necessary data and insights.
* Ability to perform quality checks and connect with relevant stakeholders for verification / rectification.
* You will work alongside the Rs1 Product Owner and Rs1 Scrum team as part of the global natural Rs1 team and in close collaboration with the business, RAR, HCP, Finance, RE/PG Discipline and Economics Function. This team supports the assets and the interfaces between Rs1 \& other applications and supports overall product lifecycle management and ensures continued alignment with the overall product vision, creating more user value and, in turn, driving greater commercial value for Shell.

* Lead WfC workload planning, prioritization, coordination, and delivery execution across the TAS team.

* Facilitate WfC team engagement through regular huddles and operational forums.

* Drive After\-Action\-Reviews for OP and ARPR cycles, consolidating feedback and identifying improvement opportunities.
* Contribute to governance forums and stakeholder reviews to enhance Rs1 performance and delivery outcomes.

* Deliver HSSE and code of conduct performance of the team \& team tasks.

* Close value and efficiency Gap to Potential (GtP) for the migrated activities.
* Maintain organizational capability to deliver team scope and maintain operational continuity. Interface Management etc.).
* HR Manage team.


 TAS Team Leadership Responsibilities:
   

  

* Hire and onboard staff; develop and assure competency and autonomy for task delivery.
* Integrate team members into Asset/Project natural teams and cadences.
* Maintain plans for migrated tasks aligned with Asset/Project plans.

**What You Bring**

title: Software Solutions Architect
description:
**Summary:** 




 The Software Solutions Architect role is to lead customer\-facing software development teams using C\#, .NET, WPF, and C\+\+. Beyond individual project ownership, you'll guide multiple engineering leads, drive AI adoption, and deliver scalable, long\-term software solutions while working directly with customers and stakeholders.
 



  





**Position Overview:** 




 We are hiring a Solutions Architect to lead large, customer\-facing software programs built on C\#, .NET, WPF, C\+\+, and Windows desktop technologies. This is a senior technical leadership role for someone who has grown beyond individual project ownership and can now guide multiple leads and engineering teams across complex workstreams.
 



  





 The role requires strong architecture depth, hands\-on engineering credibility, delivery ownership, and the confidence to work directly with customers and stakeholders. You will drive AI adoption across the team, make sound technical decisions, challenge weak requirements, resolve ambiguity, and deliver software solutions that are scalable, maintainable, reliable, and built for long\-term use.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities:** 



* Lead architecture, technical direction, and delivery execution across workstreams, owning design reviews, key decisions, and release sign\-off.
* Define and drive engineering standards, design patterns, coding practices, clean architecture, SOLID principles, and reusable approaches.
* Review system designs, interface contracts, data flows, integration points, and technical risks across complex, multi\-module environments.
* Provide technical leadership for WPF/XAML (MVVM, data binding, threading, performance) and C\#/C\+\+ development including native components, legacy modules, hardware integration, low\-level interfaces, and performance\-sensitive logic.
* Troubleshoot complex issues across multi\-process, multi\-threaded environments using logs, dumps, traces, profilers, and memory analysis tools.
* Own technical delivery planning, estimation, dependency management, risk tracking, and delivery readiness.
* Partner with customers, product, QA, DevOps, hardware, and business stakeholders to translate needs into practical, sustainable software solutions.
* Challenge requirements or approaches that introduce technical debt, delivery risk, or poor customer outcomes.
* Mentor senior engineers and technical leads, raising the bar on architecture thinking, debugging depth, ownership, and delivery discipline.
* Build alignment across local and global teams, supporting customer and cross\-site engagements as needed.



  





**Qualifications:** 



* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Electronics, Electrical Engineering, or a related discipline.
* 12\+ years of software engineering experience with proven delivery of complex software systems, including 4\+ years in technical leadership, architecture, or large\-scale delivery ownership.
* Experience leading large engineering teams, multiple workstreams, or Senior Technical Leads.
* Strong hands\-on background in C\#, .NET / .NET Core / .NET Framework, WPF, XAML, C\+\+, and Windows desktop application development, with deep knowledge of MVVM, object\-oriented design, SOLID principles, design patterns, clean code, and modular architecture.
* Strong understanding of multi\-threading, asynchronous programming, memory management, inter\-process communication, native\-managed code interaction, and application performance in Windows environments.
* Strong debugging and troubleshooting skills across complex, multi\-module, multi\-process Windows\-based software environments.
* Working knowledge of SDLC, Agile delivery, release planning, estimation, CI/CD pipelines, version control, code reviews, and software configuration management.
* Strong communication, stakeholder management, and customer\-facing skills, with the ability to influence architecture and solution direction while balancing delivery commitments and long\-term product quality.



  





**Good to have:** 



* Experience modernizing legacy C\#/.NET/WPF/C\+\+ applications or large Windows desktop platforms.
* Experience with performance profiling, memory analysis, UI responsiveness improvements, and reliability engineering.
* Exposure to backend services, APIs, databases, distributed systems, Windows services, Win32, native integrations, automated testing frameworks, DevOps, Linux, HPC, or high\-performance computing environments.
* Experience with software connected to hardware, instruments, automation systems, manufacturing systems, inspection systems, or other complex engineering platforms.
* Experience working with customers, field teams, service teams, application teams, and globally distributed engineering teams.



  





**What Sets You Apart:** 



* You identify customer pain points and take ownership without waiting to be asked.
* You can lead senior engineers, influence architecture across teams, and make balanced decisions that protect both customer value and long\-term product quality — even in ambiguous, high\-dependency situations.
* You are equally comfortable in architecture discussions, delivery conversations, and direct customer engagement.

Our work environment helps individuals explore their interests and potential and reach out to the resources and people available at Soliton to realize them. Read more about what it's like to work at Soliton: Soliton Employee Value Proposition .

title: S&C GN - Tech Strategy & Transformation - Tech M&A - Manager
description:
Manager – Technology M\&A Advisory
   

  

 Join our team in Technology Strategy \& Transformation for an exciting opportunity to help leading global organizations navigate the technology dimensions of mergers, acquisitions, divestitures, carve\-outs, and joint ventures.
   

  

 Practice: Technology Strategy \& Transformation, Global Network \| Area of Work: Technology M\&A \| Level: Manager \| Location: Bangalore/Gurgaon/Mumbai/Pune/Chennai/Hyderabad/Kolkata \| Years of Experience: 8–15 years
   

  

**Explore an Exciting Career at Accenture**
 Do you enjoy solving complex business and technology challenges? Are you passionate about helping clients create value through successful integrations and separations? Do you thrive in fast\-paced transaction environments and enjoy working with senior executives to drive critical business outcomes?
   

  

 Then this is the right place for you.
   

  

**The Practice – A Brief Sketch**
 The Technology M\&A team helps clients navigate the technology implications of mergers, acquisitions, divestitures, carve\-outs, joint ventures, and business transformations. We work across the transaction lifecycle, with a strong focus on post\-deal signing activities including sign\-to\-close planning, Day 1 readiness, integration planning, separation planning, TSA strategy and exit planning, and execution through Integration Management Offices (IMO) and Separation Management Offices (SMO).
   

  

 Our professionals help clients identify and realize transaction value while managing technology risks, operational dependencies, and transformation opportunities. We work closely with executive leadership, business stakeholders, and technology teams to design and execute integration and separation strategies that enable successful transaction outcomes.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Lead technology workstreams across mergers, acquisitions, divestitures, carve\-outs, and separation engagements.
* Support clients through sign\-to\-close planning activities, identifying technology risks, dependencies, synergies, and execution requirements.
* Develop Day 1 readiness strategies and support Day 1 execution planning.
* Drive technology integration and separation planning across applications, infrastructure, cloud environments, cybersecurity, data, and operating models.
* Support Integration Management Office (IMO) and Separation Management Office (SMO) governance, planning, execution tracking, and stakeholder management.
* Develop TSA strategies, transition plans, service schedules, and TSA exit roadmaps.
* Assess technology costs, risks, synergies, and implementation dependencies associated with transactions.
* Facilitate decision\-making with senior client stakeholders and executive leadership teams.
* Lead teams in delivering technology M\&A programs and manage project financials, staffing, and delivery quality.
* Develop executive\-level presentations, steering committee materials, business cases, and transaction\-related recommendations.


**Bring Your Best Skills Forward**
* Strong experience across Technology M\&A engagements including integration planning, IT Synergy assessments, separation planning, carve\-outs, Day 1 readiness, TSA management, and post\-merger integration activities.
* Ability to connect transaction objectives with technology execution plans and value realization opportunities.
* Experience managing technology workstreams within complex transaction environments and coordinating across multiple stakeholder groups.
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, communication, and executive presentation skills.
* Ability to structure ambiguous problems and develop practical, actionable recommendations.
* Experience leading teams and managing multiple workstreams simultaneously.


**Technology Domain Experience**
 Candidates should possess practical experience in at least one of the following technology domains and understand how these capabilities evolve during M\&A transactions, integrations, and separations:
   

  

* IT Infrastructure \& Cloud
* Infrastructure integration and separation planning.
* Cloud migration and cloud operating model considerations.
* Data center, network, workplace, hosting, and end\-user computing environments.
* Infrastructure TSA planning and exit execution.
* ERP
* Experience with SAP, Oracle, Microsoft Dynamics, or similar ERP platforms.
* ERP integration, harmonization, migration, or carve\-out activities.
* Understanding of business process impacts, reporting, controls, and data migration considerations during transactions.
* Enterprise Architecture \& IT Operating Model Transformation
* Enterprise architecture assessments and target\-state design.
* Application portfolio rationalization and technology roadmap development.
* IT operating model design and transformation.
* Technology governance, capability models, and organizational design considerations during integrations and separations.


 Deep SME\-level technical expertise is not required; however, candidates should possess sufficient hands\-on experience to assess transaction impacts, identify dependencies and risks, and support planning and execution activities within their chosen technology domain.
   

  

**What’s in it for You?**
* Opportunity to work on high\-profile global M\&A transactions and transformative business programs.
* Exposure to senior client executives and strategic decision\-making processes.
* Collaboration with leading practitioners across Technology Strategy, M\&A, Enterprise Architecture, Cloud, Cybersecurity, and Industry groups.
* Personalized training and development programs to strengthen transaction, consulting, and leadership capabilities.
* A diverse and inclusive culture focused on innovation, growth, and continuous learning.


**About Accenture:**
 Accenture is a leading global professional services company, providing a broad range of services and solutions in strategy, consulting, digital, technology and operations. Combining unmatched experience and specialized skills across more than 40 industries and all business functions — underpinned by the world’s largest delivery network — Accenture works at the intersection of business and technology to help clients improve their performance and create sustainable value for their stakeholders. With 569,000 people serving clients in more than 120 countries, Accenture drives innovation to improve the way the world works and lives. Visit us at www.accenture.com
   

  

**About Accenture Strategy \& Consulting:**
 Accenture Strategy shapes our clients’ future, combining deep business insight with the understanding of how technology will impact industry and business models. Our focus on issues such as digital disruption, redefining competitiveness, operating and business models as well as the workforce of the future helps our clients find future value and growth in a digital world. Today, digital is changing the way organizations engage with their employees, business partners, customers and communities. This is our unique differentiator. To bring this global perspective to our clients, Accenture Strategy's services include those provided by our Capability Network – a distributed management consulting organization that provides management consulting and strategy expertise across the client lifecycle. Our Capability Network teams complement our in\-country teams to deliver cutting\-edge expertise and measurable value to clients all around the world. For more information visit https://www.accenture.com/us\-en/Careers/capability\-network

**Management Level:** 
 07 – Manager
   

  

**Location:**

**Must have skills:** 
 GCC (Global Capability Centers) Strategy, Digital \& Technology Strategy, Technology Operating Model Design, Sourcing Strategy, Business Case Formulation, IT Processes \& Governance
   

  

**Good to have skills:** 
 Tech M\&A Advisory, IT Shared Services, Agile Operating Model, Workforce Transformation, AI in SDLC, Data Visualization Tools, Enterprise Architecture
   

  

**Job Summary:**
* Manage defined workstreams within GCC strategy and digital transformation engagements, taking responsibility for structuring the approach, shaping the analysis, and delivering high\-quality outputs within agreed timelines along with budgeting and forecasting activities
* Own and lead projects – guiding team, reviewing outputs, and ensuring coherence across deliverables at the workstream level
* Prepare client presentations, workshop materials, and proposal sections independently, contributing actively to client discussions and working sessions
* Develop business cases, cost analyses, value realization frameworks, and support models for GCC setup and digital strategy assignments
* Apply a technology and business perspective across GCC processes, IT governance design, KPI and maturity frameworks, and emerging areas such as AI\-enabled transformation
* Contribute to business development efforts through research, pitch preparation, and proposal development and managing BD cycles
* Excel as a long\-term trusted advisor and partner by providing thought leadership and profound knowledge of market trends.


**Roles \& Responsibilities:**
* GCC Strategy and Setup: lead analysis of BOT/ABO setup models, location and sourcing strategy, GCC tooling landscape assessment, capability maturity evaluation, and process taxonomy design for new GCC entities
* Cost Analysis and Value Realization: develop detailed cost models covering setup costs, run\-rate costs, and total cost of ownership for GCC and technology transformation scenarios; build value realization frameworks that track benefit delivery against investment over time, incorporating productivity, quality, and strategic value levers
* KPI Design and Performance Frameworks: design KPI frameworks for GCC performance management, covering operational, delivery, financial, and strategic metrics; develop KPI dashboards and reporting cadences aligned to governance structures
* Capability Maturity Assessment: conduct structured maturity assessments across GCC functions, IT processes, and technology capabilities; translate findings into prioritized improvement roadmaps with clear ownership and timelines
* GCC Processes and Tooling: Design GCC\-specific operating processes including demand management, project intake, service catalogues, and performance reporting; assess and recommend tooling platforms (ITSM, PPM, reporting) suited to GCC operating contexts
* IT Governance Design: Design IT governance frameworks for GCC and enterprise technology contexts, including governance councils, decision rights, escalation structures, and policy frameworks aligned to organizational objectives
* RACI and Interaction Model Design: Develop RACI matrices and IT interaction models defining roles, responsibilities, and collaboration patterns between the GCC, parent organization, business units, and third\-party vendors
* Operating Model Design: Design integrated IT operating models for GCC setups including organizational structure options, service delivery models, and transition planning considerations
* AI in SDLC: Contribute to assessments and recommendations on AI integration into software development lifecycles within GCC contexts – covering AI\-assisted coding, automated testing, and intelligent release management


**Professional \& Technical Skills:**
* 7–10 years of total experience in strategy consulting, technology advisory, or in\-house corporate strategy; experience at a top\-tier or Big 4 firm preferred
* Experience leading workstreams in GCC strategy, digital transformation, or technology operating model engagements
* Working knowledge of at least 2–3 of the following: GCC/Captive Center setup, Digital \& Technology Strategy, IT Governance, Operating Model Design, IT Shared Services, Sourcing Strategy, Agile Transformation
* Ability to build and interpret cost models, TCO analyses, and value realization frameworks for technology and GCC transformation contexts
* Experience designing KPI frameworks and performance measurement structures; ability to translate strategic objectives into measurable operational metrics
* Familiarity with maturity assessment approaches – capability, process, or technology maturity – and ability to develop actionable improvement roadmaps from findings
* Familiarity with IT governance frameworks (e.g. COBIT, ITIL) and ability to design practical governance structures including RACI models and interaction frameworks
* Understanding of GCC tooling ecosystems – ITSM platforms, project portfolio management tools, reporting and analytics platforms
* Awareness of AI adoption in software delivery including AI\-assisted development tools and their implications for GCC workforce and process design
* Strong proficiency in Excel and PowerPoint; exposure to data visualization tools (Power BI, Tableau); strong structured communication and presentation skills


**What’s in it for you?**
* Opportunity to work on GCC and digital strategy programs for marquee G2000 clients across industries
* Exposure to senior stakeholder engagements and client\-facing responsibilities as part of high\-performing delivery teams
* Potential to Co\-create with leaders in strategy, industry experts, enterprise function practitioners and, business intelligence professionals to shape and recommend innovative solutions that leverage emerging technologies.
* Ability to embed responsible business into everything—from how you service your clients to how you operate as a responsible professional.
* Personalized training modules to develop your strategy \& consulting acumen to grow your skills, industry knowledge and capabilities
* Opportunity to thrive in a culture that is committed to accelerating equality for all. Engage in boundaryless collaboration across the entire organization.

description:
**Petrofac is a leading international service provider to the energy industry, with a diverse client portfolio including many of the world’s leading energy companies.**
 We design, build, manage, and maintain infrastructure for our clients. We recruit, reward, and develop our people based on merit, regardless of race, nationality, religion, gender, age, sexual orientation, marital status, or disability. We value our people and treat everyone who works for or with Petrofac fairly and without discrimination.
   

  

 The world is re\-thinking its energy supply and energy security needs and planning for a phased transition to alternative energy sources. We are here to help our clients meet these evolving energy needs.
   

  

 This is an exciting time to join us on this journey.
   

  

***Are you ready to bring the right energy to Petrofac and help us deliver a better future for everyone?***
**JOB TITLE:** 
**IT Lead \- Infrastructure**
**Role Purpose**
 The Infrastructure Lead is accountable for the successful design, delivery and transition of the Petrofac Emirates infrastructure, network and IT operations landscape as part of the Emirates Carve\-Out Programme.
   

  

 The role will provide leadership across the infrastructure workstream, ensuring that all solutions are aligned with the approved Emirates architecture, High Level Design (HLD), security standards and programme guiding principles. The individual will work closely with business, technical, security, application, procurement and managed service partners to ensure the infrastructure platform is delivered within agreed timelines, supports Day 1 operational readiness and enables a successful TSA exit.
   

  

**Key Accountabilities**
**Infrastructure Strategy \& Architecture**
* Own the infrastructure workstream across network, cloud, operational tooling and managed services for the new Petrofac Emirates.
* Ensure all infrastructure decisions align with the approved Emirates HLD, target architecture and programme guiding principles.
* Act as the primary infrastructure technical authority within the programme, reviewing designs and challenging deviations from architecture standards.
* Ensure infrastructure solutions remain scalable, secure, supportable and aligned to the future Petrofac Emirates operating model.
* Support design governance and architecture review forums.


**Delivery \& Implementation**
* Lead the delivery of the Emirates infrastructure platform, including cloud infrastructure, networking, connectivity, identity dependencies, monitoring, backup, recovery and operational tooling.
* Ensure all infrastructure activities are delivered in accordance with programme plans, milestones and TSA exit timelines.
* Coordinate internal teams, vendors and managed service providers to achieve successful implementation outcomes.
* Oversee infrastructure testing, service validation, operational readiness and transition into support.
* Proactively identify risks, issues and dependencies that may impact programme delivery.


**Cross\-Workstream Integration**
* Act as the primary infrastructure representative across all Emirates programme workstreams.
* Collaborate closely with Application, ERP, Security, Identity, Data, Procurement and Business Readiness leads to ensure all technical dependencies are understood, managed and delivered.
* Ensure infrastructure services are provisioned in line with application migration schedules and business cutover plans.
* Support integrated planning, sequencing and dependency management across the wider programme.


**Operational Stability \& Risk Management**
* Ensure carve\-out activities do not negatively impact existing Petrofac operational services, users or critical business processes.
* Challenge delivery approaches that introduce unnecessary transition risk or future operational cost burdens.
* Ensure robust operational readiness, support processes and service management controls are established prior to go\-live.
* Ensure robust compliance with Information and Cybersecurity standards and directives


**Commercial \& Vendor Management**
* Work closely with Procurement and Commercial teams to support infrastructure\-related vendor selection, contracting and mobilisation activities.
* Manage infrastructure delivery partners and suppliers against agreed scope, timelines and quality expectations.
* Review technical proposals and commercial options to ensure alignment with programme objectives and architecture standards.
* Monitor vendor performance, deliverables and issue resolution throughout the lifecycle of the programme.


**Governance \& Reporting**
* Input to RAID Logs and status updates to the Programme Director and Steering Committee.
* Escalate key risks, decisions and dependencies in a timely manner.
* Support executive reporting and governance forums as required.


**Experience \& Qualifications**
* 10\+ years' experience leading enterprise infrastructure, network or cloud transformation programmes.
* Proven experience delivering complex infrastructure initiatives.
* Strong understanding of cloud infrastructure, networking, IT operations, service management and managed service operating models.
* Experience managing system integrators, outsourcing providers and technology partners.
* Strong stakeholder management skills across technical, business and executive audiences.
* Demonstrated experience managing delivery across multiple interdependent workstreams.
* Experience within engineering, construction, EPC, energy or industrial sectors.
* Desirable

description:
PROJECT ENGINEER – COMMERCIAL INTERIORS
 



 Industry: Commercial Interiors \| Glass \& Aluminium Works
 



 Department: Projects
 



 Employment Type: Full\-Time \| On\-Site
 



 Experience: 3–6 Years
 



 Locations: Chennai \& Mumbai
 



 Openings: 1 – Chennai \| 1 – Mumbai
 



 Salary: ₹5–6 LPA – Chennai \| ₹6–7 LPA – Mumbai
 



 Travel: PAN India project travel as required
 



 JOB SUMMARY
 



 We are looking for a hands\-on Project Engineer with 3–6 years of relevant experience in commercial interior projects, with strong exposure to glass partitions, aluminium works, interior fit\-outs, and on\-site project execution.
 



 The candidate will be responsible for day\-to\-day site execution, manpower and subcontractor coordination, project progress and quality monitoring, material and drawing coordination, and communication with clients, consultants, vendors, and other project stakeholders.
 



 KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
 



 Project Execution \& Coordination
 


* Plan and supervise daily site execution as per approved drawings, specifications, and project schedules.
* Coordinate with project managers, design teams, subcontractors, vendors, clients, and consultants.
* Monitor manpower, productivity, work fronts, and project progress.
* Identify site constraints and coordinate timely resolution.
* Participate in site meetings and provide progress updates.



 Technical \& Drawing Coordination
 


* Read and interpret architectural and shop drawings.
* Coordinate drawing clarifications and raise RFIs/technical queries.
* Verify site dimensions, levels, alignment, plumb, and finishing.
* Identify discrepancies between drawings and actual site conditions.
* Coordinate material requirements based on drawings and site progress.



 Glass \& Aluminium Works
 


* Supervise installation of single and double\-glazed glass partitions.
* Manage aluminium\-framed partitions and related systems.
* Supervise glass and DG doors, solid and honeycomb shutters, stile doors, and related systems.
* Ensure proper installation of glass, aluminium profiles, hardware, joints, sealants, and finishing.



 Manpower \& Subcontractor Management
 


* Plan and allocate manpower according to project priorities.
* Supervise site supervisors, installers, workers, and subcontractors.
* Monitor workmanship, productivity, and work quality.
* Coordinate subcontractors to ensure timely project completion.



 Material, Quality \& Safety
 


* Prepare material requirements based on drawings and site progress.
* Coordinate with procurement and stores teams for material availability.
* Check incoming materials against approved specifications and samples.
* Monitor material usage, wastage, storage, and handling.
* Conduct regular site quality inspections.
* Track and close NCRs, observations, and punch points.
* Ensure compliance with site HSE requirements and proper PPE usage.
* Ensure safe handling, movement, and installation of glass.



 Planning, Reporting \& Billing
 


* Prepare daily and weekly work plans and Daily Progress Reports (DPR).
* Track progress against project schedules.
* Maintain manpower, material, measurement, and productivity records.
* Maintain RFIs, inspection requests, drawing registers, NCR records, site photographs, and handover documentation.
* Take accurate site measurements and verify executed quantities.
* Support RA bills and subcontractor billing.
* Track variations and additional works.



 REQUIRED QUALIFICATION \& EXPERIENCE
 


* Diploma / B.E. / B.Tech in Civil Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related discipline.
* 3–6 years of relevant experience in commercial interiors, interior fit\-out, glass partition, aluminium works, façade, or commercial construction.
* Commercial interiors experience is mandatory.
* Project coordination experience is mandatory.
* Strong hands\-on on\-site project execution experience.
* Experience coordinating manpower, subcontractors, materials, drawings, and site activities.
* Experience in glass partition and aluminium works is strongly preferred.
* Willingness to work on\-site and travel across India as required.



 REQUIRED TECHNICAL SKILLS
 


* Commercial interior fit\-out
* Glass partition systems
* Single and double glazing
* Toughened and laminated glass
* Aluminium profiles and framing
* Glass and DG doors
* Door hardware and accessories
* Silicone and sealant applications
* Basic AutoCAD drawing reading
* Site measurement and quantity calculation
* Project planning and site execution
* Quality inspection and basic site safety



 IDEAL CANDIDATE
 



 A technically sound and proactive Project Engineer who can independently handle commercial interior site execution and project coordination, while effectively managing drawings, manpower, subcontractors, materials, quality, progress, measurements, and stakeholder communication.
 



 LOCATION: Chennai \& Mumbai
 



 EXPERIENCE: 3–6 Years
 



 SALARY: ₹5–6 LPA – Chennai \| ₹6–7 LPA – Mumbai
 



 EMPLOYMENT TYPE: Full\-Time \| On\-Site
 



 Interested candidates can apply with their updated CV.

title: Manager, Software Engineering
description:
**Company Overview**
 KLA is a global leader in diversified electronics for the semiconductor manufacturing ecosystem. Virtually every electronic device in the world is produced using our technologies. No laptop, smartphone, wearable device, voice\-controlled gadget, flexible screen, VR device or smart car would have made it into your hands without us. KLA invents systems and solutions for the manufacturing of wafers and reticles, integrated circuits, packaging, printed circuit boards and flat panel displays. The innovative ideas and devices that are advancing humanity all begin with inspiration, research and development. KLA focuses more than average on innovation and we invest 15% of sales back into R\&D. Our expert teams of physicists, engineers, data scientists and problem\-solvers work together with the world’s leading technology providers to accelerate the delivery of tomorrow’s electronic devices. Life here is exciting and our teams thrive on tackling really hard problems. There is never a dull moment with us.
   

  

**Group/Division**
 With over 40 years of semiconductor process control experience, chipmakers around the globe rely on KLA to ensure that their fabs ramp next\-generation devices to volume production quickly and cost\-effectively. Enabling the movement towards advanced chip design, KLA's Global Products Group (GPG), which is responsible for creating all of KLA’s metrology and inspection products, is looking for the best and the brightest research scientist, software engineers, application development engineers, and senior product technology process engineers. The LS\-SWIFT Division of KLA’s Global Products Group provides patterned wafer inspection systems for high\-volume semiconductor manufacturing. Its mission is to deliver market\-leading cost of ownership in defect detection for a broad range of applications in the production of semiconductors. Customers from the foundry, logic, memory, automotive, MEMS, advanced packaging and other markets rely upon high\-sample wafer inspection information generated by LS\-SWIFT products. LS (Laser Scanning) systems enable cost\-effective patterned wafer defect detection for the industry’s most sophisticated process technologies deployed in leading\-edge foundry, logic, DRAM, and NAND fabs. SWIFT (Simultaneous Wafer Inspection at Fast Throughput) systems deliver all\-wafer\-surface (frontside, backside, and edge) macro inspection that is critical for automotive IC, MEMS, and advanced packaging processes as well as foundry/logic and memory fabs. LS\-SWIFT operates from a global footprint that includes the US, Singapore, India and Germany, and serves a worldwide customer base across Asia, Europe and North America.
   

  

**Job Description/Preferred Qualifications**
**Key Responsibilities:**
* Strategic Leadership: Define and drive the long\-term vision and roadmap for distributed IMC software infrastructure supporting image computing clusters.
* Team Development: Build, mentor, and grow a high\-performing team of software engineers and technical leaders.
* Cross\-functional Collaboration: Partner with product, hardware, and algorithm teams to align infrastructure capabilities with evolving image processing and AI requirements.
* Platform Architecture: Oversee the design and implementation of scalable, fault\-tolerant distributed systems optimized for hybrid CPU/GPU workloads.
* Lifecycle Management: Lead the end\-to\-end development of image computing platforms, from requirements gathering through deployment and maintenance, using best\-in\-class project management practices.
* Developer Enablement: Deliver robust software platforms and tools that empower engineers to develop, test, and deploy new image processing and deep learning algorithms efficiently.
* Innovation in Hybrid Computing: Spearhead the integration of traditional image processing and AI/DL techniques into a unified hybrid computing architecture, leveraging modern HPC technologies.


**Qualifications:**
* Education:
+ Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related technical field.

* Experience:
+ 10\+ years of experience in software engineering
+ Proven track record in building and scaling distributed systems, preferably in HPC or cloud\-native environments.
+ Experience with image processing, computer vision, or AI/ML infrastructure is highly desirable.

* Technical Skills:
+ Deep Understanding of distributed computing frameworks \& Linux Systems Programming
+ Proficiency in C\+\+, Python, and/or other systems programming languages.
+ Working knowledge of container technologies, orchestration frameworks (e.g., Kubernetes), and workflow automation.
+ Familiarity with GPU computing and hybrid CPU/GPU architectures.
+ Strong grasp of software development best practices, CI/CD, and DevOps principles.

* Leadership \& Communication:
+ Demonstrated ability to lead and drive functional teams.
+ Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.

description:
**WorkNEXT AI Transformation Head**
**Role Summary**
 The WorkNEXT AI Tech Expert is the technical ambassador for WorkNEXT AI modules—owning end\-to\-end client engagement, discovery, solution design, demos, pilots, and technical enablement. This role translates business pain points into pragmatic AI solutions, drives adoption and outcomes, and partners with product, engineering, and customer success to ensure WorkNEXT deployments deliver measurable value at scale.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Client Engagement \& Solutioning**
* Lead technical conversations with enterprise clients: discovery, requirements analysis, solution architecture, and value mapping.
* Conduct tailored demos and hands\-on workshops for WorkNEXT AI modules (e.g., workflows, assistants, analytics, automation).
* Design proof\-of\-concepts (POCs) and pilot plans, including success criteria, data readiness, and deployment approach.
* Translate business needs into AI\-driven use cases and solution designs (incl. integrations, data pipelines, governance).


**Technical Ownership**
* Build reference architectures and implementation playbooks for WorkNEXT AI modules across common enterprise stacks.
* Partner with engineering to scope features, validate feasibility, and drive technical issue resolution.
* Configure and optimize WorkNEXT AI models and workflows (prompt strategies, orchestration, guardrails, evaluation).
* Ensure compliance with security, privacy, and responsible AI standards; coordinate with InfoSec and legal teams.


**Customer Success \& Enablement**
* Create client\-facing technical collateral: solution briefs, runbooks, FAQs, architecture diagrams, ROI calculators.
* Train client admins and super\-users; develop enablement plans and adoption campaigns.
* Monitor post\-deployment health: performance metrics, drift, model evaluation, user feedback loops.


**Cross\-Functional Collaboration**
* Capture client feedback and market signals to inform product roadmap and prioritization.
* Collaborate with Sales/Pre\-Sales for deal strategy, estimates, and RFP responses.
* Work with Data Engineering and Integration teams to ensure robust pipelines and API/connector reliability.


**Required Skills \& Competencies**
**Technical**
* Strong understanding of AI/ML foundations: NLP, LLMs, retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG), prompt engineering, model evaluation.
* Experience with cloud platforms (Azure/AWS/GCP), containerization (Docker/Kubernetes), and API integration patterns (REST, GraphQL, webhooks).
* Knowledge of data pipelines (ETL/ELT), vector databases/embeddings, and observability of AI systems.
* Familiarity with enterprise security, compliance, and responsible AI (RBAC, PII handling, auditability, human\-in\-the\-loop).
* Ability to create architecture diagrams, deployment runbooks, and performance monitoring strategies.


**Client\-Facing**
* Exceptional communication—can simplify complex AI concepts for non\-technical stakeholders.
* Consultative approach—discovery, problem framing, value story, and objection handling.
* Strong demo presence; comfortable tailoring demos to industry verticals and role personas.
* Negotiation and stakeholder management across business, IT, InfoSec, and procurement.


**Mindset**
* Outcome\-oriented: focuses on measurable business impact, not just features.
* Curious and experimental: rapid prototyping, A/B testing, iterative improvement.
* Ownership and accountability: proactive risk management, transparent communication.


**Qualifications**
* 6–10\+ years in Client\-Facing Technical roles (e.g., Solutions Architect, Pre\-Sales Engineer, AI Consultant).
* 3\+ years hands\-on with AI/ML, LLM applications, or automation platforms.
* Bachelor’s/Master’s in Computer Science, Data Science, Engineering, or equivalent experience.
* Experience in at least one enterprise vertical (e.g., BFSI, Manufacturing, Retail, Healthcare) is a plus.
* Certifications in cloud/AI (Azure AI Engineer, AWS ML Specialty, GCP ML Engineer) preferred.


**Typical WorkNEXT AI Use\-Case Areas (Adjust to your modules)**
* Knowledge assistant with RAG for policy/SOP retrieval, multilingual Q\&A.
* Process automation: ticket triage, claim summarization, email drafting, task routing.
* Insight generation: summarization of meetings/chats, trend analysis, risk alerts.
* Employee experience: HR policy assistant, IT helpdesk copilot, onboarding flows.
* Compliance \& governance: redaction, PII detection, audit\-ready conversation logs.


**Tools \& Tech Stack (Illustrative)**
* Cloud \& Infra: Azure (OpenAI, Cognitive Search), AWS (Bedrock, Sagemaker), GCP (Vertex AI).
* Data: Databricks/Snowflake/BigQuery; ETL tools (ADF, Airflow), vector stores (Pinecone, FAISS).
* Integration: REST/GraphQL APIs, iPaaS (MuleSoft, Boomi), event buses (Kafka).
* Observability \& Evaluation: Prometheus/Grafana, MLflow, human eval tooling, prompt/version management.
* Security: OAuth2/OIDC, RBAC, KMS, DLP; Responsible AI guardrails \& content filters.

title: EY - GDS Consulting - AIA - Mainframe - Manager
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

**The opportunity**
 We are seeking an experienced Manager – Mainframe Modernization to lead our AI\-Driven Legacy Transformation practice. The ideal candidate will bring deep expertise across mainframe ecosystems, AI/ML\-driven modernization strategies, and cloud technologies, combined with strong leadership, stakeholder management, and team\-building capabilities to deliver large\-scale digital transformation programmes.
   

  

 You will own the end\-to\-end modernization strategy, drive cross\-functional collaboration with C\-suite leaders, business stakeholders, and architecture teams, and lead a team of engineers and specialists to successfully migrate mission\-critical mainframe workloads to modern, scalable, cloud\-native platforms using AI\-powered automation frameworks.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
**Technical Excellence:**
* Strategic Leadership and Stakeholder Management
+ Define and own the mainframe modernization strategy aligned with business objectives and enterprise technology roadmaps.
+ Collaborate with senior stakeholders, business leaders, and architecture teams to prioritise modernization initiatives and secure executive buy\-in.
+ Evaluate and recommend modernization paths — rehosting, refactoring, rebuilding, or replacing — based on cost\-benefit analysis, risk assessment, and business impact.

* Mainframe Systems Assessment and Governance
+ Oversee comprehensive assessments of mainframe applications (COBOL, JCL, VSAM, DB2, CICS, IMS, Assembler) to identify modernization opportunities, risks, and dependencies.
+ Establish governance frameworks, quality gates, and standards for modernization delivery across the portfolio.
+ Drive technical debt identification, quantification, and systematic reduction across the legacy estate.

* AI\-Driven Modernization and Automation
+ Champion the adoption of AI tools, LLMs, and custom AI agentic workflows for automated code analysis, refactoring, and code translation at scale.
+ Define and operationalise AI pipelines, prompt engineering standards, and context engineering best practices to maximise modernization throughput and accuracy.
+ Evaluate emerging AI/ML technologies and integrate them into the modernization toolchain to maintain competitive advantage.

* Team Leadership and Capability Building
+ Lead, mentor, and grow a team of mainframe modernization engineers, developers, and analysts.
+ Build team capabilities in AI\-driven modernization, cloud\-native development, and DevOps practices.
+ Conduct architecture reviews, code reviews, and provide technical guidance to ensure delivery excellence.

* Target\-State Architecture – APIs and Microservices
+ Architect and oversee the design of target\-state systems, including API integrations, microservices, and event\-driven architectures.
+ Ensure modernized solutions are scalable, resilient, and aligned with enterprise architecture standards.

* Cloud and Platform Integration
+ Lead the migration of mainframe workloads to cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud) using AI\-driven and automated solutions.
+ Ensure seamless integration of legacy systems with cloud\-native services, containerised deployments (Docker, Kubernetes), and CI/CD pipelines.
+ Drive adoption of infrastructure\-as\-code, observability, and security best practices for modernized workloads.

* Reporting, Documentation, and Business Impact
+ Create and present executive\-level reporting on modernization progress, business impact, risks, and ROI.
+ Maintain comprehensive technical documentation including system designs, AI pipeline architectures, and modernization roadmaps.
+ Track and communicate KPIs related to migration velocity, quality, cost savings, and operational efficiency.


**Skills and Attributes:**
* Educational Background
* Bachelor / master’s degree in computer science, AI, Any Engineering or quantitative background preferred.


**Professional Experience**
* 10\+ years of experience with legacy mainframe systems (COBOL, JCL, Assembler, CICS, DB2, IMS, VSAM) with at least 3–4 years in a leadership or managerial capacity.
* Proven track record of leading large\-scale mainframe modernization or digital transformation programmes.
* Deep expertise in data migration, integration, ETL, and cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud).
* Strong proficiency in programming/scripting languages (Python, Java, etc.).
* Expert\-level knowledge of APIs, microservices architecture, and containerization (Docker, Kubernetes).
* Extensive experience with AI tools, LLM API calls, prompt engineering, and context engineering for automating code analysis and modernization workflows.
* Experience with enterprise modernization platforms (Micro Focus, AWS Mainframe Modernization, Azure Migrate, Google Cloud Dual Run) is a plus.
* Hands\-on experience building or managing AI/ML pipelines for code transformation at scale.


**Soft Skills**
* Exceptional client engagement and stakeholder management skills.
* Strong problem\-solving skills with the ability to translate complex business requirements into practical, high\-quality technical solutions.
* Excellent communication, presentation, and leadership abilities.
* Experience with Agile/SAFe delivery methodologies and managing distributed/global teams.


**Preferred Certifications**
* Cloud certifications (AWS/Azure/GCP), AI/ML certifications, enterprise architecture (TOGAF), or mainframe\-related certifications are a plus.


**Why Join Us**
* Be at the forefront of AI\-driven mainframe modernization across enterprise clients.
* Work with global clients to drive real business impact through large\-scale digital transformation.
* Collaborate with a team of modernization experts, AI specialists, and industry leaders in a highly innovative and entrepreneurial environment.


**What We Offer**
 EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is a dynamic and truly global delivery network. We work across six locations – Argentina, China, India, the Philippines, Poland and the UK – and with teams from all EY service lines, serving our clients locally and globally with innovation and at scale.
   

  

* Continuous learning: You'll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.
* Success as defined by you: We'll provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a meaningful impact, your way.
* Transformative leadership: We'll give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.
* Diverse and inclusive culture: You'll be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.


**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long\-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
   

  

 Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
   

  

 Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

 : IFSO
   

  

**About Business Line/Function**
 The role sits within the Program STAR in DAAS department within Client Delivery of BNP Paribas Securities Services. Data As A Service (DAAS) is a service offered by BNP Paribas to solve some of the data challenges our clients have by providing an enriched view of their investments. This involves taking feeds from external data administrators and custodians and supplementing these with interfaces allowing proxies, look through, supplementary market data and application of business rules and controls. This ultimately gives clients their investment data in the format and with the detail they need to effectively support their investment process and decisions
   

  

**Position Purpose**
 The role is for an opening in a service delivered by BNP Paribas to clients, based on ‘DaaS’ (Data as a Service). This allows BNP Paribas to solve some of the data challenges our clients have by providing an enriched view of their investments. This involves taking feeds from external data administrators and custodians and supplementing these with interfaces allowing proxies, look through, supplementary market data and application of business rules and controls. This ultimately gives clients their investment data in the format and with the details they need to effectively support their investment process and decisions.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
 Direct Responsibilities
   

  

* Manage the roadmap, plan delivery and capacity, and keep stakeholders and the client informed with clear, effective documentation.
* Coordinate collaboration between the IT/Ops team and product stakeholders.
* Propose and implement appropriate governance for the migration strategy, collaborating with stakeholders to ensure a high level of support from NeoXam.
* Communicate all cost figures related to the migration and provide details on the current production environment and the transition to the new data access solution.
* Help define the migration backlog together with the project team and the NeoXam implementation team.
* Contribute to designing the operating model
* Continuously adapt and update the client migration strategy in response to new developments and events.
* Manage arbitration and conflict resolution among stakeholders.
* Oversee client interactions, especially during the parallel run phase, ensuring smooth coordination.
* Monitor the client specific roadmap and work to reduce customizations, thereby promoting standardization.
* Schedule and coordinate release planning so that delivery timelines are met.
* Lead and organize meetings, providing support materials and distributing minutes promptly.
* Deliver migration updates across various governance forums (e.g., steering committee, control committee).
* Communicate roadmap changes to external departments and keep them informed of progress.
* Engage with local operations teams and other stakeholders to establish the appropriate organizational structure.
* Attend client meetings when needed to represent the project and convey its status.
* Inform external departments about the specific products slated for migration and present a gap analysis that covers functional, process, and cost differences between the legacy and new production environments.


 Contributing Responsibilities
   

  

* Back log review and demo selectivity
* Follow up of the development delivery of products and solutions specifics by clients.
* Follow up of the specific developments to assure the consistency of the client’s requirements and the planning of delivery


**Technical \& Behavioral Competencies**
* Proven Project Management skills
* Should have managed and led transitions in a similar setup (Securities Services) either in a captive / third party environment and transitioned Operations from overseas to India
* Strong interpersonal communication and coaching skills, capable of explaining, teaching, training in a highly effective manner
* Strong People Management skills


**Specific Qualifications**
* PMP / Prince 2 / ACP certified (highly preferred)


**Transversal Skills**
**Skills Referential**

* 
+ Ability to understand, explain and support change


* 
+ Ability to manage / facilitate a meeting, seminar, committee, training…


* 
+ Ability to manage a project


* 
+ Ability to develop and adapt a process


* 
+ Ability to develop and leverage networks


**Behavioral Skills**
* 
+ Organization Skills
+ Ability to synthetize / simplify

* 
+ Ability to collaborate / Teamwork
+ Creativity \& Innovation / Problem solving


**Education Level:** 
 Bachelor Degree or equivalent
   

  

**Location:** 
 India, Chennai
   

  

**About BNP Paribas Group**
 BNP Paribas is the European Union’s leading bank and key player in international banking. It operates in 65 countries and has nearly 185,000 employees, including more than 145,000 in Europe. The Group has key positions in its three main fields of activity: Commercial, Personal Banking \& Services for the Group’s commercial \& personal banking and several specialized businesses including BNP Paribas Personal Finance and Arval; Investment \& Protection Services for savings, investment, and protection solutions; and Corporate \& Institutional Banking, focused on corporate and institutional clients. Based on its strong diversified and integrated model, the Group helps all its clients (individuals, community associations, entrepreneurs, SMEs, corporate and institutional clients) to realize their projects through solutions spanning financing, investment, savings and protection insurance.
