title: Technical Project Manager Microsoft
description:
Technical Project Manager – Microsoft Power Platform \& Enterprise Applications
 



 Company: Techworkstalent Pvt. Ltd.
 



 Location: Chennai / India
 



 Work Mode: Full\-time
 



 Experience: 7–12 Years
 



 Employment Type: Full\-time
 



 About Techworkstalent
 



 Techworkstalent is an technology solutions company delivering enterprise application development, automation, CRM, low\-code/no\-code and digital transformation solutions to customers across India and international markets.
 



 We are expanding our enterprise technology delivery practice and are looking for an experienced Technical Project Manager who can lead complex application development and digital transformation projects involving Microsoft Power Platform, enterprise integrations, AI/Copilot, CRM, workflow automation and low\-code platforms.
 



 Role Overview
 



 The Technical Project Manager will be responsible for the end\-to\-end delivery of technology projects, from requirement discovery and solution planning through development, testing, deployment and post\-production support.
 



 The role requires a combination of:
 


* Strong project management
* Technical understanding
* Client/stakeholder management
* Agile delivery
* Team leadership
* Risk and dependency management
* Commercial and scope control



 The ideal candidate should be technically strong enough to understand architecture discussions, review estimates and challenge technical assumptions, while being commercially and operationally strong enough to own the overall delivery.
 



  





  





 Key Responsibilities
 



 1\. End\-to\-End Project Ownership
 


* Own the project from kick\-off to successful production deployment.
* Define project scope, objectives, deliverables, milestones and timelines.
* Develop and maintain detailed project plans.
* Establish project governance and reporting mechanisms.
* Track project progress against agreed timelines, scope and budget.
* Ensure all project deliverables are completed on time and to agreed quality standards.
* Manage multiple projects/workstreams simultaneously when required.



  





 2\. Technical Project Management
 



 Work closely with Solution Architects, Developers, Business Analysts, QA Engineers and Integration Specialists to ensure technical delivery is aligned with the approved solution.
 



 The PM should be able to understand and coordinate projects involving:
 


* Microsoft Power Apps
* Microsoft Dataverse
* Power Automate
* Copilot Studio / AI Agents
* REST API integrations
* SQL / relational databases
* SharePoint
* Microsoft 365
* CRM platforms
* Workflow automation
* Low\-code/no\-code platforms
* Cloud applications
* Third\-party enterprise applications



 You are not expected to be the primary developer, but you should be technically strong enough to understand what is being built, how it is being built, the dependencies involved and whether the proposed timeline is realistic.
 



  





 3\. Requirement \& Scope Management
 


* Work with clients and Business Analysts to understand business requirements.
* Participate in requirement workshops and solution discussions.
* Convert business requirements into actionable technical workstreams.
* Ensure requirements are documented and approved.
* Identify gaps, ambiguities and dependencies early.
* Control scope throughout the project lifecycle.
* Manage Change Requests and assess their impact on:
* Cost
* Timeline
* Resources
* Architecture
* Delivery risk



  





 4\. Project Planning \& Estimation
 


* Work with technical leads to prepare project estimates.
* Validate effort estimates and delivery assumptions.
* Build project schedules and resource plans.
* Identify critical\-path activities.
* Define development, integration, testing and deployment milestones.
* Track actual effort against estimated effort.
* Highlight potential overruns early and recommend corrective action.



  





 5\. Team Management
 



 Lead cross\-functional technology teams consisting of:
 


* Solution Architects
* Power Platform Developers
* Software Developers
* Integration Developers
* AI/Copilot Developers
* Business Analysts
* QA Engineers
* UI/UX resources
* DevOps / Cloud engineers



 Responsibilities include:
 


* Assigning tasks and ownership.
* Monitoring individual and team productivity.
* Removing delivery blockers.
* Conducting project reviews.
* Ensuring clear accountability.
* Managing resource utilization.
* Escalating performance or capability issues when required.



  





 6\. Agile Delivery
 


* Conduct Agile ceremonies including:
* Sprint Planning
* Daily Stand\-ups
* Sprint Reviews
* Retrospectives
* Backlog Refinement
* Maintain product/project backlog.
* Track sprint commitments and velocity.
* Ensure stories have clear acceptance criteria.
* Monitor sprint progress and impediments.
* Coordinate releases across development, QA and production environments.



 Experience with Jira, Azure DevOps, Monday.com or similar project management tools is preferred.
 



  





 7\. Client \& Stakeholder Management
 



 Act as the primary delivery interface between Techworkstalent and the client.
 


* Conduct regular project status meetings.
* Present project progress, risks and dependencies.
* Manage client expectations.
* Communicate delays and corrective actions proactively.
* Handle escalations professionally.
* Coordinate requirement clarifications with client stakeholders.
* Obtain approvals/sign\-offs at appropriate project milestones.
* Build strong relationships with client technology and business teams.



 The candidate must be comfortable interacting with CXO\-level stakeholders, IT heads, business leaders and enterprise technology teams.
 



  





 8\. Risk \& Dependency Management
 


* Maintain project RAID logs.
* Identify risks before they become delivery issues.
* Track:
* Risks
* Assumptions
* Issues
* Dependencies
* Decisions
* Develop mitigation and contingency plans.
* Escalate critical risks to leadership in a timely manner.
* Monitor cross\-team and third\-party dependencies.



  





 9\. Quality \& Delivery Governance
 


* Ensure development follows agreed technical and coding standards.
* Coordinate with QA to establish testing plans.
* Track SIT, UAT and production readiness.
* Ensure defects are appropriately prioritized and resolved.
* Coordinate UAT sign\-off.
* Ensure deployment readiness checklists are completed.
* Coordinate production releases and hypercare.
* Conduct project closure and lessons\-learned reviews.



  





 10\. Commercial \& Financial Management
 



 The Technical Project Manager will also have responsibility for protecting project commercials.
 


* Track project effort against approved estimates.
* Monitor resource utilization.
* Identify scope creep.
* Flag potential margin erosion.
* Support Change Request estimation.
* Work with management on billing milestones and deliverables.
* Ensure projects are delivered within approved commercial parameters.



  





  





 Required Technical Skills
 



 Must Have
 


* 7\+ years of experience in software/technology project delivery.
* 3\+ years of experience managing technical projects.
* Strong understanding of software development lifecycle.
* Experience managing enterprise application development projects.
* Experience working with Agile/Scrum methodologies.
* Strong understanding of APIs and system integrations.
* Understanding of databases and data models.
* Understanding of cloud applications and enterprise architecture.
* Experience managing developers, QA and technical teams.
* Strong client\-facing communication skills.



 Strongly Preferred
 



 Experience with one or more of:
 


* Microsoft Power Platform
* Power Apps
* Dataverse
* Power Automate
* Microsoft Copilot Studio
* Azure
* Microsoft 365
* CRM implementations
* Zoho / Salesforce / Dynamics
* Low\-code/no\-code platforms
* AI/GenAI application projects
* Enterprise API integrations



 The candidate does not need to be an expert developer, but should be technically conversant in these areas.
 



  





  





 Project Management Skills
 


* Agile / Scrum
* Waterfall / Hybrid delivery
* Project planning
* Resource planning
* Estimation
* Risk management
* Change management
* Scope management
* Stakeholder management
* Vendor management
* UAT management
* Release management
* Project reporting
* Budget/effort tracking



 Tools
 



 Experience with:
 


* Jira
* Azure DevOps
* Microsoft Teams
* Confluence
* MS Project
* Monday.com
* Zoho Projects or similar tools



  





  





 Documentation \& Reporting
 



 The candidate should be comfortable preparing and maintaining:
 


* Project plans
* Schedules
* RAID logs
* Status reports
* Sprint reports
* Resource plans
* Requirement trackers
* Risk registers
* Change Requests
* Meeting minutes
* UAT plans
* Deployment checklists
* Project closure reports



  





  





 Qualifications
 


* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering or a related discipline.
* PMP / PRINCE2 / Scrum Master certification is an advantage.
* Microsoft Power Platform certification is an advantage.
* Relevant technical certifications are preferred.



  





  





 Ideal Candidate Profile
 



 We are looking for someone who is not just a project coordinator.
 



 The ideal candidate should be able to walk into a client meeting, understand the business requirement, participate meaningfully in the technical discussion, question unrealistic estimates, identify delivery risks, coordinate the technical team and communicate the situation clearly to management.
 



 You should be comfortable moving between:
 



 Client → Business Requirement → Solution Architecture → Development → QA → UAT → Production
 



 and ensuring that nothing falls through the gaps.
 



 You should have a strong ownership mindset and be comfortable saying:
 



 "This is the requirement, this is the proposed solution, these are the dependencies, this is the effort, this is the risk, and this is what we need to do to deliver it successfully."
 



  





 Key Success Metrics
 



 Success in this role will be measured by:
 


* On\-time project delivery
* Delivery within approved scope
* Project profitability/margin protection
* Client satisfaction
* Resource utilization
* Reduction in delivery escalations
* Quality of deliverables
* Effective risk management
* Successful UAT and production deployment
* Repeat business / expansion opportunities from existing clients

title: Program Manager II, Global Catalog Operations
description:
**Description**
 Amazon.com operates in a global eCommerce environment without boundaries, and operates a diverse set of businesses worldwide, including Retail, third party marketplaces, eCommerce platforms, web services for developers.
   

  

 The Amazon product catalog is a set of records; each record being a set of facts describing a physical or digital product. These records are often organized by defined relationships (e.g. variations such as different sizes of the same shoe). Our ability to provide a good product discovery experience and empower our customers to make well informed purchase decisions is dependent on the quality of our product catalog. In a high quality catalog, every product is described with a complete, structured, accurate and correctly normalized set of facts. Every product is represented by a unique record appropriately related to one another.
   

  

 The Global catalog operations (GCO) team is part of Amazon Selection \& Catalog services (ASCS) teams in India focus on leveraging human intelligence, external or internal, to measure and improve the quality of the catalog: Global catalog operations (GCO) charter is to make Catalog engineering programs more effective by providing expert human judgment. Catalog Operations from its inception has been partnering with engineering teams to run programs focused on improving the data quality of catalog in all market places.
   

  

 We are seeking a highly organized, detail\-oriented Program Manager to join our rapidly growing team. The role is centered on developing insights and eliminating defects in quality that affects business metrics. As part of this role, you will work on 1\) Creating mechanisms to identify, investigate, and solve quality issues impacting the business metrics, 2\) Working collaboratively across our partner teams (ex: Science, PMs, Engineering, Business, etc.) to combine efforts to solve problems, 3\) Developing data\-driven approaches alongside our SWOT/BA teams to rapidly identify opportunity areas, and trends at scale, 4\) You will take complex opportunities and break them down into manageable pieces, then ensure timely delivery of solutions.

* Drive appropriate data\-oriented analysis, adoption of technology solutions and process improvement projects to achieve operational and business goal
* Communicate and take the lead role in identifying Gaps in process areas and work with all stakeholders to resolve the gaps

description:
At Alstom, we understand transport networks and what moves people. From high\-speed trains, metros, monorails, and trams, to turnkey systems, services, infrastructure, signalling and digital mobility, we offer our diverse customers the broadest portfolio in the industry.  Take on a new challenge and apply your leadership and project management expertise in a cutting\-edge field. You’ll work alongside collaborative and dynamic teammates.
   

  

 You'll play a key role in driving the execution of projects with low criticality, ensuring contractual requirements and customer expectations are met while optimizing financial performance. Day\-to\-day, you’ll work closely with teams across the business (Project Core Team, Customer Director, Support Functions), define project strategies, and lead project activities from transfer to close\-out, and much more.
   

  

 You’ll specifically take care of project governance and stakeholder coordination, but also ensure compliance with applicable standards and proactively manage risks and opportunities.

* Proactively managing risks, savings, and opportunities to optimize project outcomes.

 We value passion and attitude over experience. That’s why we don’t expect you to have every single skill. Instead, we’ve listed some that we think will help you succeed and grow in this role:
   

  

* Master’s degree or bachelor’s degree in a relevant field.

* Knowledge of project management processes and railway products and systems.
* Strong skills in team management, communication, and negotiation.
* Leadership, entrepreneurial mindset, and a results\-oriented approach.
* IPMA Level C certification (or equivalent) is desirable.

 Join us on a life\-long transformative journey – the rail industry is here to stay, so you can grow and develop new skills and experiences throughout your career. You’ll also:

* Collaborate with transverse teams and supportive colleagues.
* Contribute to innovative projects that shape the future of mobility.
* Utilise our flexible and inclusive working environment.
* Steer your career in whatever direction you choose across functions and countries.
* Benefit from our investment in your development, through award\-winning learning programs.
* Progress towards senior leadership roles or other areas of interest.
* Benefit from a fair and dynamic reward package that recognises your performance and potential, plus comprehensive and competitive social coverage (life, medical, pension).


 You don’t need to be a train enthusiast to thrive with us. We guarantee that when you step onto one of our trains with your friends or family, you’ll be proud. If you’re up for the challenge, we’d love to hear from you!

title: Manager II Program Management, Global Catalog Operations
description:
**Description**
 Amazon.com operates in a global eCommerce environment without boundaries, and operates a diverse set of businesses worldwide, including Retail, third party marketplaces, eCommerce platforms, web services for developers.
   

  

 The Amazon product catalog is a set of records; each record being a set of facts describing a physical or digital product. These records are often organized by defined relationships (e.g. variations such as different sizes of the same shoe). Our ability to provide a good product discovery experience and empower our customers to make well informed purchase decisions is dependent on the quality of our product catalog. In a high quality catalog, every product is described with a complete, structured, accurate and correctly normalized set of facts. Every product is represented by a unique record appropriately related to one another.
   

  

 The Global catalog operations (GCO) team is part of Amazon Selection \& Catalog services (ASCS) teams in India focus on leveraging human intelligence, external or internal, to measure and improve the quality of the catalog: Global catalog operations (GCO) charter is to make Catalog engineering programs more effective by providing expert human judgment. Catalog Operations from its inception has been partnering with engineering teams to run programs focused on improving the data quality of catalog in all market places.
   

  

 We are seeking an experienced people leader to join our rapidly growing team as a Manager II, Program Management. In this role you will build and lead a team of SMEs, auditors and Program Managers responsible for developing insights and eliminating quality defects that affect business metrics. You will own a portfolio of catalog quality programs rather than a single workstream, set the direction and mechanisms your team operates by, and be accountable for the aggregate delivery and business outcomes of the programs under you. As part of this role, you will 1\) hire, develop, and lead a team of auditors, SMES and program managers, growing the bench and the capability of the function, 2\) own a portfolio of quality programs, prioritizing across competing initiatives and allocating capacity to the highest impact opportunities, 3\) set the operating mechanisms, standards, and roadmap that make your team's programs measurable and repeatable, and 4\) work collaboratively across partner teams (Science, PMs, Engineering, Business, etc.) and represent catalog quality program management to senior leadership across GCO and partner orgs.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

**As a Manager II, Program Management You Will**
* Build, lead, and develop a team of auditors, SMEs and program managers, owning hiring, performance management, coaching, and career growth
* Own catalog quality programs, setting priorities across competing initiatives and allocating team capacity to the highest impact work
* Establish the operating mechanisms, standards, and roadmap that ensure your team's programs deliver measurable business and operational outcomes
* Be accountable for the aggregate delivery and business/operational metrics of the programs under your team
* Drive quantitative, data\-oriented decision making across the portfolio and champion the adoption of technology solutions and process improvements
* Communicate program progress, risks, and results to senior leadership, ensuring transparency and alignment with key business goals
* Identify systemic gaps across process areas and mobilize your team and stakeholders to resolve them
* Serve as an escalation point and senior partner for in\-house and customer teams across Science, Engineering, Product, and Business
* Ensure effective risk controls are developed and maintained across programs, with corrective actions that keep commitments on track and minimize losses
* Develop and influence new ideas, establishing procedures and practices that promote long\-term, scalable solutions in dynamic environments
* Drive continuous improvement and decision\-making strategies across the team and the broader function


**Basic Qualifications**
* 3\+ years of program or project management experience
* 3\+ years of working cross functionally with tech and non\-tech teams experience
* 3\+ years of delivering cross functional projects experience
* Experience defining program requirements and using data and metrics to determine improvements
* 5\+ years of team management experience


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience implementing repeatable processes and driving automation or standardization
* Experience in data mining, data management, reporting, and SQL queries

 At DevRev, we're building the future of work with
 *Computer*

 *Computer*

Backed by Khosla Ventures and Mayfield with $150M\+ raised, DevRev is trusted by global companies across industries.

 As a
 **Forward Deployed AI Strategist** 
 , you will serve as the lead technical strategist embedded with our customers. You'll own the end\-to\-end design of AI\-driven business transformation projects from understanding domain\-specific needs to architecting scalable agent\-based solutions using DevRev’s platform. This role requires a unique blend of enterprise architecture, AI solutioning, customer empathy, and cross\-functional collaboration. You’ll act as the connective tissue between pre\-sales, customer success, engineering, and product teams bringing our AI capabilities to life for real\-world impact.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
* Own Customer Context: Deeply understand customer business domains, systems, and OKRs/KPIs to guide solution design.
* Architect AI Transformation: Design and document AI\-driven workflows, agents, skills, and system integrations that align with customer goals and industry best practices.
* Be a Trusted Advisor: Build strong partnerships with customer stakeholders as their technical counterpart, delivering confidence in our platform’s capabilities.
* Translate \& Coordinate: Bridge the gap between pre\-sales/CS and engineering, ensuring requirements are actionable and outcomes measurable.
* Design Reusability: Architect modular, scalable solutions that can be extended across customers and verticals.
* Drive Delivery: Collaborate with Applied AI engineers to oversee solution implementation, ensuring architectural alignment and execution excellence.
* Support Pre\-Sales: Partner with sales engineers and customer teams to scope new opportunities, define technical requirements, and provide input on feasibility and effort.
* Lead Innovation: Stay ahead of emerging trends in AI, software integration, and business transformation—and bring that insight to our solution designs.
* Maintain Quality \& Compliance: Ensure all solutions meet performance, security, and compliance standards.


**What You'll Bring**
* Experience: 7\+ years in solution architecture or consulting roles, focused on enterprise\-scale, customer\-facing software implementations.
* AI \& Cloud: Hands\-on experience with generative AI tools, cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure), and modern integration patterns (APIs, webhooks, pipelines).
* Business Acumen: Strong understanding of customer priorities, with the ability to translate business needs into technical execution plans.
* Design Thinking: A problem\-solver with a growth mindset, skilled in crafting scalable and future\-proof architectures.
* Communication: Exceptional ability to convey complex technical and business concepts to diverse stakeholders, both technical and non\-technical.
* Project Leadership: Proficiency with project planning tools and methodologies; capable of managing multiple solution tracks and timelines.
* Metrics Focus: Proven ability to define and track success through OKRs, KPIs, and tangible business outcomes.
* SaaS \& Platform Fluency: Background in SaaS or enterprise platforms, with understanding of extensibility and multi\-tenant design principles.
* Education: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related discipline. Advanced degrees or certifications in AI/architecture frameworks (e.g., TOGAF, SAFe) are a plus.

 Core to Bechtel is our Vision, Values and Commitments. They are what we believe, what customers can expect, and how we deliver. Learn more about our extraordinary teams building inspiring projects in our Impact Report.
   

  

 Bechtel’s India offices support the execution of projects and services around the world. With offices in Gurgaon, Vadodara, and Chennai there are exciting career opportunities for candidates who are passionate about delivering projects that make a lasting, meaningful difference for people and communities around the world.
   

  

**Job Summary**
 In this role, you will work with the project team to prepare schedule data for proposals or contract negotiations. You will apply established unit job hour and pricing data, perform schedule integrations, prepare work logic, identify restraints and potential impacts, develop recovery plans, and evaluate subcontractor schedules for improvements. You will be instrumental in ensuring projects stay on track and on time.
   

  

**Major Responsibilities**
* Prepares schedule data for proposals or contract negotiations
* Establishes and maintains the schedule for a specific discipline area or specialty
* Performs schedule development duties to include establishing the work breakdown structure (WBS), determining the work activity duration, establishing the proper workflow logic ties, and developing the required job expenditure
* Performs schedule monitoring, including identifying critical activities and updating functions for specific applications, disciplines, or specialties
* Assists with maintenance of critical path schedule reports and schedule performance metrics
* Performs schedule analysis and studies of problem areas to determine criticality of schedule activities
* Monitors and validates subcontractor schedules
* Assists with schedule recovery plans
* Works on problems of diverse scope where analysis of data requires a review of a variety of factors
* Demonstrates judgment in selecting methods and techniques for obtaining solutions
* Networks and connects with internal and external personnel in own area of expertise


**Education And Experience Requirements**
* Requires bachelor's degree (or international equivalent) and 5\-8 years of relevant experience or 9\-12 years of relevant work experience
* Home office experience of minimum 3\-5 years as a scheduler/ planner in a large scale EPC project


**Required Knowledge And Skills**
* Experience in performing, monitoring, and reviewing planning and scheduling functions, which include schedule development, control, and analysis in EPC projects.
* Skilled in oral and written communication.
* Knowledge of engineering and construction management customarily acquired over time through specialized instruction or practical experience.
* Skilled in understanding technical processes, engineering drawings, quantity determinations, and financial reports.
* Proficiency with PC operating systems, including Primavera. Proficiency with multiple discipline\-specific software applications currently used (Microsoft Office Applications, for example)

description:

 Join EY and help to build a better working world.

 –
 **GRC Technology – Oracle GRC \- Senior**
**About Global Delivery Services**
 Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.
   

  

 Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000\+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.
   

  

 Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy \& Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high\-quality, value\-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.
   

  

 Enablement Services provides cost\-effective, high\-skilled, and innovative services to support EY’s global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.
   

  

 Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
   

  

**The Opportunity**
 We’re looking for people with expertise in
 **Oracle GRC Senior Consultant** 
 to join our
 **EY\-GDS GRC Technology Team** 
 . This is a fantastic opportunity to be part of a leading firm whilst being instrumental in the growth of the service offering.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
* Reviews materials and supports in meetings and workshops with business stakeholders to understand and gather business / functional requirements, undertaking client assessments and building relationships with business stakeholder.
* Builds relationships and collaborates with the wider team to understand business requirements and translates these into complex technical requirements.
* Produces technical specifications to guide system architectural design and development and conducts quality assurance tasks to ensure completeness of requirements, peer reviewing the work of more junior members of the team.
* Monitors and reports on potential risks/opportunities of emerging technologies, and forms recommendations for system and technical components based on understanding of business requirements, reviewing and supporting with process modelling and improvement.
* Contributes to the design and review of test cases to ensure tests adequately meet the requirements and coordinates with infrastructure and operations teams to resolve system issues, contributing to moderately complex aspects of a project.
* Provides insights on whether solutions and technologies being implemented are meeting business requirements.
* Contributes to business case development and completes RFP responses, exploring and experimenting with new and existing data to tackle defined business problems .


**Skills And Attributes For Success**
* Proven experience gathering and interpreting business requirements.
* Proven experience developing technical requirements and specifications, including knowledge of software engineering methodologies, reporting tools, modelling and testing.
* Proven understanding of Lean Six Sigma and Business Process Modelling and Notation.
* Knowledge on application building using Python would be an added advantage.


**Ideally, you’ll also**
* Preferably CA/MBA/B.E/B.Tech with 3 to 7 years of implementation and advisory experience on Oracle Cloud ERP/EBS security and controls.
* Ability to drive risk and control programs for Oracle EBS/ERP Cloud, with a focus on the following:
* 
+ Segregation of duty concerns in an ERP environment along with an ability to design SoD (Segregation of Duties) risk libraries, and preparation of remediation roadmaps.
+ System role\-design, build security and troubleshoot security defects.
+ Design risk control matrices by conducting workshops with business process owners.
+ Review Oracle ERP IT Application Controls (ITAC) for test of design and test of effectiveness.
+ Identify potential opportunities to automate current ITDM/manual controls leveraging Oracle EBS/ERP Cloud.
+ Deep understanding of regulatory frameworks like COSO, COBIT.
+ Knowledge and audit experience across regulations like SOX, GDPR, CCPA.

* Functional knowledge on Oracle EBS/ERP Cloud Financials, Procurement, Supply chain management, Projects and HRMS is a pre\-requisite.
* Sound relevant experience in either an internal or external business analysis role and/or software / technical analysis role or similar, evidenced by adding business value through identifying, analysing and articulating problems and solutions .
* Developed technical knowledge and experience in delivering IT solutions, providing technical advice and understanding user requirements.
* Some stakeholder management experience.
* Ability to simplify data and explain trends through Excel spreadsheets, dashboards, power\-point presentations is highly desirable.
* Knowledge of Oracle GRC (Governance, Risk \& Compliance) \& Oracle Risk Management Cloud (RMC) is highly desirable.
* Working knowledge on Peoplesoft, NetSuite, MS Dynamics and Workday would be an added advantage.
* Willing to learn and work on different ERPs and CRM solutions


**What We Look For**
* A Team of people with commercial acumen, technical experience and enthusiasm to learn new things in this fast\-moving environment with consulting skills.
* An opportunity to be a part of market\-leading, multi\-disciplinary team of 1400 \+ professionals, in the only integrated global transaction business worldwide.
* Opportunities to work with EY Consulting practices globally with leading businesses across a range of industries


**What We Offer You**
 At EY, we’ll develop you with future\-focused skills and equip you with world\-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams.
   

  

* Our Commitment: As a commitment, we persistently endeavour to embody our values, fulfil our purpose, and champion inclusiveness. Our dedication is to cultivate EY into an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, creating a supportive atmosphere for individuals to authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost.
* Professional Development: From entry\-level employees to senior leaders, we believe in continuous learning. We offer opportunities to build new skills, take on leadership roles, and connect and grow through mentorship.
* People and Culture: In our dynamic workplace, diversity, equity, and inclusiveness are ingrained in our culture. We're united by a commitment to create an environment where every individual's differences are valued, practices are equitable, fostering a sense of belonging. Our shared values include integrity, respect, teaming, inclusiveness, energy, enthusiasm, courage to lead, and building relationships based on doing the right thing.
* Benefits: Embark on a transformative career journey with us and indulge in a suite of premium benefits, encompassing exclusive health and wellness packages, enticing rewards, and cutting\-edge learning opportunities that empower you to continually grow and excel in your professional and personal development.
* How to Apply: If you are passionate to join us and are aligned with our commitment to building a better working world, we invite you to apply by completing our user\-friendly form with personal and professional information and by providing your consent to data privacy.


**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY is building a better working world by creating new value for clients, people, society and the planet, while building trust in capital markets.
   

  

 Enabled by data, AI and advanced technology, EY teams help clients shape the future with confidence and develop answers for the most pressing issues of today and tomorrow.
   

  

 EY teams work across a full spectrum of services in assurance, consulting, tax, strategy and transactions. Fueled by sector insights, a globally connected, multi\-disciplinary network and diverse ecosystem partners, EY teams can provide services in more than 150 countries and territories.

description:

* Define and execute the SAP roadmap aligned to business strategy, including S/4 HANA evolution, RISE / cloud strategy and integration with non\-SAP systems

* **Delivery \& Operations**



  




* Lead end\-to\-end SAP implementations, upgrades, and migrations (ECC → S/4HANA, Greenfield / Brownfield), ensuring on\-time, on\-budget delivery with quality

* Ensure seamless integration between SAP modules (FI, CO, MM, SD, PP, QM, PM, WM/EWM, PS, etc.) and with MES, SCADA, PLM, BI, and other enterprise systems.



  




* **Manufacturing \& Domain Leadership**



  




* Partner with COO, Plant Heads, and Supply Chain leaders to align SAP architecture with production planning, capacity planning, shop\-floor automation, and MRP processes

* Drive digital manufacturing initiatives (e.g., shop\-floor data capture, IoT integration, advanced analytics, AI/ML, RPA) on SAP BTP and allied platforms



  




* **Team \& Vendor Management**



  




* Build and lead a high\-performing team of functional, technical, and basis consultants, as well as support staff; drive capability building and succession planning

* **Risk, Security \& Compliance**



  




* Own application security, role design, SoD controls, and data protection in line with corporate policies and regulatory requirements
* Ensure audit readiness and support internal/external audits with appropriate documentation and controls



  




* **Reporting and Relationships**



  




* **Reports to:**
* Sr. GM (IT) / CFO



  




* **Direct reports:**
* SAP functional leads, technical leads, support managers, and project managers



  




* **Key stakeholders:**
* COO, Plant Heads, CFO, CHRO, Supply Chain Head, Quality Head, and external partners



  





**Qualifications** 




  




* Qualifications \& Experience
* 15–20 years in SAP and enterprise applications, with at least 2 full\-cycle SAP implementations in complex manufacturing setups
* Strong hands\-on experience with SAP S/4 HANA (implementation and / or migration) and deep knowledge of core modules: FI, CO, MM, SD, PP, QM, PM; exposure to PS, WM /EWM, and Group Reporting is preferred
* Proven track record managing large teams (10\+) and multi\-plant, multi\-location rollouts



  




* **Education**
* Graduate or Postgraduate in Engineering, Finance, Marketing or Material Management



  





**Required Skills** 



* Skills and Competencies
* Domain: Manufacturing operations, supply chain, finance \& controlling, project systems, and plant maintenance
* Technical: SAP S/4HANA, ECC, SAP BTP, integration middleware, basic ABAP understanding, analytics (e.g., SAP Analytics Cloud, Power BI, Superset / Grafana)
* Leadership: Strategic thinking, stakeholder management, negotiation, team building, and executive communication
* Transformation: Digital transformation, automation (RPA / AI), cloud strategies (SAP RISE), and continuous improvement mindset

**Join Us!**

* Develop technical concepts for Layouts, technical specifications, selection of equipment and connection material considering costs, quality, international standards, and material.
* Provide technical calculations, technical purchasing specification and schedules for all equipment for projects or tenders.


**Experience, Education And Other Required**
* Bachelor or master's'in electrical engineering or equivalent
* 10\+ years substation engineering experience in Utilities or EPC industry.
* Good communication skill, to interact with external and internal parties at all levels in a multi\-cultural environment.
* Expert knowledge in Substation design and engineering, Layouts, Primary design \& calculations, Grounding \& Lightning design, Steel design inputs, transformers, HV \& MV Switchgear systems.

 Shaping energy solutions to empower sustainable connectivity.
   

  

 We combine AtkinsRéalis project management expertise and Hitachi Energy's deep technological knowledge to create a company dedicated to substations – we are Linxon.
   

  

 Linxon's vision is to deliver the best market offering for turnkey substation projects through world\-class power technologies and delivering the highest level of competence in managing infrastructure projects.

title: Supply Chain Manager
description:

 Metayb is a digital transformation company on a mission to transform seamlessly by empowering organisations to navigate the vast landscape of the digital\-first era. We have grown into a close\-knit family of
 **500\+ employees** 
 , each possessing rich field expertise. Metayb focuses on fostering seamless customer experiences, enhancing operational efficiency, and deriving actionable insights. By harnessing the power of emerging technologies, Metayb aims to be the unparalleled choice for global customers, delivering strategic goals effectively within a digital\-first ecosystem of value creation.
   

  

 Our key areas of expertise lie in
 **Digital Transformation, Data Science, SAP Implementation, Workflow Automation, Dashboarding, Visualization, Finance, and Supply Chain Services** 
 . We strongly aspire to venture into
 **IoT, AI/ML, and Virtual Reality** 
 . Metayb endeavours to be best\-in\-class across digital solutions, infrastructure, and product engineering.
   

  

 Role Overview
   

  

 We are looking for an experienced
 **Supply Chain Manager** 
 to manage and coordinate end\-to\-end
 **logistics, shipment planning, transportation, dispatch, and supply chain operations** 
 across the Middle East and Africa region, with a particular focus on
 **Saudi Arabia and Egypt** 
 .
   

  

 The role will focus on ensuring smooth shipment execution, timely deliveries, transportation management, supply chain visibility, and effective coordination with internal and external stakeholders. The position will work closely with the
 **Head of Logistics** 
 to provide operational support, maintain critical logistics information, monitor shipment progress, and proactively manage delivery risks and operational challenges.
   

  

 The ideal candidate should have extensive experience in
 **logistics, transportation, dispatch, warehousing, and supply chain operations** 
 , along with strong SAP knowledge and the ability to manage multiple stakeholders across international markets.
   

  

 This role is based in
 **Chennai** 
 and operates on a
 **12:00 PM to 9:00 PM IST shift.**
 The working week is
 **Saturday to Thursday** 
 , with
 **Friday as the weekly off** 
 .
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

 🔹 Shipment Planning \& Coordination
   

  

* Coordinate daily dispatch and shipment activities based on customer orders and delivery schedules.
* Plan and arrange transportation for shipments from factories to customer locations across Saudi Arabia, Egypt, and other relevant Middle East and African markets.
* Work closely with the Head of Logistics to support day\-to\-day logistics planning, execution, and operational decision\-making.
* Act as an operational support and coordination point for the Head of Logistics, maintaining critical shipment, transportation, and logistics information.
* Ensure timely availability of vehicles, transportation resources, and logistics partners required for shipment execution.
* Maintain updated contact details and records of transport vendors, drivers, logistics partners, and other relevant stakeholders.
* Track shipments from dispatch through delivery and proactively identify, report, and resolve potential delays, disruptions, and delivery risks.
* Coordinate closely with warehouse teams to ensure packing, loading, documentation, and dispatch readiness.
* Maintain effective communication with internal teams and multi\-national stakeholders to ensure smooth execution of logistics operations.
* Maintain strong governance and visibility across the end\-to\-end supply chain and logistics process.
* Develop a strong understanding of business operations and ensure timely fulfilment of customer and business commitments.


 🔹 Transportation \& Logistics Management
   

  

* Manage and coordinate transportation activities across Saudi Arabia, Egypt, and other Middle East and African markets.
* Liaise with transport vendors, third\-party logistics providers, drivers, warehouses, factories, and destination teams to ensure smooth shipment execution.
* Monitor vehicle movement, shipment status, delivery schedules, and transportation performance.
* Proactively identify transportation risks and coordinate appropriate corrective actions to minimise delivery disruptions.
* Resolve transportation delays, vehicle availability issues, and delivery\-related challenges in coordination with relevant stakeholders.
* Ensure effective coordination between factories, warehouses, transporters, drivers, customers, and destination teams.
* Support effective management of freight, transportation resources, shipment tracking, and delivery performance.
* Maintain accurate records of transportation activities, shipment status, delays, and operational issues.
* Identify opportunities to improve transportation efficiency, service levels, and supply chain performance.


 🔹 Supply Chain Operations \& SAP
   

  

* Leverage strong SAP knowledge to support logistics planning, shipment execution, reporting, and day\-to\-day supply chain operations.
* Ensure timely and accurate updates of shipment and logistics information within relevant systems.
* Monitor supply chain activities and maintain visibility across the order, dispatch, transportation, and delivery cycle.
* Prepare and maintain logistics and supply chain reports covering shipment status, delivery performance, delays, transportation activities, and operational risks.
* Work closely with internal stakeholders to ensure accurate flow of information across the supply chain.
* Identify operational bottlenecks and support initiatives focused on process improvement, supply chain efficiency, and operational governance.
* Ensure adherence to established processes, controls, and governance requirements across logistics operations.


 🔹 Stakeholder \& Vendor Management
   

  

* Maintain strong relationships with transport vendors, logistics partners, warehouse teams, factory teams, customers, and internal stakeholders.
* Coordinate effectively with stakeholders across different countries, cultures, and time zones.
* Serve as a key coordination point between the Head of Logistics and operational stakeholders.
* Ensure timely communication of shipment status, operational challenges, delays, and critical escalations.
* Escalate significant logistics and supply chain issues to the appropriate stakeholders with relevant information and recommended actions.
* Support effective stakeholder communication to ensure continuity and smooth execution of logistics operations.
* Build and maintain strong relationships with logistics partners to support reliable transportation and service delivery.


**Qualifications**
* Bachelor's Degree in Logistics, Supply Chain Management, Business Administration, or a related discipline.
* 15–20 years of experience in logistics, transportation, dispatch, warehousing, or supply chain operations.
* Strong experience working in manufacturing, factory, warehouse, distribution, or FMCG environments.
* Extensive experience in shipment planning, transportation coordination, logistics operations, and supply chain management.
* Experience managing logistics operations across international or multinational markets is preferred.
* Candidates with strong exposure to Middle East and Africa logistics operations will be preferred.
* Arabic\-speaking candidates will be given priority.


**Required Skills**
* Strong understanding of transportation, logistics, distribution, and end\-to\-end supply chain processes.
* Strong hands\-on experience with SAP and proficiency in Microsoft Excel.
* Experience in logistics reporting, shipment tracking, freight management, and transportation coordination.
* Strong knowledge of dispatch planning, delivery management, warehouse coordination, and transportation operations.
* Excellent stakeholder management, communication, coordination, and relationship management skills.
* Strong customer\-service orientation with the ability to manage internal and external relationships effectively.
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, and decision\-making abilities.
* High attention to detail with a strong focus on process governance, operational control, and supply chain visibility.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and operational challenges in a fast\-paced, international environment.
* Strong ownership and accountability for shipment execution, delivery commitments, and logistics performance.
* Ability to work effectively with multi\-national teams and stakeholders across different regions and time zones.
* Strong understanding of freight management and shipment tracking systems.
* Arabic language proficiency will be a significant advantage.


**Preferred Experience**
* Experience in the FMCG industry.
* Exposure to logistics and supply chain operations across the Middle East and Africa region.
* Experience managing shipments to Saudi Arabia, Egypt, GCC countries, or African markets.
* Experience working with international transportation vendors and logistics partners.
* Strong exposure to SAP\-based supply chain and logistics operations.
* Arabic language proficiency.
* Experience supporting or working closely with a Head of Logistics, Supply Chain Director, or senior supply chain leadership.


**Disclaimer:** 
*The job title mentioned in this description is generic and intended for broad categorization purposes. The final designation will be determined based on the candidate’s performance during the interview process, relevant experience, and alignment with the organizational hierarchy.*

 The Contract Specialist will engage in contractual matters related to account\-level agreements and subordinate, engagement\-specific documents for complex information technology (IT) services (e.g.,Technology Preferred Provider (TPP) relationships and managed services). The Contract Specialist will provide support ranging from contractual compliance / administrative matters, contractual research related to business issues that intersect one or more contracts, and reviews of customized contract documents (Statements of Work (SOWs), Work Orders and Change Orders). The Contract Specialist will work closely with the US Risk Managers to help manage contractual matters related to client\-facing IT contracts and non\-standard subcontracting agreements.
   

  

 The Contract Specialist will be primarily responsible for matters related to contractual administration and compliance and will maintain contractual currency for dynamic contracts. The Contract Specialist will team with the US Risk Manager(s) to interact with other functions (e.g., Office of General Counsel (OGC); Information Security (InfoSec); Office of Confidentiality and Privacy (OCP); Contigence Workforce Services (CWS)) to orchestrate integrated support and guidance for Deloitte’s client teams to address policies and procedures, contractual obligations, and regulatory compliance, as applicable.
   

  

 Service capabilities provided by the Contract Specialist will help identify contractual risks and mitigations and deploy structured contract management processes for compliance with contractual commitments and deliverables.
   

  

* Provide guidance and support to Deloitte account teams post contract execution for multi\-tiered contractual relationships for complex IT services (e.g.,TPP accounts and subordinate services engagements)
* Prepare MSA summaries (for business use), engagement summaries, obligations trackers, and contracting guidebooks
* Identify key contractual terms and requirements, including obligations and deliverables
* Periodically assess currency / compliance (together with the US Risk Manager(s)) and report on contractual obligations and deliverables
* Perform thorough research of tiered contracts in connection with business issues or disputes
* Prepare analysis of potential options for resolution / response with contractual support provided
* Work with the US Risk Manager(s) to distil complex business issues that intersect one or more contracts

* Review and provide input to subordinate statements of work, work orders, and complex change orders by reviewing for contractual clarity and promoting Risk mitigations

* Support US Risk Managers with contract closeout processes (including for partial terminations) by assisting with guidance to account / engagement PMOs for offboarding checklists; assist with document archival instructions and address return of confidential information, declaration of proprietary works, and transfer of software licenses

**Description**
 Interested in shaping the future of conversational and ambient AI at massive scale? Join the Alexa Ambient Computing Technologies (AACT) team. AACT's mission is to design, build, and operate the core horizontal services that power Alexa as the world's largest IoT installation and the most capable, efficient, and trusted AI assistant. We deliver the core capabilities that allow Alexa to connect, discover, set up, manage, and interface with over 1B connected endpoints (Echo, FireTV, Smart Home, Mobile, and Metis). Our work directly impacts every Alexa\+ customer interaction, and we're obsessed with making it fast, reliable, and efficient \- increasingly by putting generative AI and agentic systems at the center of how we build and operate.
   

  

 We're seeking a Director of Software Development to own all India\-based charters and teams. This role will manage AACT's charter and lead our teams based in Bangalore and Chennai consisting of SDMs, SDEs, TPMs, and SQEs. This leader will recruit and develop high\-caliber leaders and individuals and will set the standard for how an AI\-first engineering organization operates \- where large language models, agents, and AI\-assisted development are integral to strategy, execution, and day\-to\-day engineering.
   

  

 The successful candidate will demonstrate strong intellectual curiosity, sound judgment, and creativity in solving complex, ambiguous technical problems, along with the ability to lead and scale large technical teams and influence across functions to drive results through others in a highly cross\-functional environment.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

* Define and drive technical strategy for critical initiatives — whether that's expanding Alexa into new modalities, enabling more fluid multi\-turn conversations, or evolving our inference and orchestration infrastructure to support both.
* As part of the AACT Senior Leadership team, set the India sites' strategy and lead software engineering teams.
* Own Operational Excellence (OE) for AACT India\-based charters — accountable for the availability, latency, security, and cost efficiency of the services your teams operate, including on\-call, incident response, COEs, and driving continuous operational improvements at scale.
* Champion the responsible adoption of generative AI and agentic tooling across the org — in the products you ship (LLM\-driven experiences, orchestration, inference) and in how your teams build (AI\-assisted coding, review, testing, and operations) — while owning the quality, safety, cost, and latency tradeoffs that come with it.
* Build the talent, mechanisms, and culture that let a large organization move quickly and safely with AI, raising engineering leverage and productivity without compromising customer trust or operational excellence.


**Basic Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree in computer science or related field.
* 15\+ years of software engineering experience.
* 8\+ years of demonstrated experience managing senior engineering managers.
* Experience as a mentor, tech lead, or leading an engineering team.
* Experience collaborating across multiple organizations and influencing key outcomes.
* Experience as a technical leader of multiple concurrent projects, driving strategic technical decisions.
* Understanding software engineering practices and best practices for the full software development life cycle including coding standards, build processes, testing, and operations.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Master's degree in computer science or related field.
* Demonstrated experience leading product and development teams, with a focus on customer service or user\-facing technologies.
* Experience in a lead role in bringing a product to market.
* Proven track record of taking emerging technologies from research to production\-ready solutions.
* Familiarity with generative AI models and their application in customer interactions and process automation.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
* AI Leadership Competencies \-We expect a director at this level to be fluent in AI as both a product capability and an engineering multiplier. Specifically:
* AI fluency and technical judgment — A working understanding of modern generative AI: LLMs, foundation models, prompting, fine\-tuning/RAG, agents and tool use, evaluation, and inference optimization. Able to engage credibly with scientists and senior engineers, ask the right questions.
* AI strategy and prioritization — Able to identify genuine, durable AI opportunities and to translate them into a prioritized, measurable roadmap tied to customer and business outcomes (latency, cost\-per\-interaction, trust).
* Driving AI\-assisted engineering productivity — Actively raises the leverage of the org by adopting AI\-assisted development, review, testing, and operations. Sets expectations, mechanisms, and guardrails so teams use these tools effectively and consistently, and measures the impact on throughput and quality.
* Cost, latency, and scale economics of AI — Understands the economics of inference at scale and drives the right tradeoffs across model selection, orchestration, caching, and infrastructure to keep experiences fast, reliable, and efficient.
* Talent and culture for an AI\-first org — Attracts, develops, and retains leaders and builders who thrive in an AI\-native environment, and fosters a culture of experimentation, learning, and responsible innovation.

title: Senior Program Manager, RBS : Cost to Serve
description:
**Description**
 Amazon strives to be Earth's most customer\-centric company, where customers can find and discover anything they want to buy online. Retail Business Services (RBS) accelerates Amazon's growth by improving customer and Selling Partner (SP) experiences, while optimizing costs across Stores WW. RBS operates at the intersection of retail, operations, technology, and finance, ensuring Amazon's systems and processes scale reliably while maintaining a high\-quality customer and selling\-partner experience.
   

  

 Cost to Serve (CtS) is a specialized organization within RBS focused on improving Amazon's per\-unit economics across the global supply chain. CtS operates on two pillars: defect identification and defect elimination, and partners with WW Operations, Finance, Returns, Concessions, and abuse\-related programs to uncover true cost drivers and remove them systematically. The team builds mechanisms that improve cost predictability, strengthen upstream defect visibility, and enable consistent governance across high\-impact cost categories, contributing directly to improved Free Cash Flow and scalable business growth.
   

  

 Are you passionate about building AI\-powered cost intelligence solutions at scale? Amazon's RBS CtS organization is looking for an experienced Senior Program Manager to lead our charter for identification of emerging cost trends, which serves as the first step in the journey of Defect Identification and contributes to the organization’s defect elimination work. This role serves as the primary business POC, engaging with RBS, Retail category, FBA and Finance teams in managing two projects (i) Project Strata, a layered analytical product built on a "peel the layers" philosophy that gives RBS and Stores leadership a unified, one\-stop view of how Cost to Serve is trending — decomposing headline P\&L costs into granular operational drivers and identifying cost opportunities through benchmarking between different time periods, MPs, channels and business lines. (ii) Defining and setting up P0 output and input metrics for RBS's UDE program. This role also serves as the primary POC to our tech partners in building and scaling above two projects and guides a team of Business Analysts who co\-develop and validate the MLP and scaled product's outputs.
   

  

 This leader will define requirements, own the working backward plan and oversee the daily mechanisms that connect business expertise to technical development. The ideal candidate is equally comfortable managing technical product delivery and presenting program health to Director\-level leadership, with the judgment to navigate ambiguity in a fast\-moving, high\-visibility space.
   

  

 Why You’ll Love This Role
   

  

* High Impact at Scale: You'll lead identification of emerging cost trends and drive investment by the Org in right cost areas.
* Build with Tech: Serve as the key business voice shaping an AI\-powered platform from the ground up, defining what good looks like and ensuring the tool meets the bar for downstream adoption.
* Leadership Visibility: Own updates to senior leaders on key organizational priorities, with direct influence on how the organization invests in automation long\-term.


 Key job responsibilities
   

  

* Business/Tech Partnership \& Requirements Definition: Serve as the primary business counterpart to the analytics and tech teams.
* Working Backward Planning: Own the milestone delivery plan for above two projects. Identify risks early, adjust plans proactively, and maintain credible path\-to\-green narratives for leadership.
* BA Team Oversight: Manage the Business Analysts who develop MLP of the products. Iteratively capture feedbacks from Stores leaders and ensure the feedback mechanism runs smoothly, quality standards are maintained, and BAs are effectively translating domain expertise into product development.
* Quality \& Trade\-off Decisions: Hold a high bar on output quality. When design or quality blockers arise, make trade\-off decisions that balance speed, accuracy, and adoption — escalating to senior leaders for significant calls.

CAM currently serves 30\+ programs and is scaling rapidly, with self\-serve surfaces generating demand across dozens of organizations. CAM's mission is to make customer obsession an operating habit — turning scattered anecdotes into systematic, evidence\-backed decisions at the speed Amazon operates.
   

  

 Lead deep, strategic partnerships that expand CAM's footprint within Amazon's largest and most complex organizations. As the Senior Program Manager for Enterprise Growth, you'll own the post\-launch relationship with CAM's Tier\-1 partners — driving expansion into new leaders, new signals, and new use cases within organizations that have already adopted CAM in production. You are the depth engine: where the acquisition team drives new customers, you grow them into durable, multi\-signal relationships that generate the executive sponsorship and reference stories that make future adoption easier.

* Own the strategic partner portfolio. Manage end\-to\-end relationships with CAM's Tier\-1 accounts as they mature past production launch.

description:
**Job Title: Supply Chain Assurance Manager – Pacific (Australia and New Zealand)**
 ISS connects people and places to make the world work better. Are you ready to connect to a place where you belong? At our corporate facilities or at client sites – together, we make places while transforming businesses into having even more positive impact on societies, the environment, and our people.
   

  

**Location:** 
 Guindy, Chennai, India
   

  

**Language:** 
 English
   

  

**Main purpose of the position:**
 ISS is looking for dynamic individuals in the supply chain, risk and assurance function to drive CUSTOMER VALUE by securing assurance of subcontractors that provide compliance services to ISS.
   

  

 We’re delighted to be recruiting for a new Supply Chain Assurance Manager to join the ISS Procurement Excellence team. This role will be predominantly working with our Australia and New Zeeland team and Group Supply chain assurance team. Working with suppliers and subcontractors who are aligned with ISS and its customers’ values is critically important to us; the Supply Chain Assurance team drive supply chain compliance with ISS standards and policies on our key customer accounts. You will be responsible for supplier relationship management. Reporting to the Assistant General Manager of Supply Chain Assurance, you will play a key role in adding value to our customer accounts in the Australia and New Zealand, minimising risk exposure via the implementation, delivery, and reinforcement of supplier management processes.
   

  

 You will work cross\-functionally to ensure effective supplier management and strong relationships with both ISS functions and countries (Australia and New Zealand).
   

  

**What you’ll do:**
* Supplier Relationship Management: Ensure focus with material supplier(s), that delivery is consistent, aligned to scope and quality assured.
* Ensure supplier performance is monitored at defined intervals, and corrective actions are implemented to address performance gaps.
* Creation of supplier contracts with flow\-down terms and conditions for our material suppliers in Australia and New Zeeland providing services to Key Accounts \- liaising with the supplier, Country Legal, the ISS customer account management team and Country Procurement category teams where appropriate. Negotiate terms, pricing and set KPIs and manage the contracts through to signing.
* Work in collaboration with the Vetting team and group assurance team to ensure compliance for suppliers in the assurance programme
* Manage ‘material’ suppliers to complete any client specific requirements
* Conduct audit support activity – introduction meeting including presentation, pre\-audit documentation, collaborate with supplier to close gap closure items and submit relevant documentation for closure
* Management of action plans for our key customer accounts, to incorporate defined standards of compliance with the Group Supply Chain \& Procurement supplier assurance programme
* Managing and reporting on performance by all parties per supplier assurance activity
* Routinely re\-communicating the supplier assurance programme parameters and its importance to all stakeholders and securing their continued buy\-in
* Support as required for wider supplier assurance activities, Procurement Excellence projects, and Supply Chain \& Procurement objectives


**Ideal Candidate**
* Previous employment in Supply Chain Management, Supplier Assurance or Procurement (typically 5\+ years), or strong corporate background in other professional services within a large organisation
* Degree level education or professional qualification (e.g., CIPS) is highly desirable
* Demonstrable experience in stakeholder/relationship management skills
* Strong business acumen, with negotiation skills (experience of working with contracts is highly desirable)
* Organised, thorough, and diligent work ethic; a desire to take ownership of tasks and deadlines, executing activities without micromanagement


**Who you’ll work with:**
* Key Account Director / Key Operation Directors – ensure in first instance Compliance Services are managed effectively.
* Critical and Strategic Suppliers (Key contacts)
* Interact with senior ISS stakeholders in establishing a fact base for implementing and driving performance management of suppliers and subcontractors
* Interact with our customers to define, deliver, and update on the assurance progress and enable a risk
* Drive results through working with country procurement, operations organizations and subcontractor.


**Personal skills you excel:**
* On a personal level, you are structured and demonstrates energy, persistence, and determination in the implementation of projects and initiatives.
* You are diplomatic and persuasive and demonstrates good understanding of the general business principles.
* Moreover, you have great interpersonal skills in building relationship and networking with both internal and external stakeholders.
* Knowledge of Technical Services


**Why ISS**
 Since our founding in 1901, ISS has been a people\-first company. We recognize the power of diversity and celebrate the differences that make us unique. When everyone is free to be themselves, everyone benefits. Our people feel safe, respected, represented, and supported as their authentic selves, allowing them to seize opportunities and reach their full potential. We take seriously our obligation to improve lives, make a difference in our communities, and protect our planet — because when we get things right, the world works better. And that is what drives us.
   

  

**ISS is a Place to Be You.**
 Be who you are. Become what you want. Be part of something bigger.
   

  

 Become more.
 **Become ISS.**
**How You’ll Apply**
 Apply directly via the link on this page by submitting a cover letter, CV and other relevant documents for the position you are applying for.
   

  

 We look forward to receiving your application as soon as possible.
   

  

**ISS seeks to BE a place of belonging and CREATE places where every person is welcomed, embraced, and valued for exactly who they are. Places where people feel safe, respected, represented, and supported as their authentic selves.**

The role contributes to the transformation of the Global Delivery Unit into the Future Mode of Operation (FMO) supporting large\-scale adoption of automation, follow\-the\-sun delivery, AI techniques, and a one\-standard approach across Global Delivery Centers, while ensuring quality and competitiveness at a GDC level.

The role will be responsible for operationalizing and executing globally defined sub\-capability strategies within the GDC\-specific Program \& Project Management Services’ managed area / service and team. This includes optimizing service delivery, operational performance, and delivery execution within the agreed global framework defined by L3 leadership. While global strategy ownership remains with the Cluster Delivery Head of Program \& Project Services – IN/PH/MY, decision authority of the Program \& Project Management Services Manager is focused on operational execution, prioritization, and delivery governance within a single location.
   

  

**Key Objectives**
* Given the role has single\-location accountability within one Global Delivery Center and country, execute and operationalize the globally defined sub\-capability strategy and standards for the managed area / service and team within Program \& Project Management Services of P\&PS, aligned with the HIT\&DWP Service Line strategy.
* Manage and develop high\-performing professionals within the Program \& Project Management Services’ managed area / service of dedicated location, collaborating with global and regional stakeholders.
* Provide guidance and support to local team members within the managed area, fostering continuous learning while promoting diversity and an inclusive workplace.
* Ensure effective and efficient delivery through strong people leadership, skills development, and implementation of global career pathways.
* Oversee the planning, execution, and delivery of services within the local managed area / service and team of GDC.
* Drive continuous improvement and standardization across all managed services or teams within the GDC, aligned to expected outcomes such as standardization, effectiveness, efficiency, and roadmap delivery.
* Identify opportunities for business growth and improved market competitiveness, tailored to the managed area.
* Establish and oversee management reporting, review, and change\-control processes.
* Drive the adoption and effective use of Agile practices. Implement AI and automation solutions as defined by global standrads to enhance local delivery performance.
* Ensure compliance with industry regulations, organisational and GDU policies, and incorporate ESG (Environmental, Social, and Governance) principles within the local GDC scope.
* Manage delivery within agreed budgets and financial frameworks defined at sub\-capability level, ensuring cost discipline and forecast accuracy.
* Participate in the pre\-sales process at local execution level, including cost\-model development and approvals.
* Continuously monitor and analyse market trends affecting the managed area / service and team of GDC to identify opportunities and challenges.


**Qualifications**
* Experience: Several years (at least 8\) in the IT industry, and in a leadership or management role.
* Significant experience in managed services operations, with a track record of implementing standardized processes and delivery excellence.
* Industry Knowledge: Deep understanding of Program \& Project Management Services related industry, including the latest trends, challenges, and opportunities.
* Certifications: preferred, but non\-mandatory certifications, i.e. ITIL, Agile, PM (PMI, Prince2, P3O, PgMP).


**Competencies**
* Operational Excellence: Knowledge of operational best practices in the Program \& Project Management Services within GDC, including process improvement, quality management, resource optimization, and performance metrics.
* Strategic and Commercial Acumen: Ability to support and execute strategic plans for Program \& Project Management Services’ growth, improve service delivery, increase client satisfaction, and align operational goals with organizational strategy.

* Communication and Collaboration: Strong verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to effectively engage with clients, team members, senior management, and diverse stakeholders. Demonstrated ability to foster collaboration and teamwork within GDC.

**Description**

The Books Risk Management (BRM) Automation team is seeking a Program Manager II to drive automation programs that improve operational efficiency, strengthen risk controls, and enhance the customer experience across Amazon's Books business.
   

  

 In this role, you will partner with Product, Engineering, Risk, and Operations teams to identify opportunities, build scalable solutions, drive automation adoption, and deliver measurable business impact. You will lead high\-visibility initiatives, investigate complex operational challenges, influence technical roadmaps, and ensure automation systems continue to operate effectively as the business scales. Success in this role requires strong analytical skills, technical aptitude, ownership, and the ability to deliver results in a fast\-paced environment.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

* Partner with Product Managers, Software Engineers, Application Engineers, and Risk teams to define requirements and deliver scalable solutions.
* Identify opportunities to improve efficiency, quality, and operational scalability through automation and AI\-enabled solutions.
* Use data and metrics to identify trends, evaluate business performance, and prioritize investments.

* Monitor automation performance, adoption, accuracy, and business impact through scalable reporting mechanisms.

* Drive end\-to\-end execution of automation and process improvement programs supporting Books Risk Management workflows.
* Communicate program updates, risks, and recommendations to senior leaders and stakeholders across multiple organizations.
* Continuously evaluate emerging technologies and automation opportunities to improve risk detection, operational efficiency, and customer outcomes.


 A day in the life
   

  

 You may start your day reviewing operational metrics and automation performance, investigating a production issue impacting a critical workflow, partnering with engineers on a new automation launch, conducting a deep dive into quality trends, or presenting program updates to senior leaders. You will regularly work across business, product, and technical teams to solve complex problems, prioritize opportunities, and deliver scalable solutions that create measurable business impact.
   

  

**About The Team**
 The BRM Automation team is responsible for driving automation, AI adoption, and process transformation across Books Risk Management. Our mission is to improve operational efficiency, strengthen risk controls, and protect customer trust by building scalable solutions that reduce manual effort, improve decision quality, and enable the organization to scale effectively. We operate at the intersection of business, risk, and technology, partnering closely with engineering and product teams to solve some of the most complex challenges in the Books ecosystem.
   

  

**Basic Qualifications**
* 3\+ years of program or project management experience
* 3\+ years of working cross functionally with tech and non\-tech teams experience
* 3\+ years of defining and implementing process improvement initiatives using data and metrics experience
* Knowledge of Excel (Pivot Tables, VLookUps) at an advanced level and SQL
* Experience defining program requirements and using data and metrics to determine improvements


**Preferred Qualifications**
* 3\+ years of driving end to end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership experience

* Experience in stakeholder management, dealing with multiple stakeholders at varied levels of the organization
* Experience building processes, project management, and schedules

description:
**WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands.**
